tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud rgyal gshin rje gshed skor gyi chos 'byung rgyas pa yid ches ngo mtshar bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa maṇḍal de ba tā bhyaḥ seng ge 'phrog byed ser skya sogs/ / kun gyis bzlog par mi nus pa'i/ / gshin rje'i dmag dpung 'joms pa po/ / sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i bla mar 'dud/ / de nyid gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phyir/ khro bo'i rgyal por sku bzhengs pa/ / ya mān ta ka la btud nas/ / gleng bslang 'jug sgo cung zad rtsom/ /'dir phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i 'phrin las phyogs med du sgrub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ni/ bcom ldan 'das khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po yin la/ de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen pa gcig du 'dus pa/ rgyal sras thu bo'i tshul bzung nas/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa sgrub pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal nyid khro bo'i skur bzhengs par kun tu grags pa ltar yin la/ sngags kyi theg pa 'dir de lta bu'i tshul ston dang mthun par/ byang chub sems dpa' slob pa'i tshul du bsgrub pa dang*/ gnas tshul la sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes kyi spyi gzugs yin pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyugarigs kun gyi khyab bdagardo rje 'dzin chen po nyid kyi tshul du bsgrub pa rnam pa gnyis 'byung ba las/ rgyud sde 'og ma rnams su ni snga ma shas che la/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa 'dir ni phyi ma gtso bor gyur pa'o/ / 'on kyang rgyud 'di dag tu bshad pa'i yang sgo skyong tho ba rdo rje gshin rje gshed la sogs pa rnams dang*/ rgyud gzhan gyi phyogs mtshams skyong ba'i khro bo la sogs pa zhor byung gi sgrub thabs rnams na/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul du bsgrub pa yang theg pa bla na med pa 'dir mang po zhig bshad do/ / de dag las/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi nang tshan/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum du grags pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud don la 'jug pa'i sngon du 'gro ba 'di ltar nges par bya/

de la lnga ste/ rgyud rgyal 'di rnams mchog sgrub min par 'dod pa'i log rtog dgaga'adi rnams rgyud kyi sde tshan gar gtogs ngos bzung*/ 'di rnams kyi brjod par bya ba'i bsdus don bshad/ ston pas rgyud de dag ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul/ de nyid mi yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ zab mo'i mthar rgyud rgyal 'di rnams kyi mtshan nyid ji lta bu snyam na/ theg pa spyi'i don dang*/ mdo sngags kyi dbye ba dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi po'i spyi'i rnam gzhag rags pa tsam go zin pa'i dbang du byas nas de'i rjes la 'di ltar go bar bya ste/ 'o skol gyi ston pas rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs pa las/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa ni mthar thug pa ste/ lam gyi rim pa gang la dbang bzhi dang*/ rim pa gnyis dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ nye rgyus mtshams sbyor ba rnams ma tshang ba med par ston cing gnas lugs de kho na nyid kyang phyin ci ma log par rdzogs par ston pa'i rgyud do/ / de ni rang nyid gang la dgongs nas ston pa'i yul/ ched du bya ba'i gdul bya de bar chad glo bur ba ma byung na/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub la sbyor nus pas khyab pa yin no/ / de'i phyir 'di na kha cig spyir yang bla med pha rgyud la rdzogs rim nges pa ston dgos pa min snyam pa dang*/ dgos su 'jam dpal khro bo'i rgyud rtog pa bdun pa ni/ byang chub sgrub pa la bar chad sel byed kyi chos yin gyi/ byang chub thob byed dngos min zer ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud 'di yang*/ tha na dbang bzhi yang dngos bstan la gsal po med pas dpal 'dzin gyis kyang tshig zur la snyad bcol te/ dbang bzhi po ston byed tsam dka' tshegs kyis btsal nas/ rnal 'byor bla med du sgrub dgos byung ba yin pas/ nag po skor gsum gyi dngos bstan la rdzogs rim med do zhes smra ba ni/

chos kyi gnad gtan nas ma go bas/ chos spong gi las gsog pa kho nar snang zhing*/ rang dang blo ma mthun pa'i grub mtha' ba'i sde gzhan 'ga' zhigachos 'di gtso bor byed pa la brnyas thabs su snang yang*/ khyed kyi tshig de bden na/ sangs rgyas thob byed ma yin pa'i chos ngan pa la/ khyed rang yang dbang bskur nyan bshad rtsal 'don byed pa ltar 'dug pa shin tu blun zhing byed rgyu zad pa yin la/ yang 'di la phugs kyi 'bras bu med kyang chos 'di gzhan tsho la 'dug pas/ ngedakyang gra gshog pa'i ched du'o zer na/ khyed rnams rang gis rang gi 'dod don gsal bar smras te de ni bden no/ / de lta na yang 'dir dpyad de/ gal te rtog pa bdun pa'i lam gyis byang chub mi thob na/ rtog bdun gyi bshad pa skyo lugs dang*/ mal lugs ni mchog tu gyur pa'i chos su khyed rang 'dod pa yang mi 'thad de/ las phran tshegs tsam 'grub du zin yang mu stegs kyi chos dang mtshungs par thal ba'i phyir ro/ / yang byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad sel zhes zer ba la yang brtags na/ 'di ltar bar chad thams cad sel ba yin na ni/ byang chub sgrub byed bla na med par 'gyur te/ bar chad thams cad spangs nas byang chub ma thob pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ / tshe 'di'i nad dang gnod byed dang*/ 'phongs pa sel ba tsam la byed na ni/ de tsam gyis byang chub kyi bar chad sel byed du 'jog mi thub cing*/ de 'dra ni sman dang rdzas dang rig pa dang*/ dgra thabs la sogs pa'i blo gros kyis kyang nus pas na/ grong pa'i skye bo rnams dang thun mong du 'gyur bas/ 'dir khyed bar chad srung ba dang 'joms pa'i tshad gang la 'jogaskye ba phyi ma gcig gam gnyis su sdug bsngal sel ba la 'jog na yang*/ mu stegs dang thun mong du 'gyur la/ bdud dang gshin rje thub pa la 'jog na ni/ de la ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes skye dgos pas/ de ka la byang chub thob pa'i thabs zhes zer ba go dgos so/

khyed kyi go yul na rnam bcad kyi cha nas/ bar chad la sogs pa'i skyon spangs pa yin pa la/ yongs gcod kyi cha nas yon tan mngon par ma bsgrub pa cig srid/ mtshan gzhi chos skor 'di rnams yin/ dpe zangs gzhong gi dri ma bkrus nas bcud ma blug pa dang 'dra snyam pa cig 'dug ste/ rig gras tsam ma gtogs lam gyi rim pa dang*/ spang gnyen sogs kyi go ba phyogs re tsam yang shar ba der 'dugades na gnyen po ma skyes par spang bya spong mi thub/ tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs na sgrib gnyis mi dag ste/ dper na snang ba ma byung na min pa mi sel ba bzhin no/ / des na yongs gcod du yon tan skyes pa dang*/ rnam bcad du bar chad nyes skyon sel ba bang mnyam mchong mnyam gyi tshul yin pas/ bar chad sel byed mchog tu grub na yon tan skyed byed kyang mchog tu 'grub bo/ / dpal 'dzin gyis nag po'i rgyud bla med du bsgrub pa ni 'ga' zhig gis rgyud sde 'og mar bkral ba 'gog pa'i phyir yin gyi/ bla med kyi mtshan nyid ma tshang yang*/ rgyud kyi tshig zur la 'bru log rgyab nas bla med du kha bsgyur zhing bcos pa ga la yin/ de ltar yin na rgyud kyang bla med ma yin pa dang*/ slob dpon yang rdzun po cher thal bar 'gyur ba las/ khyed rang yang de 'dra mi 'dod la raganag po'i rgyud dang rtog bdun 'di dngos gnas bla med kyi rgyud yin na/ bla med kyi rgyud kyi mtshan nyid tshang dgos pa gzhir bzhagabarlan gsher med kyang chu yin pa srid dam ci/ nag po skor gsum gyi rgyud 'di/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud yin te/ bskyed rim mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ston pa'i phyir/ rtags mngon sum gyis grub/ khas kyang blangs so/ / yang 'di skad ces/ gang bskyed rim mtshan nyid tshang ba ston na/ dngos sbas gang rung la rdzogs rim ston pas khyab/ dper na gsang ba 'dus pa bzhin/ nag po skor gsum gyi rgyud kyang*/

bskyed rim rdzogs par ston pa'i rgyud yin no/ / zhes bya'o/ / slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis bshad pa ni 'ga' zhig gis dgra nag gsang sngags phyi bar bkral/ gtso bo yum can mi rung bar 'dod pa la/ zhal phyag ston byed kyi skabs su mi gsal yang*/ gsang dbang dang*/ sher dbang gi skabs su gnyis sbyor yod/ de'i phyir gsang sngags phyi rgyud min/ gtso bo yum can dgos zhu ba glus bskul yod pas so/ / zhes sgrub byed bkod nas pha rol pa'i 'dod pa de la gnod byed zur tsam zhig bstan pa yin gyi/ dbang gong ma dang rdzogs rim 'chad rgyu med nas/ sgrub byed gzhan gyis 'phongs pa ga la yin/ lar rdzogs rim la sogs pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams/ slob ma mchog la dus su bab pa na ston par byed kyi/ gzhan dang kha shags 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa'i dus su ga la smra/ khyed rnams nyid gang yod kha ru khyer ba'i rigs 'gre de dpal 'dzin sogs ches che ba rnams la'ang sbyor ba 'di ga skyon che bar gda'o/ / des na pha rgyud kyi gshed skor/ gsang 'dus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba sogs dang*/ ma rgyud kyi mnyam sbyor sogs la/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan rdzogs rim gsal mi gsal gyi khyad par med do/ / yang mi mkhas pa de dag gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi/ rnal 'byor bskyed pa bstan pa ste/ / rdzogs pa rnal 'byor ma ru dran/ / zhes pa'i tshig gis zab don rgya chen po gzhan ston par ma shes par/ pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi khyad par ston pa yin no zhes/ chen po gzhan su yang mi smra ba la/ khyed rang rnams kho nas dran byung gsar skyes kyi 'bru log rgyab pa de ka rgyu mtshan du khyer nas/ bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud dang*/ rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud yin pas/ pha rgyud la rdzogs rim med kyang chog go zhes khungs med blo bzo byung rgyal du smra bas rmongs pa'i tshogs rnams mgo bskor bar byed de/

de la 'di skad bya ste/ pha rgyud bskyed rim gtso bor ston pas rdzogs rim med kyang chog na/ ma rgyud rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pas bskyed rim med kyang chog par thal lo/ / yang khyed rnams pha rgyud las rdzogs rim rgyas par mi ston ces pa dang*/ gsang 'dus las rdzogs par ston zer ba yang 'gal/ yang de skad smra bzhin du gsang 'dus kyi de mi zab pa'i rdzogs rim yin/ ma rgyud dang kyai rdor gyi de shin tu zab pa'i rdzogs rim yin zer ba yang de ma thag tu shin tu nang 'gal te/ mi zab pa'i rdzogs rim ni/ rdzogs rim ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ dbye ba de ltar 'byed pa ni/ rdzogs rim rang yang ngos ma zin pa'i bslab col du 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ / yang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi thob thang la rdzogs rim med tshul 'bad nas smras zin pa'i rjes su/ skyo ba rnams zhu ba'i bsam gtan dang*/ mtshan mo rgyu ba'i rdzogs rim dum tsam 'chad pa 'di/ re legs zhig 'dug go zer ba 'di ni brtad med kyi smyon gtam ste/ thob thang la med pa zhig smras pa de/ legs por 'gro ba bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa skyo ba'i lugs de legs na/ rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa gzhan byas pa la'ang mi legs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ man ngag gi sbas bshad du ni de dag kyang 'dod cing*/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan ni cig shos kyang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ / skyo bas zhu ba'i bsam gtan rdzogs rim du bkral ba'i rdzogs rim ni gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi pa yin la/ de ni khyed kyi lugs la zab mo'i rdzogs rim du 'dod cing*/ yang khyed kyi pha rgyud la spyir rdzogs rim dgos rgyu chung zhing*/ dgos su zab mo'i rdzogs rim mi yong zhes smras zin la/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud pha rgyud du yang 'dod pas/ 'gal 'du'i phung po 'di 'dra ba ji lta bu yin/ khyed rnams nyid kyis soms shiganam zhig na khyed rang rnams kyi rang tshul go bar 'gyur ram snyam/

gzhan gyis smras na ni khyed la zhe sdang mi bzad pa 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'di ltar nges pa bya ste/ bla med kyi rgyud sde gang la/ lha yab kyi sngags dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ las tshogs kho na gtso bor ston pa de ni pha rgyud yin la/ der ma zad lha yum rnams kyi yang sngags dang dkyil 'khor dang las tshogs rtsal du 'don pa yang yod pa ni ma rgyud yin no/ / de yang don thabs shes gnyis la/ rgyud sde de gnyis kyis bgo bsha' byas pa lta bu ni ma yin te/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud phal che ba las kyang thabs kyis lha sngags sbyor gsum yang rtsal du 'don pa'i phyir ro/ / des na thabs rgyud la yab kho na rtsal du 'don pas khyab/ ma rgyud la ni gdan bzhi'i bsdus rgyud 'di lta bu/ yum kho na rtsal du 'dod pa'ang yod mod/ phal cher las gnyis ka rtsal du 'don no/ / des na thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par gyi ming khyad par can la thob ste/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud ces bya ba ni/ gnas gzhi'i mo g.yen zer ba dang 'dra'o/ / stong nyid snying rje'am/ bskyed rdzogs sam/ sgyu lus 'od gsal lam/ bsod nams ye shes sam/ bde stong gsal stong sogs kyi sgo nas/ pha ma'i rgyud kyi dbye ba mi rung ste/ gnyis kas kyang de thams cad ston par mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ / 'o na pha rgyud la ni rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya la/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa ni ma rgyud kyi ming ma yin nam/ ci'i phyir thabs rgyud bla med du 'jog snyam na/ pha rgyud ma rgyud don gyi 'gangs 'dra yang*/ khyad par can gyi byin rlabs 'jug tshul 'ga' zhigam rgyud la lhag por yod par bsams nas/ rgyud sde lnga 'dod pa la sogs pa'i 'dod tshul ltar na de bzhin yin mod kyi/ rgyud sde bzhir phye ba'i bla med kyi dbang du byas na/ gsang sngags nang rgyud thams cad la rnal 'byor bla med ces bya'o/ / de la 'di go dgos te/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/

de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ / 'dod chags thabs chen po yi rgyud/ / gang gis legs par shes nas ni/ / tshe 'dir dngos grub sbyin par bshad/ / gsang ba 'dus pa stong phrag gcig/ rdo rje 'phreng ba 'bum phrag gsum/ / dgongs pa lung ston stong phrag bzhi/ / lha mo bzhis zhus brgya bdun bcu/ / phyi ma'i rgyud la nyis brgya brgyad/ / de yi nye bar bshad pa'i rgyud/ / dam tshig chen po lnga bcu lnga/ / rdo rje lnga 'dus stong phrag gcig/ kun las btus pa 'bum phrag gcig/ mnyam nyid rnam rgyal nyis brgya bcu/ / zla bzang thig le stong bdun brgya/ / rdo rje sa 'og brgya nyi shu/ / cod pan rdo rje bdun brgya lnga/ khro zla thig le 'bum phrag lnga/ / rdo rje rnam rgyal dgu brgya brgyad/ / mnyam nyid gsang ba stong phrag lnga/ / rdo rje gsang rgyan stong phrag lnga/ / rdo rje gsang mdzod stong phrag bdun/

/ nor bu gsang thig 'bum phrag gcig/ snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul stong dang brgya/ / rdo rje snying rgyan stong phrag gcig/ rdo rje thod pa nyis brgya brgya/ / de nyid brgya stong brgya stong bdun/ / dam tshig mngon rgyan stong phrag gsum/ / 'jam dpal dpa' bo 'bum phrag gcig/ gsang chen bsdus pa brgya lnga bcu/ / rin chen sdong po dgu brgya bdun/ / dus kyi thig le brgya brgyad bcu/ / lha mo bstan bcos lnga brgya bdun/ / 'di rnams dgos pa'i bye brag gis/ / nga yis yang dag bstan par byas/ / 'di ni gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa yis/ / rgyud kyi dbye ba bstan pa'o/ / de bzhin du ni lag bcangs dang*/ / rgod dang ltas pa'ang shes par bya/ / de bzhin zhe sdang gti mug gi / rgyud rnams kun kyang shes par bya/ / mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud kun yang*/ / 'di yi rim pas shes par bya/ / zhes gsungs te/ yang 'dir grangs tshad bshad pa rnams ni/ rgyud kyi rkang grangs ston pa yin gyis/ shlau ka'i grangs ma yin te/ 'dir gsang ba 'dus pa stong phrag gcig tu bshad la da lta'i rtsa rgyud bsdus pa gcig po rang la yang shlau ka stong dang brgyad brgya yod pas so/ / zhes mkhas mchog dag gsung ste/ shlau ka'i grangs ma yin pa ni cis kyang 'thad la/ ud ta ra tan tra'am phyi ma'i rgyud ni/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyi ma zhes bya ba logs pa zhig yin te/ 'di nas bshad pa'i rta mgrin lha lnga'i sgrub thabs zhig sgrub thabs rgya mtsho na'ang yod la/ rgyud 'di snga mo zhig nas bod du 'gyur 'dug na'ang*/ rgyud 'bum phal cher du ma chug go / kun las btus pa zhes pa ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'o/ / mnyam nyid rnam rgyal ni gnyis med rnam rgyal lo/ / rdo rje phreng ba sogs gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud yin zhes grags na yang*/ 'phags skor ba'i lugs la de dag bshad rgyud du sbyor ba yin mod/ gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud yin na/ gsang ba 'dus pa stong phrag gcig gi nang du 'du dgos pa las/

de dag rgyud sde'i rnam grangs so sor bgrangs pa'i phyir/ gdod nas bshad rgyud du grub pa ni ma yin te/ cha mthun gyi rgyud tsam mo/ / 'o na dgongs pa lung ston ni/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'grel du mngon sum nyid du grub pa'i phyir/ ci'i phyir gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud ma yin snyam na/ da ltar rgya bod gnyis na yod pa'i dgongs pa lung ston/ 'di kho na'i dbang du byas na/ 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud du mi 'gal yang*/ rgyud de yongs rdzogs yod pa'i dbang du byas na/ mtshan dang mthun par rgyud gzhan ji snyed pa zhig la'ang*/ gsang 'dus la yod pa bzhin du dgongs bshad mang po yod pa dang*/ gzhan la ma ltos par rang rkang tshugs pa'i lha sngags cho ga rnams yod par snang bas/ rgyud de yongs rdzogs kyi dbang du byas na/ rang rkang tshugs pa yin gyi/ rgyu gzhan nye tshe ba gcig kho na'i bshad rgyud yin zhes brjod du mi rung ngo*/ / rdo rje sa 'og kyang da ltar 'gyur ba 'di ma yin te/ da lta'i 'di kri ya yin la/ 'dir bshad pa ni gnyis sbyor gyi rgyud cig yin dgos pas so/ / rdo rje snying rgyan dang*/ gsang rgyan dang*/ nor thig gsum po'ang 'dir gnyis sbyor gyi rgyud du bshad pas/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud min no/ / 'jam dpal dpa' bo zhes pa la dpa' bo ni khro bo'i ming ste/ gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud do/ / de ltar na 'di dag 'dod chags kyi rgyud yin zhing*/ de'i nang nas kyang gnyis sbyor lam byed de/ rgyud sde bzhi las bla med yin la/ de bzhin du lag bcangs kyi rgyud rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rgod pa'i rgyud spyod rgyud dang*/ ltas pa'i bde ba lam byed kyi rgyud bya rgyud la yod pa 'dod chags kyi rgyud yin la/ de bzhin du zhe sdang gi rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ gti mug gi rigs kyi rgyud kyang*/ rgyud sde bzhi kar la yod pa shes par bya zhing*/ mkha' 'gro ma ste lha mo'i rgyud kun yang gong du bshad pa 'di'i rim pas rgyud sde bzhi car la'ang yod la/

ma rgyud de re re la'ang 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum yod par shes par bya'o/ / chags chen gyi rgyud rnams tshe gcig la dngos grub ster byed yin gsungs pas/ gzhan gnyis la'ang go bar bya ste/ tshig de thog ma'i gsal byed du 'gyur bas so/ / de ltar na 'di'i grub don la/ tshe gcig lus gcig la lam bsgoms pas dngos grub thob par nus pa ni/ sngags kyi theg pa mtha' dag yin cing*/ de thams cad la spyir 'dod chags lam byed yod pa 'ba' zhig yin kyang gtso che chung gi dbang du byas nas/ chags sdang gti mug gi rigs gsum du dbye zhing*/ de gsum du 'dus kyang 'dus pa yin no/ / rgyud sde bzhi kar la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis gnyis su phye bas brgyad yod/ brgyad po thams cad la chags sdang gti mug gi rigs gsum gyis phye bas/ rgyud sde nyi shu rtsa bzhir 'gyur/ de'i nang nas bla med thabs rgyud 'dod chags kyi rigs ni gsang ba 'dus pa nas/ lha mo'i bstan bcos kyi bar/ sde tshan nyer brgyad po 'di dag yin zhing*/ nyer bdun po ni/ 'dus pa la mngon du phyogs shing de'i cha mthun pa'o/ / zhes pa'o/ / de ltar na kha cig pha rgyud kyi dbye ba la sde gsum kho na dgos pa dang*/ ma rgyud kyi dbye ba sgo drug kho na dgos zer ba dang*/ pha rgyud la rigs lnga'i rgyud kyi dbye ba med ces pa dang*/ rin chen padma las rigs gsum gyi rgyud med zer ba dang*/ rnam snang sgyu drwa gti mug gi rigs yin zer ba dang*/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag zhe sdang gi rigs yin zer ba rnams ni rgyud tshig 'dis shin du bkag pa yin te/ ma rgyud la yang rigs gsum gyi dbye ba bshad pa dang*/ pha rgyud la rin chen rigs rin chen sdong po dang*/ las kyi rigs dam tshig chen po dang*/ dam tshig mngon mkhyen gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ rdo rje lnga 'dus zhes gsungs pas 'di ni rigs lnga 'dus pa yin la/

de'i shugs la gzhan rnams rigs lnga so so ba yin par nges par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ zla gsang thig le yang rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs su mngon sum gyis grub pas/ pha rgyud la yang rigs drug gi dbye ba gsal bar thon pa'i phyir ro/ / gzhan yang padma 'bar ba'i rgyud chen po pha rgyud padma'i rigs su kun tu grags la/ de'i dum bu rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa ni pha rgyud kyang yin la padma'i rigs yin pa yang mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du rnam snang sgyu drwa dang*/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed bya ba'i rgyud gnyis po 'di dga'adod chags kyi rigs kyi rgyud du gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ sgyu drwa dang dmar nag de gnyis ni/ tshig don gnyis kar gyi phyogs nas gsang 'dus dang shin tu 'dra bar dngos su grub pa'i phyir yang*/ gsang 'dus chags rgyud yin na de dag kyang yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ / yang rnam snang gti mug dag pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed khro bo yin pas rigs de dang der 'gyur snyam na/ gsang 'dus kyang zhe sdang gi rigs su thal bar 'gyur te/ mi bskyod pa zhe sdang dag pa'i lha yin pa'i phyir dang*/ yang na chags sdang gnyis ka'i rigs su thal bar 'gyur te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la zhi khro gnyis kar yod pa'i phyir ro/ / des na 'dod chags kyi rigs gcig pu la'ang rgyal ba rigs lnga'am drug gi dbye ba yod cing*/ de'i rigs pas gzhan gnyis la'ang yod du rung ngo*/ / des na dug gsum lam byed kyi dbye ba'i skabs 'dir/ lha sku zhi khro'i rnam 'gyur dang*/ rigs lnga las gang du gtogs pa'i sgo nas mi 'jog gi gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i lam ston tshul cung zad tsam mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas 'jog ste/ de yang las dang po pa 'jug sgo'i lam gyi skabs su mi 'dra ba yin gyi/

ye shes la dbang ba nas gzung mi 'dra ba ye med cing*/ de'i sngon ye shes phebs pa nas kyang phal cher mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ / de ltar na bya rgyud dang rtog pa'i rgyud so sor phye ba'i/ rgyud sde lnga ltar na rnal 'byor chen po dang*/ rnal 'byor pha ma so sor phye ba'i rgyud sde lnga ltar na/ rnal 'byor bla ma'i rgyud dang*/ kun khyab yongs su grags pa'i rgyud sde bzhi ltar na/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi nang tshan thabs kyi rgyud 'di la/ 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ gti mug gi rigs dang*/ zhe sdang gi rigs te gsum mo/ / dang po ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ rdo rje 'phreng ba dang*/ rdo rje snying rgyan dang*/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyi ma dang*/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa rnams rang dbang can gyi rgyud yin la/ dgongs pa lung ston dang*/ lha mo bzhis zhus dang*/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa rnams ni spyir yongs su tshang ba yod na/ rang rkang gi rgyud yan lag yongs su rdzogs pa yin mod kyang*/ da lta rgya bod na yod pa 'di rnams ni/ dogs gcod dang*/ zab don gtan la 'bebs byed dum bu re tsam logs su phyung pa yin gyi/ skal ldan gyi gang zag gcig gi cha rkyen rdzogs pa ma yin te/ lha dang*/ sngags dang*/ bskyed rim dang*/ dbang bskur dang*/ las tshogs dang*/ dngos grub rab 'byams sogs gang yang mi ston pa'i phyir ro/ / yang 'dus pa la sogs pa rgyud 'di dag ni dbang gi gnas skabs dang*/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi rgyu'i gnas skabs dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub rnams la/ dngos sam yid kyis sgom pa'i rig ma la brten nas gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba lam byed rtsal du 'don pa'i phyir chags can rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyud ces bya'o/ / gti mug gi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khri drug pa lta bu yin yang*/

da lta bod du 'gyur ba ni/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa nyid yin te/ 'di las gti mug gi gnyen por stong pa nyid dang*/ rten 'brel dang*/ rnam par rig pa'i de nyid dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rnam pa thams cad pa dang*/ bde ba chen po sogs 'gal 'dus skyon med rnams dang*/ byang phyogs phar phyin sogs gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rab tu dbye ba mtha' yas pa ston cing*/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i sgo nas/ blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par byed pa'i thabs zhu ba gtso bor ston pa dang*/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ gti mug gi gnyen po rnam par mi rtog pa rnam pa thams cad pa'i lam kho na ston/ gti mug can rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyud ces bya yi/ chags lam phal pa dang*/ mngon spyod gtso bor mi ston pa'i phyir/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gi rigs zhes mi bya'o/ / zhe sdang gi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa'am/ 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa la sogs pa yin mod kyang*/ bod du 'gyur ba ni 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa la sogs pa'o/ / 'di dag ni dbang bskur ba dang*/ rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi bskyed rim bsgom pa'i skabs nas kyang*/ mngon spyod kyi las kyi rten 'brel khyad par can sgrig cing*/ mngon spyod nyid la gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi dag pa rdzogs pa dang*/ drag las la brten nas phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi rten 'brel mtha' dang sgrig pa'i thabs ston pa dang*/ mngon spyod nyid tshogs gsog pa'i thabs mchog tu ston pa'i phyir/ zhe sdang can rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyud ces bya'o/ / spyir gsang sngags yin pas chags lam ston/ bye brag tu nang pa'am bla med yin pas/ gnyis sprod kyi chags lam nyid dbang dang*/ rim gnyis dang*/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang*/

nye rgyu'i skabs kun tu ci rigs par dgos pa tsam gzhir bcas shing*/ der ma zad dngos grub mchog la gzhol ba'i skabs su/ sgrub pa pos nyams su blang bya'i lag len gyi rim pa la/ gsang 'dus la sogs pa de dag dang*/ phyi ma 'di gnyis la 'dod chags chen po lam byed shas che chung gi khyad par yang gtad nas med mod kyi/ mchod pa dang*/ dbang bskur dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la sogs pa'i skabs su cho ga'i yan lag phra mo mang po zhig dang*/ ril lu la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub tshul gyi skabs mang por/ 'dod chags lam byed dngos su dgos mi dgos kyi khyad par chen po yod cing*/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan tshig zin la'ang*/ 'dod chags lam byed rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par cher yod do/ / de bzhin du cha shas kyis na/ gti mug dang*/ zhe sdang lam byed gsang 'dus sogs las kyang mang du gsungs mod kyi/ 'phros don dang*/ yan lag tsam yin la/ phyi ma 'di dag tu gti mug dang*/ zhe sdang lam byed lam gyi gtso bor byed cing*/ lhag par rtsal du 'don pa'i phyir/ rgyud kyi tshig zin la yang khyad che zhing*/ sgrub pa nyams len gyi sgo nas kyang*/ gti mug lam byed rgyas pa dang*/ zhe sdang lam byed rgyas pa bsgom dgos mi dgos kyi khyad yod do/ / bod phal cher gyi blo la zhe sdang lam byed kyi go ba/ lha khro bo dang*/ mngon spyod kyi las ci rigs ston pa las/ gzhan go ba gang yang ma shar 'dug cing*/ 'dod chags lam byed kyang las rgya bsten tshul tsam las go ba gzhan ma shar ba dang*/ kha cig gti mug lam byed med zer ba dang*/ phal cher zhig kyang gnyid dang rmi lam gyi gdams ngag lta bu nye tshe ba'am/ stong rkyang bsgom pa tsam las gti mug lam byed la gzhan go ba mi snang ste/ de tsam gyis ni don 'di dag dpyis phyin go bar mi snang ngo*/ / spyir gsang sngags kyi rgyud mtha' dag chags lam yin par 'jog pa'i skabs yod la/

de las kyang 'di dag thams cad spyir 'dod chags chen po'i lam ston byed yin pas/ 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi rgyud yin kyang de'i nang sel la ltos nas gsum du phye ba yin pa dper na rigs chen rigs chung gi dbye ba dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ / des rigs mtshon nas lam dngos gzhi bsgom tshul 'dod chags kyi rigs yin mnyam la yang*/ lha'i rigs kyi dbye ba sogs 'byed tshul dang*/ dbye sgo gzhan gyi sgo nas/ dug lnga lam byed sogs kyi dbye ba byed na ni mi 'gal lo/ / bod kyi phyogs 'dir sngon dgra gdong 'jigs gsum la/ nag 'jigs skor gsum zhes ming 'dogs shing*/ bshad bka' stabs gcig tu byed pa mang du byung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba ni de'i steng du gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud bsnan nas/ nag po skor bzhi zhes tha snyad mdzad kyang*/ rjes 'jug dar rgyas chung bas yig snar 'khod pa cher med pa 'dra'o/

/ phyis gshed dmar gyi skor 'gyur ba nas bzung ste/ dgra nag gdong drug gnyis la nag po zhes gcig tu sdom ste/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum zhes tha snyad 'dogs shing*/ chos skor chab gcig tu sgrig pa sems pa dag byung ngo*/ / 'on kyang nag po skor gsum dang*/ gshed dmar le'u bcu dgu pa ni pha rgyud yin la/ gshed dmar le'u nyer gnyis pa ni ma rgyud yin pas/ pha ma'i rgyud so sor gnas pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed rnam rgyal spyod rgyud yin zhing*/ gzhan rnams bla med yin pas rgyud sde'i dbye ba khyad che ba dang*/ dgra nag gdong drug gshed dmar le'u bcu dgu pa rnams 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi rgyud yin zhing*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rnams zhe sdang gi rigs kyi rgyud yin pas/ las dang po pa'i lam rim mi 'dra ba'i phyir/ chos skor 'di dag rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrig dgos pa dang*/ gcig gis gcig la nges par kha 'gengs dgos pa dang*/ nges par rgyas 'gebs byed dgos pa ni ma yin no/ / de las kyang khyad par du bod pa 'ga' zhiganag po skor gsum las dgra nag rtsa ba'i rgyud yin/ de'i bshad rgyud gzhan gnyis yin te/ gdong drug ni 'khrul 'khor gsal byed yin/ 'jigs byed las tshogs gsal byed yin zhes sam/ drag las bsal byed yin zhes zer ba ni/ pho tshod tsam mam/ thos thos bon du khyer bar zad kyi/ rgyud kyi glegs bam zhib mor bklags pa tsam yang ma byas pa'o/ / de'i rgyu mtshan rgyud 'di dag rtsa bshad du 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan yang med la/ rtsa bshad yin no zhes khungs dang ldan pa sus kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ gdong drug las 'khor lo ston byed kyi tshig rgyas po med cing*/ de'i 'khrul 'khor dang*/ dgra nag gi 'khrul 'khor gnyis shin tu mi 'dra ba'i phyir/ gdong drug gi rgyud dgra nag gi 'khrul 'khor gsal byed du ji ltar rung*/ rtog bdun las/

las tshogs kyi rnam grangs mang po gsungs mod/ rtog bdun las kyang dgra nag las tshogs mang la/ mngon spyod kyi las la rnam grangs rtog bdun mang du chug kyang*/ mngon spyod kyi cho ga'i rim pa dgra nag rgyas pa'i phyir dang*/ dgra nag dang 'jigs byed 'khrul 'khor gcig par 'dod pa dang*/ tha dad du 'dod pa lugs gnyis 'dug kyang*/ tha dad 'dod pa ltar na ni gcig gi gsal byed du cig shos gang rung zhing*/ gcig par 'dod pa ltar na yang 'khrul 'khor de rtog bdun du gsal po med la/ dgra nag tu gsal ba'i phyir/ rtsa bshad go bzlog par thal bar 'gyur ro/ khyed dag slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i 'grel pa dang*/ dgra nag gi 'grel pa shān ti pas mdzad zer ba tshad mar byed par 'dug na/ de gnyis ka las dgra nag dang 'jigs byed cha mthun gyi rgyud du bshad pa'i phyir/ khyed dag la gnod byed yin no/ / des na lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ las tshogs la sogs pa'i skabs phal cher du/ gcig gi don bshad byar bzhag nas cig shos kyis 'chad pa'i tshul du med de/ so so rang rkang btsugs pa'i tshul du 'chad pa yin pas/ rtsa bshad du sbyor rgyu ni ma yin par nges la/ lha sngags cho ga sogs phan tshun 'dra min mang po yod pa'i phyir/ cha mthun du byas na don la 'gal ba cher ma mthong mod/ rigs so so'i rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ nag 'jigs gnyis cha mthun gyi tha snyad mi 'dod la/ dgra gdong gnyis po ni cha mthun du rung ngo*/ / gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud la khyad par gyi 'dra chos du ma 'dug kyang*/ rgyud sde'i mtho dman che mtha'i phyir cha mthun gyi rgyud du mi 'jog mod/ phan tshun kha 'gengs ni rung ste/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs sems dpa' bsdus pa bzhin no/ / gzhan yang gdong drug 'jigs byed gnyis kyis/ gang bshad par bya ba'i rtsa rgyud de/ nges par dgra nag yin na gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa yang*/

gdong 'jigs gnyis kyi bshad bya'i rtsa rgyud du thal bar 'gyur te/ dgra nag rtsa rgyud du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin pa thams cad/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud de la'ang tshang ba'i phyir ro/ / de yang khas len na gdong 'jigs gnyis la rtsa rgyud gnyis su thal bar 'gyur ro/ / de ltar na yang*/ bla ma'i man ngag gis rtsa bshad kyi tshul du sbyor ba ni mi 'gal ba cig kyang srid mod kyi/ 'dir ni rtog bdun dang gdong drug la dgra nag gi rgyud nas tshur kha bskang na nyer mkho mang zhing*/ 'di gnyis nas dgra nag la phar kha 'gengs dgos shin tu nyung ba'i phyir dang*/ gdong drug dang rtog bdun gnyis po'i dbang du byas na'ang*/ gdong drug nas rtog bdun la kha bskang na nyer mkho mang zhing*/ rtog bdun gyis phar kha 'gengs dgos shin tu nyung ngo*/ / ci ste rtsa bshad du mi sbyor kha med kyi u tshugs rang byed na/ dgra nag la gzhan gnyis po bshad rgyud 'dra mtshungs su mi 'byor gyi/ rtog bdun la gzhan gnyis po bshad rgyud 'dra mtshungs su 'byor ba'i phyir/ man ngag gi rim pas rjes mthun pa'i dbang du byas kyang*/ nag po rtsa rgyud kyi tshul dang*/ gzhan gnyis bshad rgyud kyi tshul du 'jog pa mi rigs so/ / de ltar na gshin rje gshed rnam rgyal kyi rgyud smos ma dgos/ nag 'jigs skor gsum/ dmar po'i rgyud gnyis te/ lnga po 'di dag kyang*/ gcig la gcig ma ltos par rang rkang tshugs pa'i rgyud re re yin par shes par bya'o/ / rgyud gang la yang rtsa bshad kyi rgyud ni ltos pa can zhes bya ste/ rtsa rgyud ni phar bshad rgyud la nges par ltos pa min yang*/ bshad rgyud yin phyin chad rang rang gi rtsa ba'i rgyud la nges par ltos dgos so/ / cha mthun gyi rgyud ni gnyis ka phan tshun du cha mthun pa tsam yin gyi/ gcig la gcig ltos dgos pa ma yin no/ / gsum pa ni/ de la rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di dag gi brjod bya ston tshul rags pa ni 'di ltar yod de/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud ni/ dang por gleng gzhi ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor tshogs rgyas par bstan/ gleng bslang ba 'khor tshogs rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas phyag na rdo rje la bos te gsungs/ de nas rgyu rdo rje 'dzin bskyed chog dang*/ yi ge bcu bdun chung ba dang*/ lha bcu bdun gyi mngon rtogs dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'byin pa'i sngags rnams gsungs te/ mngon rtogs kyi rim pa phye ba ste dang po'o// //de nas le'u gnyis pa ni/ tshigs bcad lngas bstod pa dang*/ skye mched byin rlabs dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba rnams so/ / le'u gsum pa las sa chog gi gsol btab dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ba dang*/ ye shes dgug gzhug dang*/ gtso bo lnga'i gdan dang*/ las bzhi'i lha bsgom tshul dang*/ mig sman la sogs pa dngos grub 'ga' zhig gsungs so/ / bzhi pa las zhu tshig sngon du 'gro bas/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang sdud/ dgug pa/ rengs pa/ ngag gnon/ bsad pa'i las rnams gsungs/ lnga pa las/ dbye ba dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ de rnams kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi go rim mo/ / drug pa las/ gsol ba btab pa dang*/ rig bdag dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ dbang gi grangs dang*/ gtor chog dang*/ 'khrul 'khor la sngags 'god tshul lo/ / bdun pa las/ yum bzhi'i las sbyor dang*/ dbang bskur tshig dang*/ dgug pa la sogs pa'i sbyor ba ci rigs pa'o/ / brgyad pa las/ bka'i 'khor lo bka' bsgo dang*/ sa lha sta gon dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ dbang bskur gyi gsol btab dang*/ stong nyid sogs sngags gsum dang*/ las bzhi'i sbyin bsreg gi khyad par bstan to/ / dgu pa las/ char 'bebs dang*/ mtsho rlabs rengs pa dang*/ lha mthong ba dang*/ sbrul gyis zin pa gso ba dang*/ mgo bor zug gzer sel ba dang*/ rbod stong gis bsad pa dang*/ dgra bo 'khyams par byed pa ste/

las phra mo bdun gsungs so/ / bcu pa las/ ro langs bsgrub pa/ sgo skyong bzhi'i mngon rtogs/ mkha' nang gi dkyil 'khor spro ba/ sgo ba dang lha mo'i gdan/ rjes dran sgom pa'o/ / bcu gcig pa las/ lha dgu'i dag pa/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i bya ba/ phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa/ phyag ba rgya pa'i sgrub thabs/ dbyug 'dzin gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs/ phyag bye ba'i sgrub thabs/ dam tshig gi sgrub thabs/ bdud rtsi bsten pa rnams so/ / bcu gnyis pa las/ yum bzhis bstod pa'i glu/ bzlas pa dang*/ bgrang phreng dang*/ gdon tshar bcad pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i tshad dang*/ gtor ma'i bya ba dang*/ zas phud 'bul ba/ yon 'bul ba rnams so/ / bcu gsum pa las/ dang por rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma lha bcu gsum/ 'di yum bka'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yin/ de nas gnod mdzes lha bcu gsum gyis sa 'og bsgrub/ rta mchog lha bcu gsum gyis mkha' spyod sgrub pa'o/ / bcu bzhi pa las/ thig gi bya ba/ slob ma gzhug pa/ thig gi bya ba'i 'phros/ gsol ba btab pa/ sa'i bya ba/ thig gi cha dbye ba/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa/ rdul tshon dgye ba/ dgang blugs kyi tshad/ ye shes dbab pa/ sku gzugs kyi cha tshad tshon dang bcas pa/ ral gcig ma bcu gsum ma dang*/ pukka sī rkyang pa dang*/ mi snang ba sgrub pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs so/ / bco lnga pa las/ dug sel ma lha bcu gsum/ ku ru kulle phyag brgyad gtso rkyang*/ lus med rdo rje lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs so/ / bcu drug pa las/ mchog gi dngos grub kyi don du he ru ka lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs so/ / bcu bdun pa las/ gtso bo bskyed pa/ zhu ba glus bskul/ bskul nas bzhes pa/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i ngos 'dzin/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi sogs dam tshigargyud kyi che brjod/ rdzogs rim don dam byang chub kyi sems rnams gsungs/

le'u bco brgyad pas rgyud gsungs pas gtam rgyud kyi tshul gyis phyag na rdo rje la bka' bsgos pa'o/ / 'di la dngos su dkyil 'khor dgu yod de/ gshin rje gshed dang mkha' 'gro ma/ / gnod mdzes rta mchog ral gcig ma/ / 'jam rdor dug sel lus med dang*/ / he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor ro/ / pukka sī dang rig byed ma/ / dpa' mo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ / zhes so/ / rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di ni nyi zla ltar grags pa yin la/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i gshin rje gshed skor shes par 'dod pa dag gis/ rgyud 'di la nges pa 'jug par bya ste/ 'di'i don la nges pa phyin ci ma log pa rnyed na/ gshed skor gzhan rnams kyang 'bad med du rtogs par nus so/ / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud kyi le'u dang po las/ lha lnga'i mngon rtogs rgyas par gsungs shing*/ rdzogs rim cung zad bshad/ le'u drug pa/ bdun pa/ brgyad pa/ dgu pa'i stod rnams su/ bcud len dang*/ mngag gzhug sgrub pa la sogs pa/ las tshogs dang dngos grub mang du gsungs/ le'u bcu gcig pa nas gtor chog rgyas par bstan/ le'u tha mar gtam rgyud kyi rjes su 'pho ba dang*/ grong 'jug gsungs/ de rnams lhag po yin/ gzhan le'u'i tshad 'jog tshul dang*/ go rim mi 'dra zhing*/ 'gyur mi gcig pa ma gtogs/ nag po'i rgyud dang tshig don gnyis ka la khyad par med pa las/ phran tshegs 'don pa bsgyur ba lta bu yin/ 'di la le'u bcu dgu yod/ dkyil 'khor gyi grangs kyang gzhan rnams dgra nag dang 'dra ba las/ gshin rje gshed la lha lnga dang bcu gsum ma gnyis su dbye ste bcu'o/ / de yang le'u dang po las lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bshad cing*/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i skabs dang*/ snga phyi'i tshig rigs gung bsgrigs pa la bcu gsum ma ste/ gnyis byung ba gnyis kar rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor yin par grags kyang*/

gshed dmar gyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ni lha lnga nyid do/ / gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud le'u nyer gnyis yod pa de ni/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud yin par bshad pas skabs 'dir rgyas par mi 'chad mod/ 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa cho ga'i rim pa rnams ni/ dmar nag spyi dang phal cher mthun la/ las tshogs dang*/ chags lam gyi skor rnams mi g.yo ba bla med dang tshig rigs gcig pa shas che/ rdzogs rim dang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes gsal rgyas su bstan cing*/ dbu ma rten 'brel snying po zhes bod na grags pa'i gzhung chung 'di yang*/ rgyud 'di'i nang nas bton pa lta bur snang ngo*/ / gshin rje gshed nag po gdong drug pa'i rgyud ni/ le'u'i dbye ba med/ sdom che 'bring chung gsum gyi brjod bya'i don rnams bsdus pas/ rgyud sdom gsum par grags so/ / rgyud rang gi dngos ming ni/ gshin rje gshed nag po 'khor lo'i las thams cad grub par byed pa'i rgyud ces bya'o/ / de yang gleng gzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ gti mug rdo rje la sogs pa'i 'khor gyi dbus su/ rdo rje ro langs mas bdud 'dul ba'i thabs zhus/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ting nge 'dzin sngon du mdzad nas snying po gsungs shing*/ gshin rje gshed zhal drug pa'i skur bsgyur/ sngags rnams gsungs pas bdud rnams thams cad skrag ste/ de dag ni gleng bslang ba'o/ / de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mngon rtogs dang*/ lha nyi shu'i sngags dang*/ thig gdab pa dang*/ mtshan ma 'god pa dang*/ mchod pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin rlabs/ skye mched byin rlabs/ bdud rtsi myang ba/ phyogs mtshon dang*/ rtsig pa'i rim pa/ tshad med bzhi/ stong pa nyid bsgom tshul/ srung 'khor/ chos 'byung*/ dam tshig ldan pa'i sgrub pa po la bsngags pa rnams gsungs/ de nas mtshams der lha mos gsol ba btab nas re mig zhe dgu pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'bri tshul/ rmi lam gyi rtags/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs/

gzhal yas khang*/ lha'i gdan/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dgug gzhugadakyil 'khor mchod pa/ dam tshig bstan pa/ re mig la yi ge 'god tshul/ 'khor lo 'bri dus kyi bya ba'i rim pa 'khor lo'i phan yon rnams gsungs so/ / yang zhu ba zhus te/ 'khor lo 'bri ba'i gnas/ gzhug pa'i gnas/ dkri ba'i skud pa/ kha blta phyogs/ mchod pa 'bul tshul/ ting nge 'dzin dang sngags kyi bskul tshig tha dad pa'i sgo nas/ zhi ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ bsad pa dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ rims kyis thebs pa dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ dgug pa dang*/ mi snang ba dang*/ chu la mi bying ba dang*/ mtshon cha bsrung ba dang*/ mkha' la 'gro ba rnams gsungs/ yang zhus nas/ sdom tshig dang po gsungs/ de rjes/ ting nge 'dzin sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor chog dang*/ bstod pa dang*/

bzlas pa'i dmigs pa/ dbang gi dgos pa/ dbang bzhi'i ngo bo/ de kho na nyid bsgom tshul/ bla ma'i dam tshigarjes thob kyi bsam gtan/ 'dod yon gyi mchod pa/ dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur tshul/ 'khor lo'i bstod pa/ 'khor lo bsten tshul/ sa chogaslob ma la dbang bskur tshul/ sbyin sregadagang blugs kyi tshad/ sbyin sreg gi nges don/ drag po'i sbyin sreg rnams bshad nas/ sdom tshig bar pa gsungs/ de rjes rig ma brtag pa/ skyed rgyu'i bye braga.ā li kā li'i nges don/ sdom tshig tha ma rnams gsungs so/ / 'di la dngos bstan dkyil 'khor gcig nyid gsungs/ rgyud 'di zhal gsal zhing*/ gsang sngags spyi'i go ba dang*/ gshed skor nang du'ang nyer mkho mang ba zhig snang ngo*/ / de dag ni gong du smos pa ltar/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i gshed skor gyi nang nas/ 'dod chags chen po'i rigs kyi rgyud yin mod/ rgya bod gnyis kar du nag 'jigs phan tshun kha skong ba shas che zhing*/ bod yul 'dir sngon dgra gdong 'jigs gsum dang*/ phyis dmar nag 'jigs gsum zhes grags shing*/ phal cher phan tshun du kha skong bar byed do/ de ltar legs pa'ang yin/ lha dang*/ sngags dang*/ cho ga'i rim pa rnams cha mthun 'dra mtshungs yod pa'i phyir dang*/ chos rgyun rnams kyang 'brel chags su gnas pa mang du mthong ba'i phyir dang*/ rgyud ni rgyud gzhan las shes par gsungs pa'i yang phyir ro/ khyad par can gyi gshin rje gshed/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud ni zhe sdang chen po'i rgyud ces bya ste/ bla ma gong ma rnams 'di la'ang rgyud rgyas pa 'bum par bzhed pa dang*/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i gsung las/ rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug par gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon rdo rje grub pa ni/ rgyud rgyas pa stong phrag bco brgyad pa zhig yod ces gsungs pa thams cad mi 'gal mod/

gtso bor sems dpa' chen po'i gsung la yid rton no/ / da lta'i rtog pa bdun pa 'di ni/ shlau ka sum brgya'i tshad du gnas pa yin zhes grags so/ / de'i phyir rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa sum brgya pa zhes pa yang 'di kho na yin gyi/ le'u sum brgya pa yin nam sems pa dag ni 'khrul lo/ / 'di la gleng gzhi ni med de/ bshad par zhal gyis bzhes shing dgos pa bstan nas/ gnas kyi dbye ba dang*/ 'bras bu las dang dngos grub dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ sgrub chen rnams bstan te/ rtog pa dang po'o/ / gnas dang dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang*/ mchod pa bstan pas dbang bskur gyi dkyil 'khor bri sgrub dang*/ nye bsnyen dang*/ sgrub pa sgrub chen gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad bstan mod/ gtso bor nye bsnyen no/ / rgyud 'di bskyed rim dang las tshogs gtso bor ston cing*/ thun mong gi dngos grub rnams kyang cho ga gcig gis bsgrub pa'i lugs yin pas/ rtog pa dang po 'di'i lag len dang*/ go don phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa gal che ba zhig ste/ 'on kyang phal cher gyis dngos bstan tsam 'di go bla bar bzung nas/ don gyi khog sgrig tshul ma shes par snang ste/ rgyud 'di'i lam rim gyi khog pa rnams le'u dang po 'di las rtogs dgos pa go bar gyis shigartog pa gnyis pa las ni/ las tshogs bshad par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang*/ mngon brjod gtso bor bstan pa dang*/ rkyang pa'i 'khor lo ga'u bsro ba'i las dang*/ rims kyis thebs pa dang*/ sbags pa'i 'khor lo sba ba'i las dang*/ 'khor lo de nyid gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba la brten pa ste/ 'khrul 'khor gyi bsad las gtso bo gsum dang phyi ma gnyis la slar rjes su 'dzin pa'ang gsungs/ de rjes byi ba dug can gyi sbyor bas rengs pa gcigadabye ba gcigabaskrad pa gsum/ yang dbye ba'i rnam grangs gnyis/

sbyin sreg gis bsad pa gcigayang bskrad pa dang rengs pa re re/ dbang sdud gciga'agugs pa gcigasmyor gzhug pa/ 'khor lo bsreg pa'i sgo nas bsad pa/ yang dbye ba gcigayan lag mtshon gyis 'bugs pa dang*/ bu mo rengs par byed pa gcig rnams gsungs te/ spyir na bsad las drugabaskrad pa lnga/ dbye ba bzhi/ rims kyis bzung ba/ rengs pa/ mnan pa/ dbang*/ dgugasmyo ba/ bu mo rengs pa rnams bstan par 'dod do/ / de rjes las sgrub pa gsang dgos pa dang*/ gang la bya ba'i yul dang*/ bsam pa bstan pa dang*/ mngon spyod gzu lum du mi bya bar rgyud gzhan gyi lung drangs pa rnams yod do/ / rtog pa gsum pa las/ mtshams sbyor dang*/ sngags btu'i gnas dang*/ 'thu ba po dang*/ rtsa sngags btu ba de'i che ba dang*/ grangs tshad/ snying po btu ba dang*/ che ba dang grangs tshad/ las sngags 'thu ba dang che ba dang grangs tshad sngags btu'i bsam pa dang cho ga ming tsam gsungs so/ / rtog pa bzhi pa las ni/ bdag bskyed kyi sgrub thabs bsnyen pa'i cho ga gtso bor gyur pa gsungs te/ le'u'i 'jug gi cha nas/ thun mtshams kyi spyod pa dang*/ gnas dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ rtsa sngags kyi bzlas pa'i grangs dang*/ phan yon rnams gsungs so/ / rtog pa lnga pa las ni/ 'tshams sbyor sngon du 'gro bas/ ras gzhi dang*/ ri mo mkhan gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ yon sbyin pa dang*/ sku gzugs ji ltar 'bri ba dang*/ bzhugs pa'i gnas dang*/ bris sku mchod pa rnams gsungs so/ / rtog pa drug pa las ni/ mtshams sbyor ba sngon du 'gro bas/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gi gnas bstan to/ / de rjes bsad pa gnyis/ dbye ba gnyis/ bskrad pa gcig¿rengs pa gcigagrong bskrad pa/ las bsgrub pa la sgrims pa dang*/ gsang dgos par bstan pa/ bu mo rengs pa'i sbyor ba/ zhi ba'i sbyin sregargyas pa'i sbyin sregadagug pa'i sbyin sregasmyo ba dang*/ rdzas chud gsan pa gnyis slar gso ba dang bcas pa/ yul phyogs dbang du byed pa/

de mi nyams par gnas pa'i thabs/ nor dbang du byed pa/ rgyal po 'khor bcas dbang du byed pa/ skyes pa dbang du byed pa/ bud med dbang du byed pa/ yang bskrad las gnyis/ dbang sdud dang dgug pa re re rnams gsungs te/ thams cad sbyin sreg gi las 'ba' zhig go / de rjes bye brag mi bya ba dang*/ gcig pus bsgrub par bshad do/ /rtog pa tha ma bdun pa las ni/ bshad par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang*/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ ye shes khro bo'i bsam gtan gyis bsad pa/ pho nya gtum po'i sbyor bas bsad pa/ dbye ba'i bsam gtan gcigabaskrad pa'i bsam gtan gnyis/ dgug pa'i bsam gtan gcigadug gso ba'i bsam gtan/ zhu ba'i bsam gtan/ rgyal po sogs dbang du byed pa'i bsam gtan rnams gsungs nas/ las thams cad mnyam par bzhag cing brtul zhugs brtan pas bsgrub dgos pa dang*/ rgyud sngags cho ga bris sku rnams shin tu gsang dgos pa dang*/ slob ma mchog mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la ston pa dang*/ gzhan la bka' rgyas btab pa rnams gsungs so/ / 'di rgyud rgyas pa'i dum bu logs su phyung ba bkol ba dum bu'i rgyud du bzhed pa dang*/ snying po'i don phyung ba'i bsdus rgyud du bzhed pa dang*/ rgyud rgyas pa'i 'jug thogs su gsungs pas phyi ma'i rgyud lta bur 'dod pa ste/ 'dod tshul gsum yod kyang*/ bar ba ltar 'thad de/ bsdus rgyud nyid yin par sems so/ / yang 'di'i 'jug tu bla ma dam pa dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon/ la li ta badzras phyung nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ / zhes 'byung bas/ rgyud rgyas pa las la li ta badzra gyis mthus pa yin pas dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos so zhes rgya bal 'ga' zhig 'dod skad kyang*/ de ni mi 'thad de/ rgya gar gyi rtsom pa bstan bcos tshad ldan la rgyud kyi rnam par byas pa mi 'byung bas so/ / la li ta badzra gyis phyung zhes pa ni/ rgyud rgyas pa las 'thus rgyud byas pa'i don min/

des rdo rje'i gnas o rgyan nas spyan drangs zhes pa'i don yin no/ / rtog pa bdun pa 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i rgyud yin la/ mtha' na glegs bam bzhugs pa tsam la'ang byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'gran zla med pa zhig go / yang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bzhi pa bya ba cig kyang yod de/ de dang rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i rtog pa dang*/ mi g.yo ba phyag brgya pa'i rtog pa rnams/ mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur ba yod/ de rnams 'ga' zhig brtsam brgyud du 'dod la/ kha cig mar dos bsgyur zer yang*/ mar do'i mtshan gyi mtha' la grags pa'i ming med pas/ lo tsā ba gzhan zhig yin la/ rgyud le'u bzhi pa 'di la/ der ma zad thar los 'gyur bcos kyang mdzad do/ zhes grag go / rtog pa gcig pa gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa zhes bya ba ni/ sngon gyi skyo pa rnams rgyud rnam dag tu byed la/ phyis kyi mkhas pa rnams 'di rdzun rgyud yin te/ srog snying phul ba'i skabs na/ btsan gyi ca cos sogs sde brgyad kyang bod ma'am bon lugs su byung ba dang*/ dza la tsa btus pa shin du ma dag pa'i phyir ro gsung yang*/ 'di'i dpe rnying pa rang 'ga' re na/ tshig de dag mi snang bas/ gshin rje ya phul ma mos ma/ / zhes sogs tshigs bcad de/ rang bzo mkhan gyis lhad du bcug par mngon pas/ rtog pa dngos de rang rnam dag ka yin par mngon/ sgrol ba'i gying du byin gyis brlabs/ / zhes pa ni/ bsod byed pho nyar byin gyis brlabs/ / zhes pa'i don la 'gyur khyad tsam yin pas gsal lo/ / rtog pa gsum pa'i rgyud 'di ni/ rwa bod kyi dkar chag tshigs bcad ma na/ dgra nag gi chos skor du bgrangs la/ kha cigasngags kyi rgyal po bcu pa yang*/ / zhes 'byung bas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis kyi bshad rgyud yin zer/ 'on kyang de tsam la nges pa med pas/ gshin rje gshed spyi la 'gro ba'i chos skor yin zhing*/

bskyed rim sgrub thabs sogs logs pa med pas/ gsang sngags la nyer mkho rab gnas kyi rgyud sogs dang 'dra bar/ gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i man ngag gi rgyud dam/ rgyud rgyas pa cig las phyung ba'i bkol ba dum bu'i rgyun yin pa yang srid do/ / 'di ni lo tsā ba rong zom chos bzang gi 'gyur yin la/ lo tsā ba gzhan dang gzhan gyi 'gyur yin zer ba'i/ 'gyur byang btab pa 'dra yod na'ang*/ gzhung gi ngo bo la 'gyur bcos pa cung zad kyang med do/ / bu ston chen po'i rgyud sde spyi rnam na/ rtog gsum dang gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa skyo ba rnams rgyud du 'dod do/ / zhes rgyud min gyu ba byung ba la brten nas/ ngor pa rnams blo gsar pa skyes te/ rtog gsum rgyud ma yin/ rgya gar ba cig gis brtsams sam/ bod mkhas pa cig gis byas mi shes te/ bstan bcos rnam dag ni yin/ de yang skyo ba'i lugs la yod/ rwa la med ces zer ro/ / rgyud rnam dag ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad rgyu ni gcig kyang med pas/ khye spaugs gang yang med pa'i chos spong gi las dam bca' skam po cig tu zad la/ yang bstan bcos rnam dag tu 'dod pa dang*/ khungs med sus byas tsam yang cha med par 'dod pa 'di yang 'gal ba ltag sprod yin la/ res 'ga' 'di skyo ba'i sngags pa cig gis brtsams pa yin yang zer te/ de lta na bstan bcos rnam dag zer ba yang 'ja' tshon ltar yal lo/ khyed dag gnyos rwa mar do sogs lo tsā ba dngos kyis byas pa'i bstan bcos rnams kyang ma dag par 'dod bzhin du skyo ba'i sngags pa su yin med pa zhig gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos shin tu rnam par dag par 'dod pa yang*/ ches bzhad gad kyi gnas yin zhing*/ yang kha cig 'di skad ces/ yang na blun po dad pa brtan/ / de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub nye/ / rtog cing dpyod pa'i rtog ge ba/ / de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub ring*/ / zhes 'byung bas/

rgya gzhung min zhes zer te/ rgyu mtshan can gyi 'brel ni ci yang med do/ / de'i don tha snyad la blun yang*/ dad pa dang ldan pa la dngos grub nye ba dang*/ tha snyad mkhas kyang rtog ges dpyod pa la dngos grub ring zhes pa yin pas/ de ni gsang sngags spyi'i lugs yin na mi 'thad pa ci zhig yod/ tshig shin tu kha gsal bas bod ma yin snyam na/ mdo sde rnams dang*/ grub thob rnams kyi gzhung klogs shigazhal shin tu gsal ba mtha' yas te/ khyod kyi log rtog sel bar 'gyur ro/ / tshig la brjid bag med pa'i phyir/ bod ma'o snyam na rtog gsum ni tshig brjid bag dang ldan pa kho na yin pas skyon de med la/ spyir ni tshig rngam brjid che chung lo tsā ba'i 'gyur khyad pa yin pas/ de tsam gang gi yang rgyu mtshan du mi rung zhing*/ khyed kyis ni tshig brjid bag che chung yang nyams kyis mi chod cing ngo ma shes par snang ngo*/ / yang khyed kyi ngor thal ba'i skad 'phang ste/ lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang yang bod rtsom yin par thal te/ dga' la g.yang za/ ngo tshal skrug bro zhes dang*/ 'dod yon sna tshogs mthong bas rgod bro/ zhes sogs tshig brjid bag chung zhing mi mdzes pa du ma 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ / des na rgya gzhung bstan bcos rnam dag dang*/ rgyud tshig gnyis la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ji ltar yod/ de gnyis dang*/ bod rtsom la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gang 'dra yod/ bod rtsom bstan bcos rnam dag dang*/ rnam dag ma yin pa gnyis la/ tshig sbyor gyi khyad par ji lta bu yod/ zhes dris na gsal te/ rdzun dang tshod dpogs 'ba' zhig gis phyugs kyi skye bo'i tshogs pa rnams dang*/ mtshan nyid mkhas por rlom pa'i nyams med ko long dam po rnams mgo bskor ba lhur len pa las/ dkar po'i chos gcig kyang ma 'dres pa'i spyod pa'o/ / spros pas chog go /gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa 'di ni/ rgyud rgyas pa'i nang nas la li tas bkol ba yin pas/

rgyud kyi rnam grangs yin zhing*/ gshin rje gshed spyi khyab kyi cha lag tu sbyor/ tshu tshun dha ri'i cho ga zhib mo dang*/ te'u lo'i rtog pa chung ba gnyis ni/ rtog bdun gyi 'phros don yin pas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kho na'i chos skor du bsdu'o/ / de dag ni spyir gsang sngags gsar ma/ de'i nang gi rnal 'byor bla med/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum du grags pa'i rgyud skor yin la/ gzhan yang dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las gshin rje gshed spyi'i 'khor lo bsgrub tshul gsal bar gsungs shing*/ gshin rje gshed kyi las tshogs 'thor bu ni/ rgyud gzhan mang po las kyang 'byung ngo*/ / yang gshin rje gshed khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud ces bya ba 'di ni/ rgyud kyi ngo bo spyod rgyud yin zhing*/ kha cig bya rgyud du 'chad mod kyang*/ 'chad tshul de bya spyod gcig tu bsre ba'i lugs yin pas rgyu mtshan du mi rung la/

'di bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su 'gyur/ 'grel pa gnyis yod kyang*/ gnyis kar bod mar snang*/ phyi dar la ba ri lo tsā bas rgyud 'di cung zad bshad cing*/ dkyil chog sogs kyang bsgyur ro/ / rgyud 'di'i le'u brgyad yan chad rtsa ba'i rtog pa/ le'u dgu pa rtog pa phyi ma/ bcu pa phyi ma'i yang phyi ma/ de nas le'u brgyad gsang ba'i rtog pa dang po zhes bya/ de bzhin du gsang ba'i rtog pa lnga'i bar du yod/ de yang le'u bcu gcig pa sogs bdun kha skong gi le'u yin la/ bco brgyad pa sogs gsang rtog lnga po ni/ rnam grangs gzhan gyi sgo nas bstan pa'o/ / rgyud 'dir bsnyen sgrub rim pa bzhi'i sgo nas/ dngos grub bsgrub tshul shin tu mang bar gsungs shing*/ dngos bstan dkyil 'khor drug yod de/ be chon mang po dang*/ gsal shing mang po dang*/ mdung thung mang po dang*/ mi ro mang po dang*/ thod pa mang po dang*/ dur khrod mang po'i dkyil 'khor rnams so/ / 'di ni rtog bdun dang mthun shas che zhing*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i chos skor la nye bar mkho ba yang mang du yod mod kyi/ rgyud kyi 'jug sgo tha dad pa'i phyir/ re zhig rgyas pa ma smos so/ / rgyud sde mtho dman snyoms pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dpal gshin rje gshed po'i rgyud rnams rgyud gzhan las khyad par du 'phags tshul ni/ rnam grangs mang po yod mod kyi/ gtso bor sngags 'grub sla zhing las myur bas khyad par 'phags pa yin/ de'i nang nas kyang 'khrul 'khor gyi las stobs che zhing myur la/ the tshom med par 'grub pa'i phyir khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ ji skad du/ brtul zhugs mthar thug thod pa chen po dang*/ / 'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud/ / rgyud kyi mthar thug pa ni 'dus pa ste/ / byung bar ma gyur 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes dmar nag gi rgyud gnyis ka las mgrin gcig tu gsungs so/ / thod pa chen po'i brtul zhugs ni/

nang gi rnal 'byor gyi stobs las/ kunda lta bu 'pho med du 'ching ba'i ming yin gyi/ kha cig rig pa'i brtul zhugs tsam 'chad pa la sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud mchog yin no ba'i don no/ / zhes zer ba ni/ bsam mno mgo phur gyi bshad pa'o/ / de la sngon gyi gshin rje mkhan po bod rgan rnams na re/ rgyud thams cad las las tshogs mang du gsungs kyang*/ las dang po pas 'phral du 'grub pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi las tshogs rnams nyid rang yin/ rgyud la nang gi khams che ba/ gsang 'dus/ dus 'khor/ bde mchog rnams yin te/ gsang 'dus kyi las tshogs 'grub pa la/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob dgos/ dus 'khor la rlung bum pa can grub dgos/ bde mchog la pho nya mo grub dgos/ gshin rje gshed la grangs bsnyen song na/ 'khor lo bcas chog yin zer te rgyud de rnams kyi cha rgyus rags pa yod par 'dugaphyogs 'dra rung gi gtam yin/ spyir rgyud gzhan de dag nas gsungs pa'i las tshogs rnams kyang*/ las dang po pas mi 'grub pa ta ma yin mod/ grangs bsnyen song tsam gyis ka las tshogs bsgrub na/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor nyid/ las tshogs gzhan thams cad las mchog tu gyur par tshad mas grub bo/ / spyir lha zhi ba las khro bo 'grub thag nye ba dang*/ khro rgyal gzhan las kyang gshin rje gshed nye/ khyad par du mngon spyod drag shul gyi las la/ 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i lha sngags las sbyor rnams dang mtshungs pa 'ga' yang med do/ / bzhi pa ni/ da ni rgyud de rnams ji ltar byung tshul bshad de/ dmar nag gnyis la ston pa rdo rje gdan du bzhugs te/ byang chub brnyes par bzhed pa la/ bdud kyi dmag bye ba sum cu so drug lhags pa'i tshe/ ston pa nyid gshin rje gshed po'i dkyil 'khor du bzhengs te/ bdud kyi rigs kyi lha tshogs 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad nas byang chub kyi lam la bkod de rgyud gsungs shing*/

mthar phyag na rdo rje la rgyud gtad nas/ khyod kyis kyang gshin rje gshed kyi ting nge 'dzin dang cho ga 'dis/ bdud rnams thul zhig ces gsang bdag la gdams pa'i tshul gyis/ phyi rabs rjes 'jug gi gang zag rnams la dgongs par mdzad do/ / 'di ni dmar nag gi rgyud kyi le'u tha ma las 'byung ngo*/ / gdong drug las ni/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po'i skur bzhengs nas/ ma he'i bdag po chung mar bcas pa zhabs kyi 'og tu brdzis zhes/ gshin rje'i bdag po khyo shug tshar bcad pa tsam zhig gsungs/ de yang gshin rje'i bdag po dang*/ drag po dbang phyug gcig par 'dod pa'ang yod do/ / de bzhin du gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba las/ de nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ khro bo'i ming ni gshin rje gshed/ / mtshon cha me lce 'bar ba 'khrigs/ / 'di mthong nas ni khro bo gzhan/ / thams cad kyi ni lag cha shor/ / zhes bcom ldan 'das 'jam dbyangs kyis gshin rje gshed sprul bas/ khro bo gzhan thams cad skrag pa'i ched du brjod pa sogs yod do/ / 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud la rtog bdun las/ de yis lha rnams thams cad la/ / drag shugs che zhing 'jigs par byed/ / ces pa'i tshig zur gyis cung zad tsam 'phangs pa ma gtogs/ rtog bdun las lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa med/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ri rab kyi rtse mor sku sprul nas/ gdul bya gshin rje rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen te/ lho phyogs kyi rgya mtshor phar brgal te/ gshin rje'i gnas lcags mkhar bcu drug gis bcom/ ye shes rdo rje'i ling gas dbus kyi lcags mkhar bsgyel zhing*/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po gnad nas gzir/ bdud tshogs gzhan thams cad bcom nas rmeg med par mdzad/ sde brgyad thams cad kyis srog snying phul/

mna' dor/ gshin rje dang ma mo thams cad sgrol ba'i gying pho mor byin gyis brlabs/ bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos so/ / zhes pa tsam zhig 'byung ste/ gdul bya'i gtso bo gshin rje pho mo kho nar ston pa'i lugs gcig go / yang grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gtam rwa lo chen po'i gsung rgyun las 'byung ba ni/ sngon du dpag tu med pa 'das pa'i sngon rol na/ lha dbang phyug chen po'i bu lha'i dmag dpon chen po gzhon nu gdong drug dang*/ lha mi gdol pa drag po gnyis 'dzam bu'i gling gi bdag po su byed la ma mthun nas/ yun ring du 'thabs pa las/ gdong drug ni pham/ gdol pa drag pos 'dzam gling la dbang bsgyur ba na/ lha dbang phyug chen po ri rab kyi khong seng na gnas pas de shes te/ sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa mkha' la spyod pa'i lha rnams dang*/ nad brgyad gdon brgyad sogs sa steng gi 'byung po thams cad dang*/ lha min klu la sogs pa'i sa 'og na spyod pa thams cad dmag tshogs su bskul zhing*/ drag po dbang phyug chen po nyid/ drag shul dang bcas te 'ongs pa na/ gdol pa drag po ni mgon skyabs gzhan med pas shin tu 'jigs shing skrag pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs yid la dran te/ gdong nam mkhar phyogs te skad kyi gdangs chen pos/ mtshan nas bos shing gsol ba btab pas/ phyogs der 'jam dpal mngon sum du byon pa/ gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i khro bo'i skur bzhengs pa las/ zhal gzhan brgyad kyis phyogs mtshams kyi 'jigs byed brgyad gsol bar mdzad/ rtsa zhal dang ling gas ni 'jigs byed dbang phyug chen po khros pa nyid btul/ ma he'i rwa gnyis kyis lha ma yin gyi rta ba rnams bcom/ glang lpags 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis kyis brgya byin dang*/ phyag gzhan so gnyis kyis nye dbang sum cu so gnyis tshar bcad/ zhabs g.yas brgyad kyis gdon brgyad/

g.yon brgyad kyis nad brgyad mnan/ klu rnams rgyan du bcings/ gzhan yang lha gdon ma rungs pa rnams/ la la zhal du gsol/ la la zhabs kyis mnan/ zhes dngos su 'byung la/ de'i shugs la/ gzhan yang zhal dgus gza' dgu dang*/ phyogs skyong dgu dang*/ 'jigs byed brgyad dam dgu/ zhal dgu dang*/ spyan nye bdun gyis rgyu skar rnams btul ba'ang don gyis thob bo/ / de ltar na gdug pa can gyi lha klu lha min/ 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin thams cad/ dus dang por tshar bcad cing bsgral nas/ snying khrag gsol ba la sogs pa 'jigs pa chen po bstan nas/ slar yang gso shing rjes su bzung ste ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod nas/ gdod nas grub pa dang*/ gsar du thob pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems nam mkha' gang ba'i dbus su rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa gsungs*/ rgyud rgyas pa des dus yun ring mor sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ skyes bu mtha' yas pa zhig gis dngos grub thob bo/ / de nas bar skabs su mi rnams kyi don du mi 'gyur bar mkhyen nas/ o rgyan gyi gnas dharma gañdza chos kyi mdzod du rgyas btab nas bzhugs so zhes 'byung na/ rgyud 'di gdod nas grub pa'i dbang du byas te/ sngon byung rtsa ba'i gleng gzhi de bzhin yin mod/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas kyang*/ slar bzlos te gsungs pa yin dgos pas/ de rjes o rgyan du rgyas btab bo zhes brjod na legs par mngon no/ / 'di dang gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa gnyis mi 'dra bar byung yang*/ rtsa rgyud bsdus rgyud mi 'dra ba so so la dgongs pa'ang*/ rdzogs ldan gnyis ldan la sogs pa dus skabs tha dad du/ bstan pa byung tshul so so la dgongs pa yang srid/ gnas dus gcig dang rgyud gzhung gcig yin yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'gal ba ni ma yin no/

/ gtam rgyud phyi ma 'di ltar na/ gdul bya'i gtso bo lha dbang phyug chen po yin/ gdol pa drag po ni ha la nag po'am las kyi gshin rje ste/ nang 'khor gyi gtso bo'o zhes 'dod do/ / spyir 'jigs byed chen po zhes pa/ dbang phyug chen po khros pa'i ming yin/ yang rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po zhes rdo rje'i ming tshan gyis btags pa ni/ 'jigs byed snga ma de 'dul byed kyi lha la zer ba yin pas/ gdul bya'i gtso bo dbang phyug chen por byed pa yang*/ las tshogs sgrub pa sogs gang la'ang gnad che ba zhig yod do/ / des na gshin rje dang ma mos khyad par gyi 'phrin las sgrub pa ni/ gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs thams cad kyi spyi lugs yin la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la ni de'i steng du/ dbang phyug chen po dang mgon po nag po la khyad par gyi 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshul yod de/ man ngag gi gnas phyi ma 'di/ bod du sngon yang rwa ba rnams ma gtogs/ gzhan gy-is shes pa cher ma byung*/ phyis kyi gshin rje gshed par rlom pa rnams la/ ye gsang thabs kyis chod par snang ngo*/ / yang ba ri lo tsā ba'i gsung bgros yin zer ba/ rgyud gsungs tshul gyi gtam rgyud cig 'dug na'ang*/ rnying ma ba'i ma traṃ ru tra'i dpe blangs pa tsam zhig ka 'dug pas 'dir ma smos so/ / lnga pa la gnyis/ 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul dang*/ kha ba can 'dir ni ltar bsgyur zhing gtan la phab tshul/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos phyogs 'dir ji tsam 'gyur ba'i tshul 'phros dang bcas pa'o/ / dang po ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di'i bstan pa lho 'dzam bu'i gling du dar ba kho na'i dbang du byas nas/ chos 'di dag gi byung tshul zur tsam brjod par bya ste/ gling gzhan dang 'gro ba gzhan dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na spyod pa ni 'dir mi 'chad de/ de 'dra bsam par mi nus shing brjod kyis yang mi lang ba'i phyir ro/

/ gling 'di nyid kyi'ang*/ yul chen po gzhan dang gzhan gyi gleng ba mi byed kyi/ 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir ji ltar byung tshul phyogs mtshon gyi dbang du byas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su/ bka' bsdu ba gsum pa'i bar la/ gtso bor nyan thos kyi theg pa ka 'gro don byung*/ bsdu ba gsum pa'i rjes nas mi ring bar theg chen gyi mdo sde rnams cig car mi yul du byon zhing dar ba'i tshe/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud phal che ba dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la sogs pa bla med ci rigs pa'ang mi yul du byon/ dus de'i tshe nyid nas khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po'i sngags rgyud kyang dar te/ de yang 'phags pa'i yul na 'di skad ces grag ste/ dus kyi rim pa lnga byung skad/ de yang*/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub spyod sna tshogs/ / gnod pa can dang nges spyod dang*/ / cha shas can te rnam lnga'o/ / de la dus dang po 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyi dus ni/ dus de'i tshe rig pa 'dzin pa stong phrag brgya byung ba las/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud grong khyer gser gyi sa zhes bya ba na/ rgyal po bi dza ya sing ha 'khor stong dang bcas pa/ 'dod pa'i yul lnga la rtag tu spyod kyang*/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi rig sngags grub pas/ 'dod pas ma bcings par grol te/ rdo rje'i sku brnyes/ ri'i rgyal po manda ra la bzhugs so/ / zhes grag go / yang shar phyogs kyi grong khyer/ dzwa ṣa swa mi ste nya'i rje zhes bya/ sngon de ltar grags/ ba ren dra'i bye brag cig yin zer/ der rgyal po drag po'i 'byor pa zhes bya ba gshin rje gshed po'i rig sngags grub ste/ gdug pa can thams cad drag shul spyod pa'i sngags kyis bsad bskrad dbye mnan rengs pa sogs kyi tshar bcad cing slar gsos te/ yang dag pa'i khrims bskyangs/ mthar 'khor stong dang bcas pa rig pa 'dzin pa grub bo/

/ 'di gshin rje'i rgyal po'i mchod gnas su bzhugs skad/ yang nub phyogs ha la'i yul du/ pa ra sha ma rā dza zhes bya ba/ ngag gi brjod pa thams cad grub pa zhig byung ste/ 'khor stong dang bcas pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i las grub nas/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhing khams cig tu bzhud skad/ byang phyogs yul ya ba na zhes bya ba/ da lta kla klo'i grong ka bhe la zhes pa 'di ka yin zer/ der rgyal po nā gen dra de ba klu dbang lha zhes bya ba byung*/ des rgyal srid kyang bde bar bskyangs/ lo brgya lon te rgas shing 'khogs pa na/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal mthong ba'i dge slong zhig gis/ gshin rje gshed kyi rig sngags stsal bas myur du 'grub rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ni med/ rgan po'i dbyibs kyi rnam pas slar yang lo brgya'i bar du gnas nas/ 'thar 'khor stong dang bcas pa rig pa 'dzin pa grub bo/ / yang byang phyogs kha cher ha ri ha ra zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi rig sngags grub pas/

nye skor gyi yul ljongs thams cad dbang du bsdus te/ grong bye ba la dbang ba'i rgyal por gyur/ lo bcu gnyis su sngags kyi spyod pa spyad nas/ 'khor stong dang bcas pa'i rig pa 'dzin par gyur to/ / de dag ni mtshon pa ste/ gshin rje gshed kyi sngags rgyud la brten nas/ rdo rje'i sku thob pa mtha' yas pa zhig byung ngo*/ / de ltar dus dang po lo brgya'am nyis brgya tsam mo/ / dus gnyis pa spyod pa ba sna tshogs pa grub pa ni/ de rjes lo sum brgya tsam gyi bar du gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa rnams/ don ma grub pa ni gcig kyang med/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob pa yang mang du byung mod/ ral gri ro langs bcud len sogs lo'i sbyor bas 'grub pa dang*/ zhi sogs phra mo thams cad zla ba drug gis mi 'grub pa'i thabs med/ sa 'og sa steng sogs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'ang mang du byung*/ gshin rje gshed kyi dbang bskur bar ma thob pa dang lhan cig khyim gcig tu sngags bzlar yang mi btub ste/ bzlas na dbang ma thob pa de'i lus de ma thag tu tshig pa'am/ skams pa'am/ zhig 'gro ba byung bas/ sngags bzlos pa po rnams gcig pu kho nar bzla skad/ de'i tshe lho phyogs su tshong dpon gyi bu a ra dang*/ sa ra zhes bya ba gnyis kyis slob dpon gcig la gshin rje gshed kyi dbang bskur nod nas/ tho rangs kyi tshe bri sku'i mdun du sngags brgya rtsa re bzlas so/ / a ra zhes bya ba de lo gcig tsam song ba na/ tshong khang du tshong gi bya ba byed 'phro la/ lus yang zhing sems dga' ba de'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa zhig byung*/ der 'chag sa thag ring ba zhig la phyin pas/ bslus ma len pa'i phyir du/ chom rkun g.yo can mi bzhis bzung*/ zhags pas bcings pa la sngags dran pa tsam gyis chad/ lcags sgrog brtod pa'ang thang chu bzhin du nud skad de/ der tshong khang yid la dran pas tshong khang du sleb/

lam khar gter cig mthong nas snying rjes chom po de rnams bos te/ gter de las ci 'dod par byin skad/ bu sa ra ni dgong ka zhig dbyug pa thogs te/ phyugs rnams skor ba la song ngo*/ / der rang gi lus las sngags kyi sgra dang*/ 'od zer byung ngo*/ / dbyug pa g.yab pas me 'bar ro/ / de thogs te phyugs bdas pas phyugs kyi rwa las kyang me 'bar zhing*/ log 'ongs pas khyim du sleb kar/ nam mkha' las sgra byung ste/ cho ga'i lhag pa 'di dang 'di lta bu gyis zhes zer ro/ / de ltar byas pas khong rang dang phyugs rnams rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i lus su gyur/ lo bcu gnyis su ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rig pa mang po bstan te/ mthar ri rab kyi rtse mor 'gro'o zhes zer gar song cha med do/ / gtam rgyud 'dis mtshon no/ / de yan chad du gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams skal med kyi sems can gcig la'ang 'chol bar 'khyar ba med cing*/ skal ldan kho na la dar ba yin no/ / dus gsum pa gnod pa can gyi dus ni lo lnga brgya tsam mo zer yang nges pa med pa 'dra'o/ / gnod pa can gyi don ni/ skal ldan ched du bya ba'i gdul bya rang yang ma yin mdo sngags ci rigs pa 'grub nus pa'i las shugs chen po yod pa rnams la'ang dar bas nus pa'i sgo nas sems can la gnod pa dang*/ yul dang dus ma yin par mngon spyod byas pas/ sgrub po rang la'ang sdig pa 'byung ba'i don yin/ dus kyi stobs kyis de 'dra'ang mang du byung zhes pa tsam yin gyi/ skabs der yang skal ldan dngos grub thob pa'ang mang du byung zhing*/ sems can gyi don rgya cher ma byas pa ni ma yin no/ / de dag kyang mtha' yas pa zhig yod mod kyi/ gtam rgyud dpe tsam mtshon pa ni/ rgyal po zla ba sbas pa'i dus su/ yul o ḍi bi shar tshong dpon gyi bu rab tu byung ba sna tshogs 'byung gnas zhes bya ba zhigasde snod gsum la byang bar bslabs nas/ nags khrod kyi phug pa zhig na bsgom zhing 'dug go

/ des mtshan cig phug pa'i phyir phyin pas rdo leb cig gi steng na 'od cher 'phro ba zhig 'dug go / de mngon rtags su bzung ste nangs par bltas pas/ shing be kang kang zhes bya ba las byas pa'i ral gri zhig 'dug ste/ de la ma reg pa zhag re bzhin lta bar song na dbyar gyi dus su de las sprin chad de/ o ḍi bi shi'i yul du char chen po 'bab pa yang yang mthong nas shin tu ngo mtshar skyes pa la/ rmi lam du 'di ni ri bo 'di la gnas pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba zhig gi rtsed mo yin no/ / zer bas/ rig sngags mkhan de blta 'dod par gyur te/ ri nags de thams cad bskor zhing yun ring du gsol ba btab pas/ lan cig brag de'u cig gi ngos me long ltar mnyam zhing mkhregs pa cig las sgo phye ste/ der zhugs pas rig pa 'dzin pa gcig bzhugs 'dug pa la phyag byas/ de'i mtshan ni/ a nan ta bhā te 'od mtha' yas zer gsung*/ dpe la la na a nan ta bhakt+ra zer ba'ang yod/ de la gsol ba btab pas/ des gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur/ phyag mtshan rdo rje zhig gtad/ sna tshogs 'byung gnas kyis kyang de thogs nas zla ba drug bsgoms pas/ rdo rje las 'od 'bar ba lus la phog pas 'ja' lus su gyur/ phyi rabs kyi sems can gyi don du de'i zhabs rjes yod/ de dag dang dus mtshungs rung la/ 'phreng rgyud mkhan gcig gis kyang gshin rje gshed kyi rigs sngags la bzlas bsgom la brtson pas/ me tog 'phreng rgyud 'phyo bzhin du 'phreng rgyud sprugs pas/ sa g.yos shing 'phreng rgyud kyi rjes rdo la gsal bar byung*/ bla dwags kyi ming 'phreng ba mchog ces bya/ yul bhu sha na'i ri la sku lus ma spangs pa da lta bzhugs zer bas mtshon te/ dngos grub thob pa'ang ches mang ngo*/ / gnod pa can gyi gtam yang*/ yul gau ri'i rgyal po snying po thig le'i blon po bram ze tsa na ka lta bu yin/

de'i gshin rje gshed kyi zhal mthong*/ mngon spyod kyi las kyis mi sum stong tsam ni bsad/ stong phrag bcu tsam smyo bar byas/ dbye ba/ bskrad pa/ rengs pa/ dbang po nyams pa sogs kyi gnod pa'ang ches mang*/ phyogs kyi rgyal po'i srid bcu drug tsam stongs par byas/ de'i sdig pas dmyal bar skyes so/ / 'di 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las lung bstan/ ma 'ongs pa na gshin rje chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur bar bshad do/ / 'di'i gtam rgyud mtha' dag ma thos kyang*/ dper mtshon pa la/ yul ḍi lir kla klo'i rigs kyi rgyal po/ ha tshar a la zhes bya ba yod do/ / grong khyer bcom rlag man chad rgyal po snying po thig le'i yul yin/ rgyal po de gnyis 'thabs te g.yul bshams pa'i skabs su/ bram ze de'i sngags kyis btab pa'i bya thi ba zhig nam mkha' la phur te btang bas/ ḍi li'i dmag mi rnams kyis mgo la reg pa tsam du 'phur zhing*/ gshog pa'i rlung gi sgra 'brug sgra tsam byung*/ dmag mi thams cad kyis nam mkha' la bltas so/ / bya de thag ring por mi snang bar song ba/ dmag mi phal pa rnams rnal mar 'dug kyang*/ rgyal po dang dpa' bo'i rigs lnga brgya tsam mig nam mkha' la blta tshul gyis dran med du brgyal zhing myos/ de ka la lus pas snying po thig le'i dmag gis ḍi li'i yul mtha' dag blangs so/ / yang yul si ro ṭi'i rgyal po ha ha rā dza dang*/ snying po thig le rtsod par gyur pa'i skabs shig yul der dus ston chen po zhig byung*/ bram ze tsa na ka slong mo bar brdzus te blta bar song ngo*/ / lam du bud med rgan mo zhig dang 'phrad pa/ de yang sngags 'chang ma yin par shes nas/ bdag cag las tshogs sgrub pa'i grogs kyis shig byas nas/ de dang sdebs te song song ba las/ mthar dus ston byed sa na/ shing karko ṭi'i 'bras bu phung po shin tu che bar 'dug nas/ mi rnams kyis ma tshor bar/ de la bram zes sngags kyis btab ste bzhagamakha' 'gro mas kyang lta stangs kyis mnan no/

/ de nas dga' ston gyi skabs/ shing thog rgyal po dang blon po dang gtso bo thams cad la drangs/ rang rang so sos de nas zos so/ / thams cad kyi tha ma phyag tshang ba des za bar bsams te/ chu gris shing thog phyed mar gtubs pas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas sum brgya tsam gyi mgrin pa dus gcig tu chad de mgo sa la lhung ngo*/ / de nas yul de yang snying po thig les blangs so/ / zhes grag go / de dag ni mtshon pa ste/ gzhan rnams kyang de 'dra'i rigs so/ / yang de dag gi rjes su/ yul ma la bar bram ze legs par grub byed ces bya ba byung*/ des slob dpon sngags mkhan zhig la gshin rje gshed zhus te bsgoms pas/ rig sngags 'grub nas las phra mo rnams thogs pa med do/ / 'on kyang las sna tshogs kyis yid 'byung ste/ yul ma ru'i so mtshams grong khyer kakṣa na zhes bya ba dang nye ba'i brag phug gcig tu gnas bcas nas/ skye bo mang po la rig sngags kyi mthus phan 'dogs shing bsdad pas/ grong khyer ba de dag sngar mu stegs byed kho na la dad pa las/ skabs der phal cher nang pa la dad par gyur to/ / de'i rgyal po rgyal phran cig yod pas kyang*/ yang yang blta bar 'ongs pa las/ de dang mi ring ba'i phyogs shig na/ rdo leb chen po 'dom gang tsam du 'thug pa dkyus zheng du 'dom bco lnga tsam pa zhig yod pa/ gnod sbyin stobs po che zhig la bka' bsgos te/ des blangs nas rang nyid sdod sa'i phug pa'i sgo 'gebs byed byas so/ / rgyal po des nyi ma snga ma cig 'ongs dus/ de med pa las de'i phyi nyin 'ongs pas/ de ltar 'dug pa mthong ste ya mtshan skyes nas slob dpon de bla mar bkur ro/ / de nas rgyal po de yang stobs dang ldan par gyur nas/ sau raṣta sogs yul mang po la dbang byed pa zhig byung ngo*/ / der mu stegs kyi slob dpon sau ma ā tsarya la sogs pa rnams phrag dog tu gyur nas gros byas/ yul phyogs 'di kun tu sangs rgyas pa dar ba ni/

bram ze 'di la thug na 'di bsad par nus pa su yod byas pa la/ khas len pa su yang med de/ de ni rig sngags grub pa yin pas/ me chu mtshon dug sogs gang gis kyang mi tshugs pas so zhes zlog go / de nas phyi zhig na mu stegs pa'i dbul po lus chung zhing gos hrul ba nyams chung chung 'dra ba gnyis zhig gis khas blangs te/ de gnyis la'ang mu stegs de rnams kyis gser 'bum rngan par ster bar khas blangs so/ / de nas de gnyis bram ze legs grub kyi sar song nas g.yog byed cing yod pa las/ ji zhig na bram zes de gnyis kyi bsam pa shes kyang ci yang mi gnod do bsam pas ci dgar bzhag go / de yang sngon bram ze'i bla ma sngags mkhan des/ khrus la 'gro ba na mi skra'i tshangs skud sgo gong du btags te bzhag pa/ bram ze legs grub kyi mgo la thogs pas khros te bcad nas bor/ de la bla ma de bag tsam ma mnyes pa'i dmod pa yod pas/ g.yog de gnyis kyis kyang 'tshang de rig ste skabs 'tshol zhing yod do/ / skabs der bram ze legs grub kyis g.yog gnyis po yul sau raṣtar brdzangs te/ sau ma ā tsarya'i gnas su bur shing gi lcug ma khur po 'di skyol zhig byas/ des kyang de bzhin du byas pas/ mu stegs kyi gnas gzhi de thams cad zhig ste/ sau ma ā tsarya 'khor bcas shi'o/ / yang de gnyis log ste 'ongs/ yang lan cig bram ze legs grub sngags kyi tshangs skud de bzhag nas bag med par khrus byed pa la/ g.yog po gnyis kyis tshangs skud blangs te ral gri la dkris nas bram ze'i ske bcad pas chod do/ / da ni de bsad zin snyam nas mgo khyer te/ de gnyis bros nas sau raṣtar song*/ shing gi rtse mo la mgo btags te phyar nas/ mu stegs byed kyi gnas lhag ma rnams su phyin/ bram ze legs grub bsad zin gyi da gser dang dbyig rnams longs shig ces skad btang bas/ der mu stegs rnams 'dus te/ dga' dga' ltar ngo mtshar che bar byed pa la bram ze legs grub ni sngags grub pas ma shi ste bsams pa/

da ni slob dpon gyi dmod pa byung zin pas/ las de dag go snyam dga' ba dang bcas te/ mgo bo med pa'i lus kyis mu stegs kyi pho nya gnyis kyi rjes la ka song nas/ yul sau raṣtar phyin pas/ mu stegs can rnams dang skye bo mang po ltad mo dga' ston la 'tshogs pa'i sa der gar byed cing 'ongs/ de mthong ba tsam gyis sngar gyi g.yog po gnyis dang*/ mu stegs can lnga brgya tsam khrag skyugs te shi mu stegs pa'i dge bsnyen rnams kyi grong khyer yang mes tshig go / de nas bram ze legs grub kyis rang gi mgo blangs te sngar shul du bslan pas 'grig go / de nas sngar gyi gnas su log 'ongs te/ gshin rje gshed kyi cho ga stong brgyad brgya pa yi ge bris shing*/ slob ma gsum la cung zad bshad nas/ glegs bam brag la sbas te bzhagami ring bar phug de nyid du mi snang par gyur te/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ni ma thob/ thun mong gi rig 'dzin yin zer/ gnas de ni gho ra dzwa la ste/ drag po 'bar ba zhes pa dur khrod shin tu bka' gnyan pa zhig da lta yang yod de/ kla klo rnams kyis 'gro mi nus gsung ngo*/ / yang dmangs rigs kyi slob dpon ka ma la ka ra zhes bya ba gcig gis/ slob dpon dzā la ha ri zhes bya ba dge slong sngags mkhan zhig mnyes par byas te/ gshin rje gshed zhus nas bsgoms pas/ lo 'ga' zhig song ba na/ sngags 'grub cing zhal yang mthong*/ nub phyogs kyi yul bhā ra pā ṭa na zhes pa grong sde bcu gnyis yod pa zhig na/ bsod snyoms rgyu zhing nags na gnas par byed do/ / yul de dang po dad can mang po yod pa yin yang*/ bar der bram ze dang kla klo'i btsun pa dag gis su thob kyi tshul gyis 'ongs nas/ yul thams cad lta ba log par bsgyur/ der ka ma la ka ras mi ma yin mthu chen mo mang po rig mar bsgrubs nas yod pa/ mi'i bud med kyi gzugs su bsgyur te de dag dang lhan cig grong khyer du phyin pa'i grong khyer gyi mi rnams 'tshogs te/

sangs rgyas pa 'di kun la bden pa cung zad kyang med/ 'di sngon tshangs par spyod pa yin par brdzu ba/ da bud med dang lhan cig grong du rgyu'am zhes thams cad kyis thal brdabs byas/ ka ma la ka ra khros te/ lhung bzed sa la brdabs pas sa g.yos mi bzad pa byung*/ grong sde bcu gnyis kyi mi phyugs khang khyim byung ba'i shul tsam yang med par sa 'og tu song*/ der gnod pa ha cang ches pa'i sdig pas/ slob dpon des dngos grub ni ma thob/ lo sum brgyar 'tsho zhing*/ phan gnod kyi nus pa gang la'ang thogs rdugs med/ yul sa kar dang*/ bha kar gnyis kyi ri la gnas shing*/ longs spyod lha dang mnyam pa byung*/ gshin rje gshed mkhan po tshe ring ba'i grags pa yang de nas byung skad/ gtam rgyud mtshon pa tsam mo/ / de dag ni spyir gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor byung tshul dang/

rig sngags 'grub tshul tsam yin gyi/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi rgyud rnams de skabs mi yul na spyod pa cher med skad do/ / rgyud sde'ang gsang sngags phyi rgyud la brten pa kho na yin zhes grags mod/ mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ bla med kyi tshul la brten pa'ang mang du yod par mngon no/ / de rjes bar skabs cig lo brgya tsam khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i rig sngags grub pa nyung ba'i skabs shig byung ngo*/ / dus bzhi pa nges pa la spyod pa ni/ de nas slob dpon chen po dpal chos kyi grags pa'i sku tshe'i stod tsam gyi dus shig na/ slob dpon la li ta badzra byung ngo*/ / slob dpon de 'khrungs pa'i yul ni o ḍi bi sha yin/ bod pa rnams rigs bram ze yin zhes 'chad/ dpal na lan dar song nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par byas/ sngags kyi theg pa yang mang du thos/ slob dpon sngags mkhan zhig la/ dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbang zhus/ me tog 'jam dpal la phog pas 'jam dpal nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsgrubs pa yin/ gsang mtshan la li ta badzra yin mtshan dngos 'jam dpal mtshon cha zhes bya/ des 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgrubs pas/ lo nyi shu tsam na zhal gzigs shing*/ thun mong gi dngos grub 'ga' re thob bo/ / skabs 'dir bod kyi bla ma rnams gsungs pa ltar na/ slob dpon 'dis paṇḍi ta sngags mkhan rnams la/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs/ / mig drug lag drug stobs dang ldan/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di rnams kyi lha sngags rgyud dang dkyil 'khor la sogs pa gang yin zhes dris kyang*/ 'jam dpal gyi sku'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa ston te de'i nang tshan re yin gsung pa tsam las/ 'dzug btsugs su ston rgyu ma byung*/ khong rang gi bla ma'am/ paṇḍi ta bgres po zhig la zhus pas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i phyag na 'di dag la'ang rgyud re re yod par 'dug ste/
