da lta mi yul na med pas/ de'i don du 'phags pa 'jam dpal sgrubs shig gsungs nas bsgrub pa yin zer ro/ / de nas slob dpon gyis bskyed rim brtan cing nus pa cung zad thob pa dang*/ dpal o rgyan gyi yul nas dregs pa 'dul ba'i rgyud spyan drongs shig pa'i lung bstan yang thob nas/ rim gyis byang phyogs su bzhud nas/ o rgyan dang nye ba'i gnas kun tu mu stegs rnams dang nus pa 'gran pa las/ gzhan thams cad las rgyal bar gyur kyang lan cig mu stegs pa'i rnal 'byor ma zhig gis lta stangs byas pas/ slob dpon yug cig dran med du bogade sangs tsa na/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje ro langs ma mi'i bud med kyi rnam par mngon sum du byon te gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ slob dpon gyi rgyud la phyin ci ma log pa'i dbang gi ye shes skyes/ gnad der zla ba phyed dang gsum bsgoms pas/ bskyed rdzogs kyi ye shes brtan cing drod thob nas/ nags kyi ma he gdug pa can bkug ste/ de la phyibs te zla ba drug tu smyon pa'i spyod pa mdzad/ de rjes dza la pa ṭa na dang*/ ta la pa ṭa na la sogs pa'i grong khyer rnams su rgyu zhing*/ bzhi mdor bzhugs te chang 'tshong ma rnams kyi chang thams cad dus gcig tu bkug ste gsol ba dang*/ yang de'i phyi nyin chang 'tshong ma rnams kyi chang gi snod dag gser dngul dang*/ rin po che dang*/ gzhan yang rdzas sna tshogs kyis gang bas tshims par mdzad/ yang lan cig grong khyer gyi mi phyugs rnams la khrag 'gug pa'i ting nge 'dzin mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi mdun du snod chen po khrag gis khengs/ rdo rje tsar tsi kās zhal mngon sum du bstan/ de gsol bas stobs dpag tu med par gyur te/ glang po che ni sor mo gcig gis mnan/ shal ma li'i sdong po chen po yang phyag gcig gis sa nas bton/

grong khyer gyi mi phyugs thams cad shin tu rid par gyur to/ / thams cad 'jigs shing skrag pa na/ de'i nangs par sngar bkug pa rnams slar phar spos pas/ mi phyugs thams cad nyams stobs dang ldan par song*/ rdo rje tsar tsi kā'i sgrub thabs zhig kyang mdzad do/ / de dag la sogs pa rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi 'gro don cung zad mdzad nas/ dpal o rgyan gyi gnas dharma gañdza chos kyi mdzod du byon/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang bka' bgros te/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi rgyud spyan drangs so/ / yang rgya gar gyi lo rgyus cig la/ smyon pa'i spyod pa mdzad pa yan chad yul dza ri khaṇḍar yin la/ de nas rgyud spyan 'dren pa'i lung bstan byung ste/ o rgyan du bzhud ces kyang 'chad la/ bod kyi bla ma gong ma rnams ni/ la li tas o rgyan gyi sa mthar phebs tsa na/ zhabs la sindhu ras byugs nas yod pa la/ 'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis/ nged kyi mgo rgyan khyed kyi rkang pa la byug pa zer nas/ sdigs mdzub byas pas/ slob dpon dran med du song*/ de sangs tsa na skyabs gzhan med mgon gzhan med dgongs nas rdo rje ro langs ma la gsol ba btab zer ba dang*/ rgyud spyan 'dren pa na mkha' 'gro ma rnams na re/ zhag bdun du blo la gang zin pa khyer zer bas/ zhag bdun du bzung bas mi phan snyam ste/ lha la gsol ba btab pas/ zhag bdun pa'i tho rangs nag 'jigs skor gsum gyi rgyud thugs la lhangs te shar/ ske tshang nas glegs bam blangs te bltas pas kyang ma nor bar 'dug ces 'chad/ de lta na yang gong dkyus su bris pa ni/ 'phags yul rang du grags pa ltar yin zhing*/ lo rgyus kyi yi ger yang bkaud pa yin pas 'khrul ba med do/ / de nas nub phyogs kyi yul mo la tā na zhes pa na/ rgyal po na ra padma zhes bya ba yod de/ gnas de na mu stegs byed dug gi rgyud la mkhas pa mang po dag yod pa las/

rgyal pos bskul te de dag dang nus pa 'gran pa las/ mu stegs de rnams kyis dug bre bo re re dus gcig tu zos/ slob dpon gyis dug mi khur bcu btags te/ de'i tshad nyis 'gyur kyi myos byed la btab ste gsol yang gnod pa med/ ghe la zhes pa chang snyol ba'i snod rdza ma shin tu che ba cig gi ming yin de 'dra gnyis dngul chus gang ba gsol yang gnod pa med/ de ltar dug dang*/ dngul chu de zhags bdun gyi ring la gsol bas/ sku bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dpag tu med par gyur te/ rgyal po'i pho brang yang phyag gcig gis bsgul bas/ thams cad skrag ste yo byad dpag tu med pa phul/ de thams cad dge slong dang phongs pa rnams kyis ce bder khyer/ de nas gandha ra'i ri la lo gcig tu ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la bzhugs/ de nas grong khyer hasti na pu rar byon/ de na mu stegs byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyi rol pa'i sngags mkhan gyi sde chen po chags te/ nus pa thob pa rang yang pho mo 'dres pa lnga brgya tsam yod skad/ der slob dpon byon te/ de rnams la phar sku lus ston cing tshig kyang gsungs la/ de dag gi tshur smra ba'am/ phyi rjes gcod du byung na sku lus mi snang bar byed pa sogs kyi cho 'phrul bstan te/ mthar nyi ma phyed kyi dus zhig na/ de nas brtsams nam phyed kyi bar la dus btab ste/ khyed rang rnams bsgrims te bzlog pa gyis shigangs kyang sngags gtong ngo zhes mthu dus btab pas nam phyed na sa g.yos/ skye bo gzhan la ni gnod pa med/ mu stegs pa'i sngags mkhan mthu chen thams cad sa 'og tu sdib ste gar song med par shi'o/ / de nas ma ga dhar byon te/ dpal na lan dar song ba na/ paṇḍi ta rnams na re/ khyed kyis rgyud kyang spyan drangs/ nus pa yang thob ces zer na/ nangs par nam langs pa tshun chod la/ dngos su mthong ba'i nus pa zhig ston cig zer ba la/

'o na rgyal po seng ge lnga pa'i 'khor zhig 'dir dgug gi byas/ de la rgyal po seng ge lnga pa 'khor bcas ni/ yul gau ra na yod de/ na lan da nas shar phyogs su mgyogs pa song yang zla phyed tsam 'gro dgos pa la/ slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi las sbyor mdzad pas/ rgyal po seng ge lnga pa'i blon po mu tā ri pra dā na bya ba mu stegs la dad pa zhigayul ma ga dhar 'gro 'dod skyes nas nyi ma phyi phred kyi dus su yo byad mang po dang bcas shing 'khor dang bcas pa lam du zhugs pas zla ba phyed kyi lam chu tshod 'ga' zhig la bgrod nas/ nam phyed pa na dpal na lan da'i lcags ri'i nang du sleb/ dge 'dun gyi zhal ta pa la skad btang ste/ nam langs ma thag dge 'dun rnams la chos ston gsol/ nor mang po phul/ phyin chad sangs rgyas pa byed par khas blangs pas/ slob dpon la thams cad yid ches shing ngo mtshar skyes so/ / de nas shar phyogs ba rend+ra'i bye brag ba ga la zhes bya ba cig yod/ de yang bhaṃ ga la dang*/ ba ga la so so yin par go dgos/ yul de na mtsho gcig la klu bi kri ḍa zhes bya ba/ gdug rtsub che zhing*/ phyi pa dang kla klo'i grogs byed/ nang pa la shin tu gnod pa zhig yod do/ / mtsho'i mtha' rnams su sngags kyi srad bus bskor nas/ der sbyin sreg mdzad pas klu 'khor dang bcas pa tshigamatsho yang zhag bdun nas bskams/ de'i shul du rdo ring chen po btsugs/ rdo ring gi rtse mo la 'jam dpal gyi sku gzugs cig byas so/ / skabs der yul ba ren dra na he tsi li zhes pa kla klo'i grong zhig yod/ gzhan kla klo med do de rnams stobs dang ldan par 'gro ba dang rgyal khams thams cad phung bar byed pa'i ltas gzigs nas/ de dang nye bar sbyin sreg kyang cher mdzad/ nyi ma gcig 'khrul 'khor bskor nas/ ro langs me ldan zhes bya ba nyi ma khos pa la btad pas/ de ma thag he tsi li'i kla klo'i grong thams cad tshig ste/

kla klo'i bla ma kā tsi dang*/ sa yī ta thams cad shi de nas brtsams lo lnga brgya'i bar du ba rend+rar kla klo ye ma byung skad/ de dag ni rgyud las gsungs pa'i bsam gtan dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi nus pa bstan pa yin gyi/ slob dpon nyid de dag la ma ltos te/ grub pa chen po brnyes pa'i phyir/ bzhed pa tsam gyis las thams cad mod la 'grub bo/ / de rjes ma ga dha dang*/ bhaṃ ga la dang*/ o ḍi bi sha rnams su lo yang mang du bzhugs shing sems can gyi don mdzad do/ / de nas lan cig o rgyan du rgyal po ind+ra bo dhi bar pa de/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob cing*/ grags che yang nga rgyal dang ldan pas de 'dul bar dgongs te byon pas/ lam du slob dpon lwa ba pa dang phrad pas de dang lhan cig gshegs pa na/ ri mu ruṇḍa ka zhes bya ba la 'byon pa'i skabs/ ri de shin tu mtho zhing bgrod dka' ba yin pa las slob dpon 'dis gshin rje gshed kyi ral gris ri de sa gzhi'i thang la thug par gnyags pa'i ting nge 'dzin mdzad pas/ slob dpon nyid dang lhan cig lam du 'gro ba'i skye bo mang po dang bcas pa thams cad/ la chen po la 'dzeg ma dgos par/ grong khyer gyi srang kha dog po 'dra ba cig la phyin pa'i ngang nas yud tsam cig la ra'i pha rol tu sleb pas thams cad ya mtshan skyes/ de nas o rgyan du byon pa na/ grub thob cig 'ongs so zhes rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis gsan nas/ 'khor tshogs mang po dang bcas te bsu ba la byon/ rgyal pos slob dpon gyi zhabs bkru zhing bsku mnye mdzad pa la/ zhabs re la lag pa gnyis kyis sku mnye byed dgos pas lag pa bzhi sprul lo/ / de nas slob dpon gyis zhabs bzhi sprul bas rgyal pos phyag brgyad/ slob dpon gyis brgyad sprul pas/ rgyal pos bcu drug gi bar du byung*/ slob dpon gyis zhabs bcu drug sprul pas/ rgyal po ni lha phyag bcu drug pa'i bag chags brtas pas/

bcu drug las lhag pa sprul ma nus te/ de nas slob dpon kyi zhabs re la rgyal pos phyag re res sku mnye byas so/ / de nas zhabs sum cu so gnyis sprul bas/ de yang ma nus te/ rgyal po nga rgyal chagaskye bo rnams dad pa skyes so/ / de nas o rgyan du yang 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad/ rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis kyang*/ phyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/ dus de tsa na rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'di ni mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud/ bskyed rim gyi grub pa la dbang 'byor ba yin/ slob dpon lwa ba pa ni mchog gi dngos grub brnyes zin pa yid skad/ o rgyan nas phyir byon pa'i dus su/ lwa ba pas ri mu runṭa ga nyid nam mkhar bsgoms pas/ ri gtan nas med pa'i thang yangs gcig la byon chog pa byung ba'i gtam rgyud yod/ phyis slob dpon 'di yang slob dpon lwa ba pa dang rtogs pa mnyam par gyur to/ / de nas byang phyogs kha che'i yul du bzhud de/ sems can mang po'i don mdzad/ yang lan cig tho gar gyi yul du kla klo'i dmag byung bas/ dmag rnams chu klung pakṣu'i byang phyogs su yod/ slob dpon gyis lho phyogs nas 'khur ba'i dum bu cig dang*/ chu snyim pa gang gis gtor ma mdzad de/ gcer bur bzhengs bzhin du thal mo brdabs pas/ kla klo'i dmag tshogs thams cad smyo ste/ ri klungs med par rgyugs/ rgyal po dang dmag dpon dang dpa' bo lnga brgya tsam khrag skyugs nas shi ste/ re zhig kla klo rmeg med par byas so/ / de dag la sogs pa gtso bor mngon spyod kyi las kyis 'gro don mdzad cing*/ gzhan yang zhi rgyas dbang dgug bcud len gter gyi dngos grub sogs kyi sgo nas/ sems can mang po la phan btags te/ mdzad pa ngo mtshar can lnga brgya'i bar du bstan skad/ sku tshe'i mthar yul pus ka rar bzhugs nas/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyais so/ / slob dpon 'dis mtshan brjod la sogs pa 'jam dpal zhi ba'i rgyud 'ga' re dang*/

rgyud thams cad kyi spyi bo yin pa'i phyir gsang ba 'dus pa ci rigs gsungs/ gzhan gshin rje gshed skor ma gtogs ma gsungs kyang sngags kyi 'phrin las kyi sgo nas ches che ba bla na med pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdo rje slob dpon chen pos zhes mtshan gsol lo/ / 'di dang po bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i dus/ rten dge slong yin zhes bod rnying rnams 'chad kyang*/ lo rgyus khungs ma la gsal ka med cing yin ni rung*/ phyis ni rnal 'byor pa'i tshul du bzhugs nges pas/ sku brnyan bzhengs na rnal 'byor ba'i cha lugs can du byed dgos/ bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i thugs dam bde mchog dkyil thang drang srong srin po ri na yod pa de na/ ma he la phyibs shing ling ga gyen bsgreng can bris 'dugargya gar du bris pa'i thang ka gzhan la gtor mas kla klo'i sde bcom pa'i bkod pa'i tshul du byas zhabs gnyis mnyam par brkyang zhing bzhengs pa/ phyag thal mo brdeb pa/ ling ga gyen bsgreng*/ sku mdun du gtor ma'i maṇḍal yod pa re yod gyin 'dugaspyir mngon spyod kyi las mang du bsgrubs pa rnams kyis tshe de la dngos grub 'grub pa dkon kyang*/

slob dpon 'di'i mngon spyod kyi phrin las thams cad ni 'gro phan bla na med pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/ mngon spyod dpag tu med pa mdzad nas/ mthar phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes so/ / slob dpon 'di'i slob ma sang ka ra de ba zhes bya bas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma 'grub ste/ srid pa gsum po mtha' dag mthong ba'i mngon shes byung*/ bram ze gser mdzes zhes bya bas gnod mdzes grub ste sa 'og gi dngos grub thob/ a bhi ma na zhes pa dge slong zhig gis rdo rje rta mchog grub nas/ rang snang du nam mkha' la spyod cing*/ gzhan snang du'ang lam gang la song mi shes par ci 'dod du yong ba cig byung*/ pra kā sha du ta zhes bya ba ral gcig ma la brten nas/ gnod sbyin mo grub/ nam mkha' las nor gang 'dod blangs te mi rnams la ster ro/ / mi phaṃ bshes gnyen zhes bya ba rnal 'byor pa cig gis/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje grub nas phal cher lus mi snang zhing mkhas pa rnams kyi the tshom gcod pa'i phyir du res 'ga' lus snang zhing chos ston to/ / bram ze chos 'bangs zhes bya bas/ dug sel ma grub ste/ dug khur du longs ba za zhing chu la mi bying bar 'gro/ rigs ngan gyi rnal 'byor pa tsa ka ru zhes pa klu'i gnas su ci 'dod par 'gro/ ku ru kulle grub/ dmangs rigs dur dza ya zhes pas yan lag med pa'i rdo rje 'grub ste/ thig le mchog ma sogs lha mo brgyad kyis g.yog byed/ bha tra pā li ta zhes pa cig gis dpal he ru ka la brten nas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sna tshogs pa dag gis bskor zhing gshegs pa zhig yod do/ / de rnams thams cad rnam smin gyi lus ni ma bzhag 'ja' lus su song*/ snga ma rnams kyis thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ phyi mas mchog grub pa'o/ / de dag gis chos bshad pa las 'phel ba ni med skad/ yang slob dpon dza mā dzi par mtshan thogs pa cig bhaṃ ga lar byung*/

grong khyer sa hyir du chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba cig byung*/ grong khyer a dzo dhya ru buddha gupta zhes pa byung ste/ de rnams rnam smin gyi lus gnas ma gyur mod/ lha mo bzhi grub cing las tshogs thogs pa med pa yin zer/ gsum po de la brten nas la li ta badzra kyi chos rnams dar ba yin zhes rgya gar ba la grags so/ / bod kyi brgyud pa so so'i gsungs bgros kyi dbang du byas na/ slob dpon la li ta badzra la/ skyo ba rnams kyi ngag bgros las/ mtshan slob dpon li la badzra zhes 'don te/ rgyud du ma mkhyen/ slob ma mang po'ang yod pa las/ rnal 'byor pa cig 'ongs nas/ bsad bskrad dbye rengs kyi cho 'phrul du ma bstan pas li la'i slob ma rnams de la mos par byung*/ der slob dpon gyis bsams pa/ nus mthus sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung nus pa/ cho 'phrul ya ma zung ston pa/ phyi ma mchog thob pa'i chos cig dgos par 'dug snyam nas 'tshol du byon pas/ chu len gyi bud med rkang pa sa la ma reg par 'gro ba gcig dang phrad/ khyod gar 'gro zer/ chos de lta bu 'tshol du 'gro byas pas/ khyod kyis cang rnyed dam zer/ de mkha' 'gro ma yin par shes nas/ phyag dang bskor ba byas gsol ba btab pas/ des dur khrod bsil pa'i tshal du khrid nas/ ma mo'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma gzhan gcig la gtad do/ / des nub phyogs o rgyan du khrid nas/ rdo rje chen po'i brag phug tu bskyal bas/ bcom ldan 'das 'jigs mdzad dam/ gshin rje gshed zhal bzhad cing spyan g.yo ba mngon sum du gzigs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bka' lung sbyin te/ rgyud kyi glegs bam gyi tshogs pa'i nang nas/ gser gyi thur ma sor bzhi pa cig gis thon tshad cig long gsung ba ltar bton pas/ nag po skor gsum gyi rgyud byung*/ de yang dgra nag ni rdo rje 'chang khros pa lha'i bu'i bdud 'dul ba'i phyir dang*/

gdong drug ni phyag rdor khros pa gshin rje 'dul ba yin zhes dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed ni 'jam dpal khros pa dbang phyug 'dul zhes dang*/ gsum kar ngo bo rnal 'byor chen po yin par 'dra yang*/ 'jigs mdzad kri ya dang mthun te/ bris sku'i sgrub pa gtso bor ston/ gdong drug yo ga dang mthun te phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs/ dgra nag rnal 'byor chen po rang rkang bar dgongs zer te/ rgyud kyi bzhugs tshul ni de lta bur ma nges so/ / der rgyud gzhan gnyis bris bshus mdzad/ 'jigs mdzad glegs bam rang du bton nas bsnams pas/ mchod rten gyi cong chen po rang sgra sgragabya dang khyi rnams shar du zugaljon shing thams cad shar du rtse mo dud skad/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang rmi ltas sogs log ste/ phyi bzhin bsnyegs pas slob dpon ni ma mthong*/ bcom ldan 'das 'jigs mdzad kyi sku'i drung na glegs bam 'dug par mthong ste/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis glegs bam blangs te song ngo*/ / der glegs bam spyan drangs kyang don du mi 'gyur bar 'dug snyam du dgongs nas/ slar yang o rgyan du cung zad cig bzhugs/ rgyud thugs su chud par mdzad nas byon te/ phyis thugs nas bton te yi ger bris zhes 'chad do/ / ba ri lo tsā ba'i rjes 'jug rnams ni 'di skad ces 'chad de/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes bya bas/ gshin rje gshed nag po bsgoms pas nus pa cung zad grub nas/ lho phyogs kyi yul du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa byas/ mu stegs gcig dang 'gran pas khong rang la ma tshugs kyang*/ 'khor pho mo rnams ra lug tu gyur pa/ spyod pa sngas so snyam kha sarpa ṇir gsol ba btab pas/ rmi lam du lung bstan byung nas/ dpal o rgyan du phyin/ lung bstan dang mthun pa'i rnal 'byor ma dang mjal nas/ de'i khol po lo gsum byas te dka' ba spyad pa las/ khyod ci 'dod gsung*/ 'dod bya med de/

bdag khyed la gus pas bkur bsti byed pa lags zhes zhus/ de bzhin du lo drug dang dgu'i mthar yang de dang 'dra/ lo bcu gnyis kyi mthar/ khyod dngos grub ci 'dod gsung ba la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mi 'gal zhing*/ bdud dang mu stegs mod la tshar gcod pa'i thabs cig zhu byas pas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bskur zhing rgyud rtog pa bdun pa gnang ngo*/ / rnal 'byor ma de'i mtshan ni bde ba'i spyan ldan zhes zer/ de nas rtog bdun dar dkar po la ra'i 'o mas bris te bsnams/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis snying khrag phyung ba snyam byed kyang*/ slob dpon rkang mgyogs grub pas rjes ma zin par rang gnas su sleb/ sngar gyi mu stegs de dag thams cad tshar bcad/ ces zer ro/ / 'dir sgeg pa'i rdo rje zer/ rol pa dang sgeg pa don gcig par bsams nas/ la li ta sgeg par bsgyur bar snang yang*/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba gzhan dang 'khrul gzhi 'byung bas/ sgeg pa'i rdo rjer bsgyur ba mi legs shing*/ der ma zad la li ta rol pa la gtso bor 'jug cing*/ sgeg pa'i skad dod gtso bor la syā'am/ bi la syā yin pa dang*/ rol pa'i don rtsed mo'am/ gang 'dod dang ci gar rang nyams su yod pa'i don yin/ sgeg pa ni cha byad spros pa bskyed pa'i don yin pas tshig don gnyis kar nas cung zad mi 'dra'o/ / lī la dang*/ la li ta yang don cig mod kyi/ ming 'dogs tha dad du byung zhing*/ skyo ba'i lugs kyi lī la pa de yang*/ nag po skor gsum gyi rgyud spyan 'dren pa po yin par 'dod pa'i phyir la li ta badzra nyid yid dgos pas/ lī la badzra zhes 'bod pa cung zad mi legs so/ / slob dpon 'di'i rjes su lo brgya lhag tsam gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor ha cang mang por mched pa med/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis kyang ci rigs par gsungs shing*/

la li ta'i brgyud 'dzin dang*/ ye shes zhabs kyi brgyud 'dzin rnams gcig tu 'dres te shin du dar bar gyur to/ / de dag ni gtso bor nag po'i skor byung tshul yin la/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud ni/ grub thob bi rū pas spyan drangs par kun tu grags na/ de la'ang rgyud le'u nyer gnyis par grags pa 'di ni bi rū pa kho nas spyan drangs par nges shing*/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje dmar po'i rgyud 'di ni/ slob dpon la li ta badzra gyis kyang spyan drangs par mngon te/ rgyas bsdus cung zad ma gtogs nag po'i rgyud nyid 'don pa spos pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis kyang rgyud 'di la brten nas bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs mdzad/ bod kyi brgyud pa 'dod lugs la/ birwa ḍombhi dpal 'dzin zer ba'ang yod pa ni/ gshed dmar lugs thams cad gcig tu bsgril ba'i dbang du byas par 'dugayang rdo rje 'chang ye shes mkha' 'gro dpal 'dzin zer ba ni nye brgyud kyi dbang du byas pa yin/ don la bram ze dpal 'dzin de ni/ birwa ḍombhi'i brgyud pa mi 'dzin/ la li ta dang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi brgyud 'dzin kho na yin pas/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i sgrub dkyil yang slob dpon de gnyis kyi dgongs 'dus yin pa'i phyir/ la li tas de spyan ma drangs na/ de las byung ba'i man ngag yin pa mi 'thad do snyam pa ni/ kho bo'i rnam par rtog pa'o/ / rgyud de'i le'u dang po la brten nas/ birwas sgrub thabs mdzad pa'i phyir/ yongs su grags pa dang mthun par bi rū pas kyang spyan drangs par yang bya mod/ rgyud gcig nyid grub thob du mas spyan drangs pa mi 'gal lo/ / grub thob bi rū pa yang rags rtsis su na slob dpon la li ta badzra dang dus mnyam la/ lo grangs cung zad kyis snga ba tsam ni yin srid do/ / 'dir birwa ḍombhi'i rnam thar lo rgyus sbyar bar bya ste/

gzhan du gsal lo/ / de ltar dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi rgyud thams cad/ bram ze dpal 'dzin la bka' babs te/ sngon gyi slob dpon la li ta dang*/ bar du sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang*/ tha mar slob dpon dpal 'dzin te/ 'di gsum la dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdo rje slob dpon zhes grags shing*/ las dang po pa la bskyed rim kho na bsngags pa sogs bskyed rim phrin las dang bcas pa'i bka' babs yin/ zab gsal gnyis med lhun grub kyi dgongs pa sogs bka' babs dang dgongs pa yang gcig go / de la slob dpon dpal 'dzin ni rgyal po dharma pā la'i sku tshe'i mjug gi cha tsam la/ yul ma ga dhar bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas sgra tshad sogs rig pa du ma la mkhas par byas/ dpal o tan ta pu rir rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ sde snod gsum la'ang mkhas par mdzad nas/ mar me mdzad bzang po la lung thob tsam byas te/ dpal sde sogs ye shes zhabs kyi slob rgyud slob dpon 'ga' re bsten nas/ gsang 'dus dang gshin rje gshed kyi dgongs pa thugs su chud de dpal gshin rje gshed rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas ye shes chen po la dbang*/ sems can gyi don mdzad par bzhed de/ nus pa nyams sad pa'i phyir nags tshal rnams su rgyu zhing gshegs/ bse ru dang ma he dang stag rnams la sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa tsam gyis shi lta stangs mdzad pa tsam gyis gsos/ yang ting nge 'dzin tsam gyis shing thog la sogs pa'i khu bcud lhung bzed du bsdus te gsol bas/ de dag rad rad por 'gyur zhing*/ se gol gtogs pa na sngar bzhin gsos par gyur to/ / de nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud be darbar byon pa na/ dge slong sde snod gsum pa chos smra ba rtsod pa'i khyu mchog gcig yod pa des rtsod pas/ yul der mu stegs 'gribs so/ / der bram ze'i rigs kyi rgyal po ha sa de ba zhes bya ba log pa la mngon par zhen pas/ dge slong de'i mgo gcod pa'i grabs byed pa na/

slob dpon 'di der byon te/ 'jig rten la phan par byed pa ni sangs rgyas pa'i chos yin na/ chos de 'dzin pa'i mgo gcod du rung ngam ma gcod cigangs 'di la rin sbyin no gsung*/ rgyal po na re/ 'o na mgo bos mgo bo bslu ba yin pas/ khyod nyid kyi mgo bo blang ngo zer/ slob dpon nyid kyi dbu bcad de rgyal po la byin/ dge slong de thar bar byas so/ / de nas de dang nye ba na mchod sbyin gyi khang pa zhig 'dug pa'i tsa na/ ma he'i mgo zhig 'dug pa blangs te bslan pas/ slob dpon ma he'i dbu can du gyur/ zla ba gsum du de ltar 'dug cing 'gro 'ong mdzad pa las/ de'i rjes su res ni stag dang*/ res bya kang ka dang*/ res rta la sogs pa nyin re bzhin dbu mi 'dra ba'i cho 'phrul bstan/ skye bo rnams ngo mtshar du gyur cing*/ mu stegs pa mang po'ang sangs rgyas pa la bkod/ de nas lan cig rgyal po de lam du song bas/ slob dpon khyi'i dbu can du 'dug pa mthong*/ der zhe sdang gis khyi khyi zhes byas so/ / slob dpon gyis khyod nyid khyi'o zhes sdigs 'dzub bstan pas/ rgyal po nyid khyir gyur to/ / de nas slob dpon gyi dbu sngon bzhin du rnal mar gyur/ phyogs der re shig mu stegs rmeg med par song*/ rgyal po na ra ba ti tsa la zhes pa cig gis kyang gtam de thos nas zhabs la btud do/ / phyi nas de lta bu'i snyan pa'i grags pas khyab pas/ yul dbus kyi rgyal pos spyan drangs te/ bi kra ma shī la'i sngags pa slob dpon mdzad/ de skabs kyi rgyal po ma he pā la yin pa 'dra'o/ / der bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ gdug pa can mang po btul ba dang*/ chang 'o mar bsgyur ba dang*/ dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba sogs kyi lo rgyus mang du yod par gda'/ de nas dben khang gcig tu ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing bzhugs/ tho rangs cig mchog gtor rnams phyi rol tu skyel bar byon pas/

rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba cig sgo drung na 'dugade ni slob dpon nag po spyod pa ba yin/ de la phyag mdzad pas rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i rig sngags kyi lung stsal te mi snang bar gyur/ nang du bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nub byang na/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma dngos su bzhugs 'dugade nas mi ring bar slob dpon 'ja' lus su gshegs te/ thun mong tsam ma yin mchog rang brnyes par grags so/ / yang zhal gzigs yin na ma gtogs/ ga ya dha ra'i bla ma dpal 'dzin dang 'di mi gcig par mngon pas de nas spyod pa ba la brgyud pa 'ded na/ bar der brgyud pa gcig gnyis dgos pa 'dra'o/ / slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi rjes de nas kyang mi rabs gcig tsam song ba na/ slob dpon ka ma la rakṣi ta byon/ gtso bor gshin rje gshed dgra nag la grub pa brnyes pa yin/ de yang ma ga dhar 'khrungs/ rigs tshong ba/ rten dge slong*/ grub mtha' rnam rig pa/ phar phyin dang*/ gsang 'dus dang*/ gshin rje gshed la mkhas/

lho phyogs ang dā gi ri zhes bya ba'i ri zhig la bzhugs nas/ lo bcu gnyis bsgoms/ dang por sdug bsngal dang*/ 'jigs pa la sogs pa bar chad sna tshogs byung yang*/ stong nyid dang lha bsgoms pas zhi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi zhal gzigs/ de phyin chad phra ma rnams thogs pa med par grub/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa nyin re bzhin zhal gzigs shing*/ chos gsan par yang grags/ gong bu dgug pa dang*/ rkang pa dgug pa dang*/ khrag dgug pa dang*/ chang dgug pa sogs la thogs pa med/ gtam rgyud dmigs gsal re re yang yod par 'dugabi kra ma shī la'i sngags pa slob dpon yang mdzad/ rgyal po sha mu pā la'i dus tsam yin par mngon/ der bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams/ de yan chad dge slong bsod snyoms pa'i spyod pa can yin/ de nas dge slong gi rtags dang ni ldan bsod snyoms pa'i brtul bzhugs spangs te sngags kyi spyod pa can du gyur/ lan cig ma ga dha'i yul mtha' dur khrod cig tu tshogs 'khor rgya chen po mdzad par bzhed/ de'i dus na nub phyogs karṇa'i yul na kla klo'i rgyal po zhig yod/ de'i dmag dpon gcig 'khor rta ba dang*/ glang po pa lnga brgya tsam dang bcas dmag jag la 'ongs/ yul dang lha khang 'ga' zhig bcom ste log 'ongs pa dang*/ slob dpon 'khor bcas tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad du ma dang bcas te byon pa phrad/ de dag gis rol mo brdungs/ mtshon ma 'phangs/ 'joms par brtsams pa la/ slob dpon gyis bum pa sa la brdabs pas skad cig la rlung nag byung mi rta glang po rnams bsgyel/ mi nag po ral gri thogs pas brdeg pa'i snang ba shar/ dmag dpon ni de nyid du khrag skyugs te shi gzhan rnams la yang rims nad kyis btab ste/ gcig ma gtogs yul du ma sleb skad/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bi kra ma la rtsod pa byed pa'i mu stegs pa'i paṇḍi ta brgyad kyi ngag mnan/ byad ma byed pa bcu drug tsam sngags dang sbyin sreg gis bsgral ba sogs kla klo dang mu stegs can thams cad shin tu skrag par mdzad do/

/ mthar nags tshal dben pa zhig tu gcig pur bzhugs/ dngos grub chen po rnams kyang 'grub rung gi sgrub pa po zhig yin no/ / dus lnga pa cha shas la spyod pa'i dus ni mtshams de dag nas da lta'i bar ro/ / mkhas pa sgo drug gi dus tsam na ye shes lha'i las tshogs gzhan rnams dang*/ rdzas kyi dngos grub rnams mi 'grub pa ma yin yang*/ yun ring por sgrub dgos pa'am/ dka' spyad chen pos bsgrub dgos pa las/ gzhan thams cad pas gshin rje gshed myur zhing*/ dmar nag sogs las kyang rdo rje 'jigs mdzad myur bar byung bas/ 'jigs mdzad la brten nas ro langs dang*/ rdzas kyi dngos grub 'grub pa dang*/ las bzhi thogs med du 'grub pa shin tu mang bar byung ngo*/ / gshed skor bod du 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos mdzad pa po la li ta chung ba dang*/ a mo gha bar pa dang*/ li la badzra dang*/ zhi ba ye shes dang*/ 'jam dpal ye shes sogs kyang skabs der byung zhing*/ gzhan yang nus mthu can ches mang ba byung ngo*/ / rtog pa bdun pa yang ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rgyud 'gran zla med par mnga' gsol zhing*/ glegs bam tshar re 'bri ba la yang gser srang bcu'i yon du chad byas skad/ de nas gzung lo brgya tsam rgya gar du mchog tu dar la/ bal bo'i yul du yang de dang mthun pa'i tshul gyis bar skabs der shin tu dar zhing phan stobs che'o/ / de rjes slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i dus tsam na/ dgra nag dar ba yod/ 'jigs mdzad kyi chos skor rnams btsal rnyed tsam las med/ gdong drug gi rgyud ni zhar byung tsam ma gtogs de'i snga rol nas kyang ha cang dar ba ma byung ba 'dra'o/ / de rjes rgyal po sya na bzhi'i ring la/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i skor rnams dar bar byung*/ rdzogs 'phreng gi nang gi de dang*/ sgrub thabs phra mo'i rigs ma gtogs/ nag 'jigs skor rnams nub pa bzhin du song skad/ rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi chos skor nub pa nas/

yul dbus su kla klo zhugs pa 'dra ba cig byung skad pas/ kla klo lha min gyi gnyen po mchog ni/ spyir khro rgyal ya mān ta ka dang*/ sgos su 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad nyid mthar thug pa yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ chos 'di rnams bod kyi phyogs 'dir ji ltar dar ba yin snyam na/ spyir bod du dar tshul dang*/ brgyud pa so so'i rim pa bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ dpal gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs thor bu pa cung zad ni chos 'go dar ba dang dus mnyam du byung*/ sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos kyang sgrub thabs mdzad par grags/ rab tu byung pa'i sde dar tsam na gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud 'gyur zhing*/ dbang bskur bshad pa man ngag lag len thams cad byung*/ gsang sngags bla med lugs kyi sgrub thabs phra mo yang mang tshad byon/ rigs sngags grub pa yang mang du byung*/ de nas snga dar phyi dar gyi bar mtshams der/ rig sngags 'chang gi dbang phyug snubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pas/ gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor mtha' yas par spel/ drag sngags kyi mthu can shin tu mang bar byung*/ chos skor rnams kyang*/ rgya gar/ bal bo/ kha che/ li yul/ rgya nag sogs nas spyan drangs pa dang*/ khyad par du zhal mthong dang*/ nyams shar gyi chos sna tshogs pa mtha' yas pa zhig go / dpal gdong drug gi rgyud sdom gsum pa 'di yang*/ snga dar gyi dus rgyal blon la gsangs te bsgyur ba'am/ bar skabs der bsgyur ba gang rung zhig yin par mngon/ 'di la phyis 'gyur gyi lo tsā ba so so'i 'gyur byang mi 'dra ba bris pa 'dra 'dug ste/ rang rang gi mos zhen gyis bris par zad/ 'gyur khyad ni gcig kyang med/ dpe rnying phal che ba na 'gyur byang yang mi gda'/ 'di dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ zla gsang pa thig le dang*/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud rtsa ba da lta yongs khyab 'di rnams la 'gyur byang nges can med de/

sngon rgyal blon la gsangs te bsgyur ba rnams/ 'gyur byang byas na bsgyur mkhan ngo shes nas/ chad pa byung dogs ma bris pa yin/ yang snga dar phyi dar gyi bar der/ khrigs ka med pas 'gyur nges shes pa la yang 'gyur byang med pa dang*/ bod rang nyid kyis brtsams pa la yang rgya gar ba'i mdzad byang dang*/ lo paṇa gyi 'gyur byang byas pa'i brtsams rgyud kyang mang du byung ba yin no/ / de lta na yang sdom gsum pa la ni snga 'gyur sogs kyi dbang bka' bshad bka' cher ma dar zhing*/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi chos skor gzhan rnams ni skabs der ma 'gyur ro/ / de rjes bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su/ bod yul dbus gtsang du dge 'dun gyi sde byung nas mi rabs gcig la nye ba na/ zhang co gru lo tsā ba shes rab bla ma byung*/ 'di lo tsā ba leng 'brog gnyis dang dus mnyam yin/ 'di'i gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud dang*/ 'jigs mdzad rtog bdun te rgyud gnyis dang*/ gshin rje gshed 'byung ba dang*/ 'jigs mdzad zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ gtor chog dang*/ li la badzra gyi lha dgu'i sgrub thabs rnams sngar ma 'gyur ba gzhi 'gyur mdzad/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bka' bshad bka' yang byung zhing*/ lhag par dgra nag la rtsal du thon pa'i man ngag dang*/ sgrub bka' shin tu dar bar mdzad do/ / de las lo grangs bco lnga'am/ nyi shu tsam gyi rjes su nag po tshul khrims rgyal bas/ nag po'i rgyud dang*/ sgrub thabs phran bcas jo bo rje la zhus nas bsgyur/ phyis shān ti bha dra la dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung 'grel rnams zhus nas gzhi 'gyur byas 'duganag tsho dang dus mtshungs rung la lo tsā ba rong zom chos bzang gis/ paṇḍi ta u pa ya shrī mi tra la zhus te/ nag 'jigs kyi rgyud gnyis dang*/ gzhung phran du ma dang*/ rtog gsum rnams bsgyur ro/ / lo tsā ba de rnams kyis bsgyur ba ni/ 'gyur snga ma la 'gyur bcos byas pa min/

rang rang gi blo'i rtsal gyis gzhi 'gyur mdzad pa'o/ / nag tsho dang*/ rom zom gyis bsgyur ba'i rjes de nas/ lo bco lnga nyi shu skor gyis 'phyi ba la/ gnyos lo tsā bas nag po skor gsum gyi chos bsgyur bshad mdzad 'dugadapal 'dzin gyis nag po'i skor sogs nag 'jigs kyi gzhung 'ga' la/ gnyos kyis 'gyur byang mthong*/ rgyud gnyos 'gyur ma mthong yang yod par ni snang ngo*/ / de dang dus mtshungs rung la/ klog skya lo tsā ba shes rab brtsegs kyis kyang nag po'i rgyud nag tsho'i 'gyur la/ 'gyur mchan mdzad do/ / des bsgyur ba nas lo sum cu tsam 'gro ba na/ rwa rdo rje grags kyis nag 'jigs kyi rgyud gnyis bsgyur bar 'dugadagra nag nag tsho 'gyur la gnyan los 'gyur mchan mdzad/ de la rwa los bcos pa yin/ rtog bdun ni zhang 'gyur dang mthun shas che bar 'dug pas/ de la 'gyur bcos mdzad par gsal lo/ / de dang dus mtshungs par nag po'i rgyud la zangs kar gyi 'gyur chung dang*/ rtog bdun la bu rangs pa khyung po chos brtson gyi 'gyur byung ngo*/ / rwa lo las dus bag tsam gyis 'phyi ba la/ paṇḍi ta a mo gha badzra chung ba bod du phebs/ de la skyo 'od 'od 'byung gis zhus te skyo lugs byung*/ a mo gha de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung chung sogs man ngag gi gzhung thor bu tsam gsar du bsgyur yod/ rgyud gzhung che ba'i rigs la gzhi 'gyur dang 'gyur chung gang yang ma mdzad do/ / de dang dus mnyam par ba ri lo tsā bas paṇḍi ta de nyid la zhus te rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi rgyud gzhung chos skor mang du bsgyur bar grags/ 'dis bha ro phyag sdum la yang zhus 'dugade las cung zad 'phyi ba la/ mal gyo lo tsā ba blo gros grags kyis bal bo ha du dkar po la nag 'jigs skor gsum zhus/ nag po'i rgyud ni snga sor du klog skya la'ang zhus par sems/ rtog bdun khyung po chos brtson gyi 'gyur la mal los 'gyur chung mdzad do/

/ mal lo'i dus de tsam na rgya gar na dgra nag dar rab yod/ 'jigs mdzad btsal rnyed las med/ bal yul na nag 'jigs gnyis kar dar ba yod 'dugade phyin chad nag 'jigs kyi rgyud la 'gyur bcos byed mkhan ma byung ba 'dra zhing*/ lo paṇa sdebs pa'i lugs srol dbang bshad man ngag gsar pa'ang ma byung bar snang ngo*/ kha ba can gyi phyogs 'dir 'jigs mdzad kyi chos skor snga phyi thams cad du dar rgyas che/ dgra nag kyang sngon gsang sngags dar rgyas che ba'i skabs/ ci rigs par dar/ gdong drug la rwa chen pos bshad pa mang rab mdzad pas/ yig sna bsdus don sogs yod/ gzhan dbang bka' tsam las bshad pa dang*/ ngan ngag dar rgyas cher ma byung ngo*/ / gdong drug gi rgyud la 'gyur yang gcig las med/ dgra nag la zhang nag tsho klog skya gu ru ba gnyan rwa 'gyur rnams mthong la/ gnyos zangs kar sogs gzhan yang mang du yod par ni snang ngo*/ / rtog pa bdun pa'i rgyud la ni/ co gru shes rab bla ma/ gyi jo/ rong zom/ khu ston dngos grub/ rwa lo/ ba ri lo tsā/ mal lo/ paṇḍi ta sa man shrī'i 'gyur te 'gyur brgyad yod ces sngon dus grags la/ phyis skyi rong lo tsā ba ngag dbang gis/ co gru rong zom rwa lo ba ri bzhi/ sngar gyi brgyad la mi the ba btsad po mu ne rā dza'i 'gyur dang*/ 'gyur byang ma thebs pa yang gnyis mthong gsung bas 'jigs mdzad kyi skor 'di la thams cad kyi rtsis su byas pa'i phyir 'gyur byed lo tsā ba ches mang ba byung rigs su 'dug/ zhang 'gyur la sngags btu tshig lhug pa dang*/ rwa 'gyur la tshigs bcad mar yod/ 'gyur cig la rgyud yongs rdzogs tshigs bcad du byas pa'ang yod/ gzhan dpe rnying yin yang 'gyur phan tshun 'dres pa ni mang du snang ngo*/ / de nas phyis ni zhang gnyos rwa skyo mal te lugs lnga po de las rgyud pa la/ nag 'jigs skor gsum ci rigs pa yod pa'i dbang du byas nas/ so so'i lugs ma 'dres par 'dzin pa dang*/

de dag phan tshun ci rigs par bsres te byed pa dang*/ brgyud pa ni de dag gang rung gcig la ded nas/ gang rnyed thams cad legs bsdus byed pa'am/ rgya gzhung gcig gi rjes su 'brangs nas lag len byed pa sogs nges med sna tshogs byung ba la/ yi ge rtsom pa po de dang de'i lugs so zhes rab tu grags par gyur la/ dag ma dag kyang sna tshogs su snang ngo*/ / dmar po'i chos skor la/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i nang na lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs cig yod/ de tsam ma gtogs/ gong du smos pa'i lo tsā ba de rnams kyi skabs su 'gyur ba med cing*/ mal lo 'das nas lo lnga bcu tsam song ba tsam na/ bla ma dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi dpal bzang pos/ rdo rje gdan pa ni ska lang ka la zhus/ lha lnga'i dbang dang man ngag lag len cha tshang bar yod/ byin rlabs shin tu che/ birwa pa'i sgrub thabs che chung*/ gtor chog che chung*/ 'khrul 'khor 'phreng ba/ dus 'khor lugs kyi 'khrul 'khor sogs bsgyur/ rdzogs rim gyi 'khrid ni med/ spros med 'grel pa dpyal los mdzad zer ba gcig yod de/ phyis kyi kha 'phangs su ka snang*/ de dang dus mnyam rung las cung zad 'phyi bar/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i slob ma/ paṇḍi ta dā na shī las bi rū pa dang*/ dpal 'dzin gyis gzhung mang po rang 'gyur mdzad/ dbang bka' yang bcu gsum ma dang*/ lha lnga gnyis ka byung mod/ phyis 'ga' zhig lha lnga kho na'i zer ba ni/ rang gis ma mthong ba rgyu mtshan du bkod pa'o/ / rdzogs rim gyi 'khrid tshul ci rigs par yod kyang*/ spros med dang rnal 'byor bzhi rim ni de dus ma 'gyur ro/ / de'i rjes su lo nyi shu tsam song ba na/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal gyis/ bi rū pa dang dpal 'dzin dang*/ blo gros bzang po sogs kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung mang du bsgyur/ lugs gnyis ka'i dbang bka' dang lag len dar rgyas su mdzad/ rdzogs rim ni/ rim pa lnga'i dag sbyor tsam gyi rdzogs rim ma gtogs/

'khrid tshul rgyas pa'i lag len ni med do/ / de las cung zad 'phyi bar glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis/ chag lo'i bla ma ra benda pa la yang thugakhyad par du darpan ā tsarya spyan drangs te birwa pa'i spros med/ dpal 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor bzhi rim sogs gzhung phran gsar pa mang du bsgyur zhing*/ rdzogs rim gyi man ngag 'khrid tshul khyad par can mtha' rgyas su byung*/ chag lugs kyi skor rnams sngar nas khong rang la bzhugs/ 'gyur bcos ni ma mdzad do/ / de ltar na dpyal lo/ dā na shī la/ chag lo/ glo bo lo tsā ba ste bzhi po des gshed dmar gyi dbang man ngag lag len rnams mtha' rgyas su mdzad cing*/ thams cad byin rlabs kyi bka' dang ldan pa yin mod kyi/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud ni spyan ma drangs pa las/ glo bo lo tsā ba sku 'das pa tsam gyi dus na/

yar lungs lo tsā ba shud ke grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu yod pa 'di bsgyur/ khong pa la dbang dang rgyud bshad gnyis kar bzhugs par 'dugade dang dus mtshungs rung du shong blo brtan gyis kyang rgyud de bsgyur 'dug ste 'gyur shud ke cung zad legs so/ / 'di la rgya gar gyi 'grel pa ni ma 'gyur/ bod kyi yig sna rnying pa'ang cher med pa 'dra'o/ / gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud le'u nyer gnyis yod pa 'di ni/ slob dpon dharma kirti bar grags pa/ kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang gi phyag tu rgya dpe byung nas/ mkhas mchog bu ston rin po che'i phyag tu phul nas bsgyur bar zhus/ 'gyur yang mdzad/ 'gyur bzang zhing legs pa yin yang*/ rgya dpe de'i skabs shig na/ ma dpe 'khrugs pa las bshus pa'i tshig 'khrugs 'dug pa/ bod skad la yang 'khrugs pa'i rgyun de ka 'dugaphyis rgya gar paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen bod du byon dus/ rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa shud ke 'gyur la/ yid bzang rtse pas 'gyur bcos mdzad 'duganags rin la rgyud 'di'i dbang bshad man ngag rdzogs par bzhugs kyin yod gda' na'ang*/ yid bzang rtse ba dang*/ khrims khang lo tsā ba sogs ni bod kyi phyag chen pa'i zhes ske chad chad 'then pa la yengs nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la phan pa'i chos de dag zhu ba ma byung ba 'dugami g.yo ba bla med kyi rgyud la'ang dbang tsam ma gtogs de dang 'dra ba cig ka byung ngo*/ / 'on kyang rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa ni gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud dang*/ birwa pa'i gzhung rnams shes na/ rgyud don phal cher go bar nus la/ nyer gnyis pa 'di ni/ tshig don tsam zhal gsal bar 'dug mod/ 'on kyang bla ma'i zhal lung med par/ rang gar 'chad pa ni mi rung ngo*/ / //da ni gshin rje gshed skor la brgyud pa so so'i rim pa brjod na/

dgra gdong 'j-igs gsum gyi chos skor thog mar bsgyur zhing*/ srol brtod mkhan zhang lugs par grags pa rnams lo rgyus 'di skad ces 'chad de/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdo rje slob dpon lha sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs de/ 'jam dpal zhi khro dang gnyis su med pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa lta bu yin/ des mar me mdzad bzang po la gnang*/ 'di dang la li ta chen po gnyis kyi lo rgyus 'khrul gzhi cung zad byung*/ de la li ta badzra ram/ mtshan gzhan li la badzra gyis zhus/ 'dis rgyud rdo rje 'chang zhal gzigs nus pa thogs pa med/ dgra nag gi rgyud kyi don 'grel du gshin rje gshed 'byung pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/ 'jigs mdzad zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs kyang 'dis mdzad pa yin/ zhang pa rnams slob dpon 'dis nag 'jigs skor gsum gyi rgyud rnams spyan drangs par 'dod mod/ slob dpon 'di ni sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi yang slob tu zhang lugs par rang 'dod pa bzhin du/ don la'ang gnas par mngon pas/ la li ta chung ba rang yin zhing*/ rgyud spyan 'dren pa po ni la li ta chen po yin pas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs las kyang*/ mi rabs bzhi lnga tsam gyis snga bar byon no/ / zhes go bar bya'o/ /li la badzra de'i slob ma ni/ sau su ra ba yin te/ 'khrungs yul shar phyogs kā ma ru pa/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud mtha' dag la mkhas shing*/ gshin rje gshed la grub pa brnyes pa yin no/ / de'i slob ma ni gu ru se na pa yin/ mdo rgyud kun la mkhas shing sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad/ de'i slob ma a pa li na pa yin te/ 'khrungs sa kha che ba yin/ rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub brnyes/ de'i slob ma gu na ā ka ra bha dra yin/ yul shar phyogs bha land+re ba/ mkhas pa chen po sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas pa/ de'i slob ma ni ngag dbang grags pa yin te/ 'khrungs yul dza gad dha da la ba/ ra dha'i rgyal po'i bla mar gyur/

sgrol ma dang spyan ras gzigs zhal gzigs/ che ba'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' zer te/ mkhas pa sgo drug gi nang tshan ngag dbang grags pa ka yin nam sems/ ye shes zhabs nas de'i bar thams cad rab byung gi cha byad du bzhugs/ de'i slob ma de ba ā ka ra tsand+ra yin te/ paṇḍi ta dkar po yin/ yul ma ga dha ru 'khrungs/ dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus sogs rgyud thams cad la mkhas/ gshin rje gshed la nus pa thob/ yul ra ra na klu gdug pa can gnas pa'i mtsho zhig yod pa/ skabs skabs lud nas grong khyer dang zhing la gnod pa cher 'byung ba zhig yod pa la/ lta stangs mdzad de gnad la phab pas/ klu de thul nas phyin chad mtsho lud pa'i gnod pa ma byung*/ bskam yang ma bskam/ zhing la phan pa cig yod zer/ yang brgyud yig 'ga' zhig na/ 'jam dbyangs ye shes zhabs dang mar me mdzad/ / rab 'gying rdo rje bde sbyin se na pa/ / mkha' lding zhabs dang yon tan 'byung gnas bzang*/ / ngag dbang grags pa lha 'byung zla ba dang*/ / zer ba yod de/ sau su ra ba dang bde sbyin zhabs gciga.a ba li dang mkha' lding zhabs gcig pas/ don la khyad med do/ / de ba ā ka ra la zhang gis gsan te/ de yang 'bring mtshams pa zhang co gru shes rab bla ma bya ba/ 'chims phu bka' phyogs pa bya ba'i sngags rnying ma pa'i sde la zhugs/ mdo sgyu sems gsum/ mgon po beng ma dang*/ mdor mgon sogs kyang mkhyen/ bo dong gi 'bal shākya rdo rje la yo ga yang bslabs/ mtshan nyid kyi gzhung yang mang du mkhyen/ gsang 'dus gsan par bzhed kyang*/ de tsa na gsang sngags gsar ma shin tu bka' dogs pas/ dpe 'dra g.yar ba las chos bka' thob pa ma byung nas/ bal bor byon nas lo gnyis tsam sgra la sbyangs/ de nas rgya gar ma ga dhar byon/ jo bo de ba ā ka ra tsand+ra la gsang 'dus rdzogs par gsan/ dus 'khor yang ji rigs pa gsan/ khyad par nag 'jigs skor gsum dgyes phyin par gsan cing*/ rtags mtshan dpag tu med par byung*/

byin rlabs kyi bka' babs/ de'i nang nas kyang dgra nag nyid khyad du thon par grags so/ / phyis bod du phebs pa'i a mo gha badzra ya/ jo bo de ba ā ka ra'i slob ma paṇa chung cig yod/ lo tsā ba dang de dus mched grogs yin/ de nas jo bo de ba ā ka ra bod du spyan drangs/ bal bod mtshams su jag pa byung ba la/ paṇḍi tas sa gtor bas jag pa thams cad rengs/ de rjes lo paṇa lhan cig tu dbus gtsang du 'gro don cher mdzad nas/ gzhong stag rtse phug mo cher spyan drangs te/ chos mang du bsgyur/ paṇḍi ta bal yul du bskyal/ de nas sngon gyi bla ma dang*/ mched po kun 'das te mi bzhugs pas thugs shin tu skyo ste/ dpyal byang chub 'byung gnas de gzhon nu'i dus kyi bla ma yin/ de dus khong mi bzhugs kyang*/ de'i sras se rtsarma ru spran drangs te/ 'jam dpal nam mkha' dri med la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan/ phyis paṇḍi ta de ba rā dza la/ mtshan brjod kyi chos skor sgrub rgyud dang bcas pa dang*/ a mo gha badzra bod du phebs pa la yang*/ rgyud kyi 'gyur bcos dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi skor sogs man ngag 'ga' re dang*/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon shes rab gsang ba zhes bya ba ā tsarya dmar por yang grags/ lwa ba dmar po can du grags pa de la/ phyag rgya chen po'i thig le dang*/ bka' srung re ma tī/ dmag zor gyi skor dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi man ngag zab mo mang du gsan/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyil 'khor yang yang zhal gzigs/ dmag zor rgyal mo dang*/ legs ldan nag po bran du 'khol/ mthu stobs thogs pa med/ 'bring mtshams ral gsum du gtsug lag khang du ma bzhengs/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi grwa ba sprin bzhin 'dus/ 'bring 'tshams kyi zhang zhes bod kyi mi chen bzhi'i gya gcig tu bgrang ba yang 'di nas byung*/ mi rabs bdun gyi bar du thams cad nga'i rjes su bde bar 'gro zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin/

phyis gdung las chad pa la stod smad tsho du mar gyes kyang*/ thams cad la bdun brgyad kyi bar du sngags pa dang*/ dge bshes ngo mtshar can sha stag byon/ dpyal lo chen por grags pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis kyang*/ lo tsā ba 'di la nag 'jigs skor gsum rdzogs par zhus/ sku'i sras bzhi ste/ saṅgha bha dra/ dharma siddhi/ dzñā na garbha/ ratna ke tu rnams yin pa las/ phyi ma gnyis la rgyud 'dzin med/ che ba dge 'dun bzang po la lha rje sang por grags/ 'di yab kyi chos thams cad la shin tu mkhas shing yi dam zhal gzigs/ yul lha sde brgyad phal cher dam la thogs/ yab kyi dus thugs dam mgron lha'i gtsug lag khang gzhi 'dings pa tsam las ma grub pa la/ 'dis mgron lha byams kyi gtsug lag khang bya ba/ rdor dbyings dang*/ 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa mtha' yas bzhugs pa'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ gsang sngags kyi sde chen po tshugs/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa sku mched kyis kyang 'jam dpal zhi khro'i chos skor rnams gsan cing shin tu gus par mdzad do/ / lha rje sang po la sras lnga byon pa las che shos tsang thang 'od po dang*/ chung shos rdo rje rtse mo gnyis mkhas grub mchog tu gyur pa byon/ gcen gyis khyung po grags seng dang*/ gcung gis gsang phur zhang tshes dang*/ stod lung du rgya mar ba la gtugs te/ mdo lugs kyang mkhas par mkhyen pa yin pa 'dugade dag las gyes pa'i dge bshes sngags mkhan shin tu mang yang*/ 'dir rgyas par 'bri mi lang*/ cog rabs rin chen 'phreng ba sogs na gsal bar yod/ lha rje sang po'i sras gnyis pa skyi tsha 'od chen gyi sras zhar lo mya ngan med pa'i dpal yin/ de'i dbon po zhang byang chub rin chen yin te/ rten tshangs spyod/ dge bsnyen shin tu phrin las che/ zhang lo tsā ba'i sras dharma siddhi nas brgyud pa ni zhang ban dpe ba'i phyogs yin la/ zhang sgom ri bar grags pa de yang 'di'i rgyud la byung*/

khyad par zhang rnal 'byor gzungs zhes bya ba'i sras/ zhang ston 'brug sgra rgyal mtshan yin/ slob stod sgrub pa 'od dang*/ yab mes dngos grub rgyal mtshan dang*/ byang chub rin chen sogs la gtugs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gsung dngos su byon/ sgog thang gi phra men ma btul/ nus mthu shin tu che/ bstan pa srung bar mdzad nas/ de dus rgyal khrims med pas bod sil bu yin yang*/ nyin mo lag rtags bstan pa dang*/ mtshan mo skad thos pas sus kyang 'da' mi nus/ 'bring 'tshams la lam rgya yang mdzad/ lcen lung mkhar rnga'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bka' bshad bka' man ngag gi bka' thams cad shin tu dar bar mdzad/ yang zhang byang chub rin chen gyi slob ma shes rab rdo rje dang*/ shes rab 'byung gnas sku mched kyi slob ma zhang rin chen 'od zer ba yin/ 'dir mkhar rnga dgon gsar btab/ rten dge slong yin/ gzhan phan shin tu che/ yang zhang 'brug sgra rgyal mtshan gyi sras zhang rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs kyang chos kyi phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo*/ / brgyud yig ni logs su yod do/ /da ni rwa lugs pa rnams kyi bzhed pa bshad de/ slob dpon chen po la li ta badzra la/ a mo gha badzra chen pos thug gsung ste/ de ni dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po dang mi lab pa bzhin du bzhugs gsung*/ rgya gar du grags pa la li ta'i dngos slob kyi gsal kha rang med/ ma la ba'i yul du kla klo'i grong lnga stong tsam yod pa la/ grong bskrad pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pas/ yul de'i rgyal po khros nas/ de thams cad rgya mtsho'i gling phran zhig tu bskrad par grags/ la li ta mi yul na bzhugs pa'i dus kyi dngos slob yin na/ rgyal po de yang rgyal po brta ha ri yin par byed dgos/ phyis zhal gzigs yin na nges pa med/ rgya gar gyi gtam rgyud cig la/ rgyal po mahā pā la'i dus su/ a mo gha chen po byung*/

des sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la 'grel chen byas zer ba yod ces bla ma gsung ste/ de lta na yul ma la ba'i rgyal po de yang rā ma yuddha yin par mngon no/ / gang ltar yang a mo gha chen po la ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa'i dpal gyis gsan/ de la slob dpon padma badzra bya bas gsan/ slob dpon 'di ni pha mas btags pa'i ming rā ma pā la/ slob gnyer byas pa'i ming a bhi dzukta/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan shrī rakṣi ta/ gsang mtshan padma badzra yin gsung ba 'dugayi ge rnying pa rnams na/ o rgyan pa yin gsung ba 'dug na'ang*/ yig nor brgyud pa 'dra/ slob dpon 'di 'khrungs sa o ḍi bi sha ba yin/ o ḍi ba o rgyan par 'khrul ba yin nam snyam mo/ / slob dpon de gnyis kyis kyang*/ rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po zhal gzigs/ bla ma de la bla ma bha ro phyag sdum dang*/ me tsa ling pa gnyis kyis zhus/ bha ro phyag sdum la paṇḍi ta 'jam pa'i dbyangs zer/ 'khrungs yul bal bo/ rigs bram ze/ dang po phyi pa yin/ rgyal po'i chad pa byung bas/ phyag g.yon sdum po yin/ rgya gar du byon nas mu stegs kyi lha drag po mang po bsgom bsgrub byas nas rgyal po 'dul bar bsams kyang*/ khong rang smyo bas sdug bsngal bar yod pa la/ slob dpon padma badzra gyis bum chus bkrus pas smyo ba bsangs/ nang pa la mos te chos kyi sgor zhugs/ nag po skor gsum la mkhas/ sgrub pa ring du mdzad pas/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad zhal gzigs/ nus pa thogs med mnga'/ rwa los gzigs pa la yang*/ khong gi g.yog po dang*/ mtha' 'khob rgyal phran cig 'khrugs/ rgyal po des dmag byed par brtsams/ 'khor dang nye du kun gyis bros pa drag zhus kyang*/ rgyal po kho nga la gus pa btud du 'ong gsung*/ zhag shas cig su yang ma byung*/ de nas nyin cig rgyal po de 'khor bcas 'ongs/ 'bul ba chen po byas/ zhabs spyi bor blangs te/ slob dpon 'dis dbang dang dgug pa'i las 'grub pa'i rtags so/

/ me tsa ling ba'ang bal bo ka yin/ dus de tsa na bal bo'i ya rabs dra ma rnams la bha ro zer bas/ slob dpon 'di la'ang bha ro zhes 'bod pa'i skabs yod pas/ bha ro zhes pa'i ming tsam la 'khrul nas/ phyag sdum dang 'di gnyis gcig par 'dod pa ni shin tu blun no/ / rab tu byung ba'i mtshan dngos dī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta/ thugs rgyud 'jam zhing 'gro phan shin tu che bas bla dwags kyi mtshan thugs rje chen po/ bzhugs gnas dgon pa me tsa ling yin pas/ me tsa ling par grags/ rten dge slong yin/ pradzñā rakṣi ta dang*/ ka na ka shrī dang*/ dharma ā ka ra ma ti dang*/ padma badzra sogs bla ma mang po bsten nas/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud grags che ba phal cher mkhyen/ yo ga la yang mkhas pa zhig yin par snang ste/ zangs kar lo tsā bas paṇḍi ta 'di la zhus nas/ yo ga smad 'grel chen mo bsgyur ba yin/ khyad par du 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed la mnga' brnyes 'jam dpal 'jigs mdzad chen po zhal gzigs/

nus mthu thogs pa med pa mnga' 'o/ / bla ma de gnyis kar la rwa lo chen pos gsan/ yang brgyud pa'i lugs gcig la/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ nag po spyod pa ba/ bha dra ba/ dha ma pa/ de ba pa/ dze tā ri pa/ a naṃ ga pa/ dharma ā ka ra ma ti/ me tsi ling pa zhes pa dang*/ yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ tilli pa/ nā ro ba/ pradzñā rakṣi ta/ thugs rje chen po zhes pa'am/ nā ro ba/ ma na ka shrī/ ka na ka shrī/ dī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta zhes 'ded pa'ang yod de/ de dag kyang*/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum dang*/ bde dgyes sogs kyi dbang du byas par 'dugagazhan yang grub thob mang po'i brgyud pa mnga' ba zhig go / bha ro phyag sdum dang*/ thugs rje chen po 'di gnyis la/ ba ri lo tsā bas kyang gtugs/ mal los kyang phyag sdum la sgrol ma'i chos skor sogs zhus/ lo rgyus de tsam ni/ khungs dang ldan zhing nor 'khrul ye med pas bkod pa yin la/ gshin rje gshed rwa lugs kyi bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis mdzad zer ba de na/ la li ta man gyi bla ma rnams la lo rgyus nyag nyog mang po 'dug kyang*/ khungs dang mi ldan zhing yid brtan thub par mi 'dug pas 'dir ma bris la/ rgya ston chen po yang gsung rab spyi la mkhas tshul rang ma bstan 'dug na'ang*/ lam 'bras dang*/ gshed skor la mkhas shing gnas lugs gzigs pa/ nus mthu brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam par 'dug pas/ rdzun po che ga la mdzad/ des na yi ge de rgya ston kyis ma mdzad par nges/ khams phyogs kyi slob ma mi mkhas pa de 'dras brtsams par mngon no/ / bla ma bha ro phyag sdum dang*/ bla ma me tsa ling pa gnyis la/ lo tsā shes pa'i slob ma rang yang mang mod kyi/ slob ma'i thu bo 'gran gyi do zla med pa ni/ 7 rje btsun rā lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags pa'o/ / bla ma de ni la stod gnya' snam gyi yul de'i nang tshan snang yul zhes par 'khrungs/

yab ni rwa dkon mchog rdo rje zhes bya ba/ sngags rnying ma ba'i rigs zhig yin/ byis pa chung ngu'i skabs shigadapal lha mo re ma tī mngon sum du byon nas/ na bza' phu rungs kyi nang du bcug ste/ spyir rgyal khams ches mang ba zhig bskor zhing yul gyi bkod pa gzigs/ khyad par mdo khams lho byang stod smad thams cad bstan/ zla ba gsum gyi bar du de ltar byung*/ nang mi rnams kyis bu stor bar thag bcad/ de nas dpal lha mos yab yum gnyis kyi khyim du bskyal ba na/ zla ba gsum po de'i ring la lo gsum gyi lus skyed byung*/ lo rgyus rnams bshad pas mi thams cad ngo mtshar che bar byed/ phyis 'gro don mdzad pa'i dus kyang*/ khams pa'i grwa rigs mang po 'dus pa la/ khyed kyi yul de ni 'di dang 'di lta bu'i zhes ri klungs chu zhing grong gi bkod pa sogs phra zhing phra ba thams cad yul so so rang gi mi bas kyang zhib par gsung ba zhig yod/ de nas sku cher skyes nas/ re zhig khyim gyi 'tsho chas dang*/ 'brog skyong ba sogs la'ang lo mang rab song*/ de nas bar skabs su thugs la dad pa 'khrungs te chos grwa 'gar byon nas/ phar phyin dang*/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos thor bu pa yang mang du gsan cing mkhyen la/ de skabs nas bla ma dang*/ mched grogs gong ma thams cad yo byad dang spyod lam dang gus pas mnyes par mdzad/ bar skabs su mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ 'jam dpal dang*/ sgrol ma sogs lhag pa'i lha'i bsnyen pa yang mang du mdzad/ dgyes rdor dang gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyang rags pa mkhyen/ de dag tu lo mang po song zhing*/ bar skabs der grogs dang nye du rnams kyis bskul nas/ 'bro jo bo padma bya ba'i bu mo zhig kyang khyim thab tu bzhes/ snang yul la sdud sgo re yang yod pa las/ mi ring pa cig na bud med des kyang mi dga' ltas te bor nas/ 'bro rje rtsad po'i bu 'dzam me zer ba cig gi sar song*/

gnya' snam yul pa dang*/ de dag gi ngan gros bshams/ yul pa rnams log ste dmag byas bkrong bar brtsams pa las/ re zhig mkhar la 'phras pas gnod ma thub/ de nas nyan tsho gnas rnying gi 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ rgya gar la gshegs par bzhed pa zhig yul der phebs pa dang mjal nas/ khong gi phyag phyi la 'brangs/ bal yul du byon/ mthu zhu bar bzhed de/ me tsa ling pa dang*/ ba ro phyag sdum la nyi ma gcig la chos sne btags/ thog ma nyid du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dbang bskur zhus/ lag len bslabs te bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa mdzad/ lo gcig lhag tsam na zhal gzigs kyi mtshan ma byung*/ las rnams 'grub nges par 'dug nas/ bod du 'gro ba'i mi 'gal la lon bskur te/ 'bro rje rtsad po dang*/ snang yul ba'i yul pa rnams la zla ba gsum gyi mthu dus btab/ drag po'i 'khor lo bskor bas zla ba gsum gyi nang du snang yul du rims nad sna ka mi 'dra ba mang po dus gcig tu byung*/ grong brgya tsam yod pa gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad stongs/ rtsad po'i bu dang*/ bud med de gnyis la tshes bcu bzhi'i nam phyed cig 'ur sgra dang bcas te lcags kyi phur pa dngos su byung ste/ dpral ba phug nas shi lo de kha'i khongs su rtsad po rang dang*/ g.yog pho mo drug cu tsam yang shi rwa nag po'i mthu ba log lta log tu grags/ de nas rwa chen pos pu rangs su mnga' bdag rtse lde la/ chos bsgyur ba'i mthun rkyen zhur byon/ gser sogs yo byad mang po rang byung ste/ slar yang bal yul du phebs/ rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du dge slong mdzad/ sngar gyi bla ma rnam gnyis dang*/ gzhan yang rgya bal gyi paṇa grub mang po bsten/ slob dpon thugs rje chen po gsang sngags kyi bang mdzod yin pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de la mdzad/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ sampu ṭi/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ he ru ka mngon byung*/ a bhi dha na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ste 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud drugagashin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/

'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ lū yi smad lnga/ nag po gzhung drugadakyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel/ sgrub thabs don gsal dang*/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i chos skor sogs rtsal du thon par sbyangs pa mdzad/ mgon nag dang par bu sogs gdams ngag phra mo mang po yang gsan/ gtum mo/ rlung sbyor/ sems 'jog gi sgom sogs zab don mang po'ang gsan/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud zhor nyan du mdzad pa'ang mang po yod gsung*/ slar yang 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub pa bskyar ma'ang mang du mdzad/ bal bor lo bco lnga tsam bzhugs/ skabs der bod la ma byon kyang*/ mnga' ris kyi rgyal po dbang phyug lde la gser slongs kyi pho nya btang ba la/ gser mang du byung bas phal cher bla ma rnams kyi zhabs tog mdzad cing*/ gdams ngag gi 'phro zhus/ gser lhag ma mang du bsnams nas/ rgya gar ma ga dhar byon/ zla ba drug tsam bzhugs/ rdo rje gdan/ bi kra ma shi la o tan ta pu ri rnams su mchod pa rgya cher mdzad/ smon lam btab/ na lan da'i lha khang thams cad la yang mchod pa mdzad/ dge 'dun ni mi bzhugs/ dkon gnyer rnams tshim par byas/ ma ga dha'i mkhas pa rnams la chos 'brel re tsam gsan pa ni mang du yod par 'dugadogs gcod kyang mang du mdzad/ 'on kyang ma ga dhar mchod pa mdzad pa yin/ thugs gnyer rang ma mdzad cis kyang grags te/ yun ring ba rang ma bzhugs pa min pa slob gnyer ni mdzad par shes so/ /de nas dbyar cig pu rangs dang*/ yar rtser byon/ rgyal po go gnyis kyang dgyes pas chos 'khor re yang mdzad/ de nas las stod la mar byon dus/ sngar gyi dgra rnams lta ci smos/ phyogs gtogs tshun chad kyang stongs nas med pas bag zon dgos pa ni gcig kyang med/ mthu bo che de byung zhes thams cad 'jigs 'jigs byed/ rnyed bkur dang chos zhu mkhan tsam ma byung*/ de nas dbus gtsang gi gzhung kun la phebs/ mthu chen gyi grags pa la brten nas sku bsod rgyas/

lha sa bsam yas gnyis su chos 'khor cung zad re yang mdzad/ lo shes song yod par 'dugapaṇḍi ta spyan drangs na 'gro phan che bar dgongs te/ mnga' ris nas de bar la phyag tu 'byor ba'i rdzas bzang rgu phar bsnams nas/ bla ma rnams la tshogs 'khor dang 'bul ba cher mdzad/ dī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta bod du spyan drangs/ grom pa man chad nas 'gro don 'ur langs/ dbus kyi lho byang thams cad dang*/ gnyal gyi bar du phebs/ chos thams cad gser chos su mdzad de/ rgyud so so'i rgyud mchod/ dbang yon/ tshogs 'khor rgyud yon sogs phar bzhagazhu rten rang la'ang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la gser srang gang*/ gzhan rnams la gser zho re re bab kyang*/ zhu ba po mi thob pa tsam byung*/ paṇḍi tas kyang bod du lo mang po ma bzhugs 'ga' zhig lo bdun/ kha cig lo lnga zer/ phar phebs dus gser srang stong phrag gcig phyag tu phul/ gla ba la sogs pa yo byad gzhan rtsis su ma btab/ yar lam la stod du'ang 'gro don cher byung*/ bal bo'i bar du skyel ma mdzad/ de rjes rwa lo chen po sku bsod shin tu rgyas/ khams stong pu bo yan chad dbus gtsang kong po/ gnyal lor/ lho brag tshun chod du lan mang du phebs/ bzhugs yul mthil ni g.yas ru nub mdar mdzad/ bla ma dī paṃ ka ra bal yul du phebs pa'i rjes su sku ma 'das kyi bar la/ snga phyir 'bul chen lan sum cu so bdun bskyal/ 'bul ba re re'i steng du res tsa du zhes bya ba btsun pa nyis brgya tsam bsags pa la/ mchod ston yon bcas re dang*/ res ha du ste sngags pa nyis brgya tsam bsags pa la tshogs 'khor yon bcas re mdzad/ bla ma bha ro phyag sdum la gser srangalnga brgya phul/ gzhan yang bka' drin che ba'i bla ma lnga tsam yod pa la'ang*/ gser srang brgya lhag re phul/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan du mchod pa'i thes la/ gser srang brgya phrag re snga phyir lan mang po dang*/ bi kra ma shī la/ o tanta pu ri/

na lan da rnams su nyi khri dang*/ brgyad stong pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang bcas pa'i 'chad nyan gyi thes dang*/ chung ba sdud pa 'chad pa'i thes sogs bstan pa nam gnas par du rgyal blon la/ zhing sa dang*/ lha 'bangs grong zhu ba sogs la/ gser srang brgya tsam nyis brgya tsam 'bul bar btang ba shin tu mang*/ bla ma la gus shing zhabs tog che ba'i tshad du bzhag pa yin/ de dag ni sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i rgyu rnams gtso bor smos pa'i skabs yin no/ /'bras bu gtso bor gyur pa'i che ba la/ lung bstan brnyes pa'i che ba/ chos gsungs pa'i che ba/ byin rlabs nus mthu'i che ba/ sku bsod nams kyi che ba/ mdzad pa phyag rgyas kyi che ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang*/ ā tsarya bo dhi satwas chos 'khor chen po bsam yas la/ ma 'ongs pa na me'i gnod pa byung ba'i tshe/ 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa dge slong zhig gis gso bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de ni/ rje btsun rwa lo 'di yin/ klu mes kyis zhig gsos cung zad mdzad pa nas/ phyi ma'i bar du zhig gsos than thun byed pa mang du byung yang*/ me'i gnod pa gsos pa 'di kho na yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ gong du smos pa de rnams las/ sngon bod du gsan pa dang*/ phyis rgya bal du yang zhor nyan tsam mdzad pa'i rigs rnams ye ma gsungs/ rgya bal gyi paṇa grub rnams kyi drung du nan tan nges tig rtsal 'don du mdzad pa rnams kho na gsungs/ lhad med yid chos can byin rlabs dang ldan pa sha stag yin/ dge bshes 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyi gsungs nas/ chos cig la dge bshes rwa ba'i chos las zhe kha gshin pa med/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub rnams 'di skad gsung bya ba las rang bzo dang*/ bod kyi sra bsre gtan nas med pas so/ / zhes gsungs/ gsum pa ni/ yi dam 'jam dpal khros pa dang mi lab pa bzhin bzhugs/ 'khor lo bde mchog dang*/

rdo rje phag mo dang*/ 'jam dpal zhi ba'i yang zhal gzigs/ bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin gsal snang can ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gog nus la brtan pa thob/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes la mnga' brnyes/ las kyi gshin rje dang*/ lang ka'i bdag po bran du 'khol/ mgon po nag po lcam dral gyis kyang gsung bzhin bsgrub/ dbang bskur tshad la ye shes phebs shing snang ba bsgyur nus/ bsam gtan gyi las bzhi yang grub/ de lta bu'i rtags ni la stod phyogs su gong du smos pa ltar rtags bstan pa dang*/ phyis ngan lam yul gyi sri mnga' dang*/ byang phyir chos gsung ba'i skabs shigangan lam nyu gu sna pa rnams kyis mthu yod med blta'o zer nas mdzo rta ded/ 'bul skyel ba bcom pa la/ rwa los grong bskrad pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pas/ ngan lam 'bar po la sogs pa 'ga' zhig smyo nas gar song cha med/ zla ba gnyis gsum nas nyu gu sna'i yul pa dang*/ dge 'dun rgyal sar sgang pa 'khrugs/ rgyal sar sgang pa'i rgyab tu klu mes tsho thams cad 'gril nas/ nyu gu sna pa grong nyis brgya tsam byang rgyab tu yul bud do/ / yang skyogs 'dul 'dzin gyi slob brgyud/ skyogs dbang grags zhes bya ba dang po 'dul 'dzin yud tsam byas/ phyis dang tshugs can gyi gsang sngags par rlom pa cig gis/ rwa lo 'dra mchod rten chag ro yin zer nas bla ma la skur 'debs byed cing*/ chos 'khor 'gegs pa 'byung*/ de la thugs khros te sbyin sreg mdzad/ zhag bdun nas skyogs dbang grags gzer thung btab nas 'das/ lo tsā ba rgyus smon lam grags dang nang rgyas byung ba yang*/ zla ba drug tsam nas rgyus lo sku 'das/ zangs kar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab gsang ba'i bdag po zhal gzigs/ rnam sras bran du 'khol/ zhes gragasashing nus mthu dang ldan pa yin yang yin/ me tsa ling pa rje btsun gyis bod la spyan drangs dus/ khong gi me tsa ling pa chen po nying ro dbyar thang du spyan drangs/

chos 'khor mdzad pa sogs de dus legs lam du yod kyang*/ phyis rwa lo sku bsod rgyas pa la/ zangs kar gyis phrag dog gi tshul gyis rwa los chos mkhas po mi shes zer brnyas pa yang mang du mdzad/ dang po paṇḍi ta kho pas spyan drangs kyang*/ chos thams cad ngas bsgyur ba zhe tshe yin zhes 'phya smod mdzad kyin lha sa ra mo cher rwa lo'i chos 'khor dgag pa sogs nang rgyas byung*/ de'i lo dus la zangs mkhar glo bur du bsnyung nas sku 'das/ gcung po dang nye gnas kyang de nas cang ma lon pa shi'o/ / mar pa lo tsā'i jo sras dar ma mdo sde yang yin te/ rje btsun 'di lho brag stod smad du 'gro don mdzad pa'i skabs shigayon bdag shud ke bya ba cig gis gson ston la spyan drangs/ khong rang tshe dang sngar 'dris kyi yon mchod yin pas dar ma mdo sde yang byon/ bla ma lo tsā ba las kyang bkur zor che ba tsam byed kyin 'dug skad/

rwa lo'i gsung gis/ chos mkhas na ni ngas kyang khyed la dag pa byin pas chogade min nged lho bal du phyin pa'i lo tsā ba yin/ khyed bod ston tsam du ka gda' bas/ sa gcig tu khyed kyi 'gying thabs 'di rang bag min nam/ chos kyi gleng bslang byed dgos gsungs pas/ dar ma mdo sde na re/ nga pha tshe rabs nas sangs rgya ba'i chos byed mkhan yin/ khyed rwa nag po bya ba ngan sngags la blo gtod pa dang mi 'dra zer nas/ dngos su gshe zhing ltag lab mdzad thegs song*/ de nas zla ba gcig tu nye tsam na dar ma mdo sde rnga mo chu shod kyi ltad mo'i sar rtas brdabs te skad cig la grongs/ 'di la ding sang gi lo rgyus khyab che ba tsho na/ mar pa bzhugs pa'i dus su yin pa dang*/ mi la ras pa rta gdong pa yin go ma chod byung ba sogs 'chad kyang*/ mar pa'i sngon la mdo sde 'das pa min/ 'di skabs mar pa sku 'das nas lo shas song*/ mi la ras pa tho phyi na bzhugs pa med do/ / des na lo rgyus mang po de dag rdzun phal ka sgrigs su shes par bya'o/ / yang 'brog mi jo sras in dra de/ dbus su nor 'tshol la byon pa gtsang rong gi re dngul gyi chos sder/ rwa lo chen po dang 'dzom/ chos kyi gleng bslang mdzad pa la/ de na re/ lo tsā ba dang*/ lo tsā ba mi 'dra/ bsgro gleng byed dgos med zer bas/ rwa lo thugs khros te/ lo tsā ba dang*/ lo tsā ba ka cis kyang mi 'dra/ gzod blta'o gsung*/ de nas zla ba gsum nas 'brog mi jo sras khrag tu 'khru ba'i rims nad byung nas dbus su ka 'das/ gcung po jo sras rdo rje yang phyis mi ring bar 'das zer/ yang bla ma lo tsā ba gtsang rong gi g.yung du chos 'khor zhig mdzad kyin yod/ der khams pa jo sras rdo rje sra brtan bya ba rnying ma'i ma mo dang*/ phur ma la mkhas/ nus pa yod par yang 'dod/ gsar ma sogs mdo sngags gzhan yang ci rigs shes pa zhig yod/ des 'dra men srang gang gi tshod tsam phul nas rdo rje 'jigs byed zhus pa la/

bla mas kyang snod brtag pa'i phyir/ rdo rje 'jigs byed yin pa ltar mdzad nas/ gdong drug gi dbu nas bag tsam gsungs/ chos thun 'ga' zhig song ba na/ rgyud mchod mdzad pa'i tshogs gral du/ bla mas mgur ma la/ khyod kyis gser dang 'dra ba'i 'dra men phul/ / ngas 'jigs byed 'dra ba'i gdong drug bshad/ / ces gsungs pas kho ma mgu/ sang snga mor kho dos chas byed pa la/ grwa ba rnams kyis gros btab kyang ma nyan par 'gro khar kha rdeg byas te/ rong gi rwa rgan lo tsā la/ / 'jigs byed dud 'gro'i mgo can nyan pa las/ / sman lung gi dpyal ston lo tsā la/ / rgyud dgyes pa rdo rje zhu ba dga'/ / zhes zer gyin song*/ de nyin chos gral la kho ma byung bas/ ci yin gsung ba na/ grwa ba rnams kyis lo rgyus zhugs pas/ mi la brnyas btub ste/ lha 'di la brnyas su mi btub/ 'di la brtags ma bstan na mi rung gsung ste de ma thag sbyin sreg mdzad pas/ khams pa de yang de'i nangs par tsam rang yin yod par 'dugasman lung du ma sleb pa la/ lam du khrag skyugs nas shi rwa lo chen pos sman lung gi dpyal lo kun dga' rdo rje la phrin pa brdzangs te/ ngas grwa ba khyod kyis blo brkus 'dugakhyod sbungs bskyed la sgur zhig gsungs pas/ dpyal lo thugs shin tu skrag nas/ 'bum gser ma gcig gis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba mang po bsnams te dag 'tshangs la phebs pas rwa lo chen po'ang dgyes par byung*/ dpyal los rwa chen po la chos kyang mang du gsan/ thugs dam thang sku cig kyang dpyal la gnang yod par 'dug go /yang bal bor bla ma'i phebs skyel la byon pa'i skabs shig kyang*/ kṛṣṇa jo bo dang*/ purṇa jo bo la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod cing*/ bla ma'i sku dgrar gyur ba mu stegs pa'i bla chen bzhi tsam mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis bsgral bar gda'/ grags tshong kha skad du/ dar ma mdo sde la sogs pa/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu gsum bsgral/

/ zhes grags/ dang po nas gzungs ma rungs pa'i mi re re gnyis gnyis la bsad bskrad dbye rengs sogs kyis tshar bcad pa la rtsis btab med/ lo tsā ba dang dge bshes chos 'khor mdzad pa thams cad/ rwa lo chen po la dgongs pa zhu dgos pa yin par 'dugami ma yin gdug pa can tshar bcad pa ni/ ngan lam nyu gu sna'i btsan bya ba sngon slob dpon padma byon dus yib thub pa yin/ dam 'og tu ma chud zer ba'i bdud btsan shin tu rdzu 'phrul che ba chos la gnag pa cig yod/ nye skor der gsang sngags kyi sgrub pa dang chog grwa byed sa med/ dge 'dun mchod na lo nyes gtong ba cig yod zer/ nyu gu sna'i yul ba rnams kyis rwa lo la sdig gsog byed pa yang des bskul ba yin/ rwa lo chen po byang phyir bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'khor la btsan des cung zad gnod pa byed pa byung bas/ nub gcig gtor ma che ba cig mdzad nas dgongs pa brtad/ de'i rgyun la zhag bdun la sgrub pa mdzad pas/ zhag lnga pa'i dgong cigabatsan gyi gnas brag dang lha rten la thog smad dgu babs/ brag chad lha rten gar song med/ kho thul 'og tu chud de dngos su gzugs bstan/ bshags pa phul/ dam la bzhagakho'i yul dang 'khor thams cad brlagakho rang yang mig zhar bas nyu gu sna'i btsan zhar du grags/ phyin chad chos la gnod pa gcig kyang byed mi thub bo/ /yang sku tshe'i smad kyi dus shig yar lungs su lha btsun sngon mos spyan drangs te chos 'khor mdzad/ de nas gnyal phyogs la phebs par bzhed do/ / yar la shams bu'i gangs 'gram du bzhugs du/ shams pos gangs chen po phab ste la bkagagrwa ba gcig kyang 'khyags nas shi ba la/ bla ma'i gsungs gis/ shams po dregs pa che mno'am/ / rwa rgyan lo tsā rgas mno'am/ / 'jigs byed nus pa chung mno'am/ / rwa mtshon rtse mo zad mno'am/ / zhes gsungs shing gangs ri la brdungs stangs mdzad dgongs pa yun ring du brtad pas/ dam thag brdung stangs mdzad sa nas gangs chen po 'ur/

nam phyed kyi dus shig na/ shams po kho rang khye'u dkar po gcig gi gzugs su byas nas/ phyag zhung zhung 'tshal zhing*/ bdag gi 'khor rnga shang thogs pa stong phrag lnga ni dus gcig tu gum song*/ da bla ma'i grwa ba gcig shi ba la grwa ba brgya dang brgyad kyi yus byed/ gser srang brgya dang brgyad kyang 'bul/ bzod pa mdzad de rjes su bzung bar zhu zer/ de ma thag yul yang 'jam por gyur to/ / dpon slob rnams kyis kyang zhag shas de kar bzhugs/ zhag bdun gyi khongs su/ yar lungs phu mda' nas/ grwa ba byed pa brgya brgyad kyang byung*/ gser srang brgya rtsa brgyad phyag tu'ang 'byor bas/ 'dre 'di pa chad la btsan par 'dug gsung*/ de rjes gnyal du chos 'khor mdzad/ de nas lho brag ban pa dang*/ gru shul dang la yag kun tu'ang phebs/ klu bdud thog 'bar bya ba dang*/ mdzo mo spun lnga zer ba'i klu srin mo gdug pa can yod/ lam la 'gro ba'i mi kun gyis kyang*/ phyag phul mchod yar byed dgos/ ma byas na cho 'phrul 'phral du 'ong*/ mtshan mo su yang sgyu 'phrul byed mi nus/ mngon sum du mi khyer ba'ang mang po yong*/ de skabs kyang bag ma 'gro ba cig rta thog nas gar song med par sbas te lo gcig gnyis song*/ rwa lo chen pos phebs lam du de dang nye bar tsha phogs mdzad/ khal ma rnams kho'i gnas kyi tshal gling dang ne thang la btsos pas/ kho'i cho 'phrul gyis mdzo gcig shi bla ma thugs khros te mdzo sga bcagasbyin sreg gi yams shing la phul/ klu bdud pho mo 'khor bcas de ma thag tshig yod par 'dugasngar sbas pa'i bud med de gson po skyon med du thon/ des lo rgyus bshad/ klu bdud kho lo tsā ba dpon slob kyis/ tsha phogs mdzad pa la'ang*/ nga la phyag mi 'tshal ba zer nas 'khu/ phyugs btsos pas shin tu khros te/ mtshon cha 'phangs/ de dud 'gro gcig la phog pa yin/ sbyin sreg mdzad par brtsams pa na/ kho bzhad gad byed 'phro la phyogs thams cad nas mun nag na bun 'dra ba bstibs/

gang yang ma mthong ba cig la lung pa mes khengs nas de thams cad tshigade skabs mo rang yang skrag dngangs chen po byung ste/ de nas gnyid sad pa 'dra ba cig la gang yang mi 'dug zer/ de nas mi ring bar gnas de'i chu mig thams cad bskams par gda'/ de dag mtshon pa tsam yin/ chos la bar du gcod pa'i mi ma yin mang po yang btul lo/ / : gsum £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡· bzhi £© pa sku bsod nams kyis che ba la/ longs spyod dang zas nor char bzhin babs/ mi chen so sos zhabs tog byed pa la grangs med/ chos yon rnams brtsis na yig 'bru re re la gser srang re re'i rtsis byung*/ na bza' gsang lam ma gtogs sku la snal ma mi 'khri/ de dus rgun 'brum shin tu dkon pa'i skabs yin yang*/ rgun 'brum bre lnga lnga'i rgun skyems kha che'i lugs nyin re bzhin du sbyor/ rgya bal gyi shing thog mang po mi rnyings pa'i thabs byas te/ paṇḍi ta dang*/ rgyal blon tshong dpon sogs kyis 'bul mkhan yang yang yong ste/ rgya gar gyi shing thog so ma la rgyun mi 'chad gsol du yod pa sogs/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyi rjes su 'di bas bzhes thang che ba med par grags/ dus rgyun gyi 'khor tshogs 'dus pa la/ chos nyan pa po brgya phrag du ma rgyun mi 'chad cing*/ sngags pa dpe 'grems brgyad brgya dang*/ btsun pa dpe 'grems stong nyis brgya re yang yang 'dus/ gsang sngags kyi chos grwa la 'di las che ba dus gsum khegs pa yin/ sngon chos dar ba'i skabs mdo pa dang sngags pa mi 'dra/ sngags chos la mchod pa dang yon chen po dgos pas/ phal pa cig gis mi 'grub/ gzhan sngon dus sngags pa 'du 'tshog che shos rang mgos khug pa la yang*/ dus gcig la dpe 'grems bdun brgya las lhag pa ma byung ngo*/ khyad par gyi 'khor tshogs ni/ mi che ba jo bo rtsad po'i rigs kun dang*/ zhang sgra chen la sogs pa 'byor ldan kun dang*/ brang ti dbang phyug grags dang*/ g.yu thog dar po la sogs pa sman pa chen po thams cad kyis kyang zhabs la gtugs/

zhang tshes spong ba dang*/ 'bre chen po dang*/ 'ban dkon mchog rdo rje dang*/ rtag ba kha che la sogs pa mtshan nyid pa chen po thams cad dang*/ zhang sang gha dang*/ gtsang thang 'od po dang*/ sgang ind+ra dang*/ snur nyi ma dang*/ klun rdor po dang*/ rgya long chos grags dang*/ rtsangs yang dag 'bar dang*/ rngog mdo sde dang*/ shong rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*/ skyu ra a skyabs dang*/ ngo khro yon tshul la sogs pa gsar ma pa'i dge bshes thams cad dang*/ zur hor po dang*/ yang keng bla ma dang*/ byang chub 'bar la sogs pa rnying ma pa chen po rnams dang*/ ba reg lo tsā ba dang*/ dpyal lo la sogs pa lo tsā ba mang po ste/ de dus kyi dge bshes dang mi chen phal cher gyis zhabs la gtugs so/ / mchod gnas gzhan lta zhogagasung rab gcig po phyag tu phebs pa la yang*/ mdo sde yongs rdzogs tshar drug cu dang*/ 'bum cha nyis brgya lhag pa phyag tu byon pas mtshon/ nor rdzas tha mal pa smos kyis ga la lang*/ slob ma mi chen rnams kyi mtshan dang*/ so sos zhabs tog byas tshul rnams rgyas par rwa ye shes seng ge'i gsungs las shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa mdzad pa phyag rjes kyi che ba ni/ rgya bal du phyag rjes dge rtsa mdzad tshul gong du smos zin/ bod kyi dbang du byas na/ chos 'khor bsam yas su rba dang*/ rag sha'i sde 'khrugs byung ste/ 'khor sa bar pa dang*/ grang khang thams cad mes tshig go / de rjes lo sum cu tsam song yang*/ dkor bdag gnyan che bas zhig gsos byed mkhan yang med/ rba rag gzhung ma 'dums pas/ dgon gnas 'dzin mkhan med par/ dkon gnyer re tsam ma gtogs stongs pa bzhin du gyur/ de skabs rwa lo chen pos zhig gsos mdzad par dgongs te/ ba lam kla gi phul phebs pa'i skabs/ dkor bdag : dpe [ pe ] kar gyis dkon gnyer la gzugs dngos su bstan te/ sang gnangs 'dir 'jigs su rung ba cig yong ba 'duga'adir sdod pa'i dbang mi 'dug zer nas bros pa dngos su mthong*/

su yod snyam tsa na/ zhag gsum song nas rwa lo chen po phebs/ mngon shes kyis mkhyen nas/ dkon gnyer la khyod kyi dkor bdag gar song gsungs/ de nas dkor bdag kyang bos/ bka' bsgo dam bzhag mdzad/ 'ol ka'i shug nags chen po zhig bcad de/ shing rnams gtsang po'i steng nas yar drangs/ thag pas cung zad de 'dren pa ma gtogs/ nya gyen la rgyugs pa bzhin dka' tshegs ye ma byung*/ bsam yas kyi zhig gsos la nas khal 'bum phrag cig gi rtsis song*/ dbyar lo gsum la gyang ris tshun chod mthar phyin/ rba rag sde pa gnyis la mthun par bsgrigs dam bzhag mang po mdzad nas/ dge 'dun gyi sde sngar bzhin tshugs par mdzad do/ / g.yas ru gtsang 'gram lha khang yang shin tu gogs shing zhig ral du gyur pa la/ dbu rtse dang 'khyams thams cad la zhig gsos mdzad/ nas khal khri tsho gcig gi rtsis song*/ de'i dge 'dun 'thor ba yang bsdu bar mdzad/ sku tshe'i smad kyi dus cig na/ g.yu me tog spungs pas sna drangs pa'i g.yu byang kho na'i 'phreng ba spe mo che zer ba mkhar thog so lnga pa cig gi dar cog gi rtse nas bzung na sa la 'khyil ba tsam zhig yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang zab yugadar yug go khrab/ stang rtse/ mdzo rta sogs dpag tuu med pa rnams ni/ ngur smrig bye mda'/ kyus thang*/ nyan tsho/ lcang ra/ shar skyang*/ re dngul sogs gtsang gi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams dang*/ rgyal lha khang sogs dbus kyi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams la/ so sor thes su sbyar nas chos 'chad pa'i thes dang*/ dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog lha khang gi mchod pa/ mtha' na mgron zan gyi bar du bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar cha rkyen du gnang*/ gzhan yang dge 'dun gyi sde so sor rten gsum dang*/ spyi rdzas dang*/ phyag 'gyed kyi dngos po btang ba la grangs med/ de bzhin du 'bum bcu drug dum rang yang brgya dang bzhi bcu tsam bzhengs pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad/ sku drung du rgya gar gyi a tsa ra paṇḍi ta brgyad stong pa 'don mkhan brgyad re dang*/

lū yi pa bsgom mkhan re ste/ mchod gnas rgya gar ba dgu re rtag tu 'degs/ bod kyi gsung rab la sher phyogs stong tshar dang*/ mdo sde brgya tshar lan mang du song*/ mtha' na tsha tsha rang yang 'bum phrag lo star gyis mdzad/ gson dge mdzad pa la rngog lo tsā ba'i chos 'khor la nas khal khri tsho gcig dang*/ 'bum gyis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba chen po bskyal/ de dang mnyam pa glang ri thang pa dang*/ btsan kha bo che dang*/ rgya 'dul 'dzin rnams la yang mdzad/ rog mngon pa ba la sogs pa gzhan yang dge bshes ji snyed pa zhig la chos 'khor btsugs shing 'bul ba mang du mdzad do/ / bla ma lo tsā ba 'di sku tshe yang ring por bzhugs pa zhig ste/ dpal me tsa ling pa spyan drangs pa'i dus na/ dgung lo drug cu lhag tsam du phebs par gda'/

de nas phrin las mgo rgyas pa yin/ de rjes mi ring ba na/ rngog lo chen po'i 'phrin las kyang mgo tshugs/ rngog lo sku 'das nas kyang rwa los lo nyi shu lhag par bzhugs/ sku tshe'i smad lo mang por gzhan la gshegs bzhud ma mdzad de/ ne'u me tog ldan du bzhugs 'dugadagung lo brgya dang bcu bzhugs bya ba dang*/ brgya brgyad bzhugs bya ba sogs 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba du ma 'dug kyang*/ lo rtsis nges gsal mi gsung ba cig yin pa 'dug pas/ sgra ji bzhin bshad dka' na'ang*/ dgung lo brgya skor cig bzhugs par nges/ bsad pas tshe ring 'grub pa ni/ / rwa rgan lo tsā'i khyad chos yin/ / gsungs skad/ mthar bsnyung ba med par ye shes gong 'pho mdzad de sku 'das/ dpon po lo tsā ba chos rab kyi dge 'dun gyi sde chen po nyi shu tsam spyan drangs nas/ sku ldad rgya chen po mdzad/ zhag shas nas sku gdung du mngon pa cher ma byung*/ khru gang tsam yod zer/ cung zad cig ston pa rin chen rdo rjes zhi ba'i thab khung cig tu zhugs la phul/ sgra dang 'od dang*/ me tog gi char sa gzhi khengs pa byung*/ sku ldad kyi skal ba skyel ba la/ ston pa rgyal ba zhes bya bas bal yul du phyin te gser srang brgya bshig pa'i mchod pa dang*/ gser srang brgya'i 'dra min gyi rnyed pa phul lo/ / rgya gar bi kra ma dang*/ rdo rje gdan du de dang phyogs mtshungs pa byas par grags so/ / de ltar na rnam thar lo rgyus mdo tsam mo/ / 'dir ma 'dus pa rnams ye shes seng ges mdzad pa'i rnam thar dang*/ de'i lhan thabs gnyis las shes par bya'o/ / rnam thar gyi yi ge rgyas pa gzhan zhig sngon dus byung zhes zer na'ang*/ deng sang med par mngon/ spyir yang sngon dus kyi lo tsā ba rnams la/ rnam thar khrigs chags ma chen mo'i rigs khungs dang ldan pa cher mi snang bas/ lo rgyus kyi ngo bo 'di tsam yang rgyas pa yin par mngon no/ / phyis kyi kha skad 'khyam po la/

rwa lo dang gnyan lo nang rgyas byung zhes kun la grags pa ni mi bden te/ nag po'i rgyud nag tshos bsgyur ba la gnyan gyis bcos/ de la rwa los bcos pas kyang mtshon/ gnyan lo dang sngags pa nang rgyas byung ba de ni/ bla ma rdo lo tsā ba yin zhes skyo ba'i yig rnying khungs ma rnams las bshad/ de yang gnyan lo rdau lo gnyis bsdung khongs la rtsod pa byung bas/ gnyan lo na re/ nangs par khyod kyi mgo la phur ba rtsangs se ba cig bya yi/ zhes lon bskur bas/ rdo lo na re/ khyod dag ngan sngags 'dras spos pa yin te 'ong*/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po la su yis bdo/ khyod rang zobs shig zer/ rdo los/ brdung stangs byed kyin yi dam chos skyong bskul bas/ gnyan lo'i thugs kar lhog 'bur chen po byung ste/ cang ma lon par grongs zer bar 'dugardo lo tsā ba de phyis deng sang grags chung yang kha che lakṣ+miṃ gyi slob ma yin/ chos rnam grangs mang po mi mkhyen/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kho na la chig 'dril mdzad/ yi dam gsang yang mi gsang*/ gzhan la 'chad kyang mi 'chad/ mthu stobs thogs pa med pa cig yod zer ba 'dugablun pa las kyang ches blun pa dag zhal bzhi pa dang las gshin la lha 'dras yod/ bya rog gdong can dang pu ṭa la lha 'drasayod/ phyag drug pa dang*/ gur zhal la lha 'dras yod zer ba sogs ni go ba ye ma chags pa'i gtam ste/ shes ldan thams cad khrel ba'i gnas so/ / spyir ye shes kyi lha 'khrug pa mi srid/ sngags mkhan nang rgyas byung yang*/ yi dam 'khon pa ga la yod/ dper na bod mi cig gi lag tu rgya gar gyi ral gri byung*/ cig shos kyi lag tu rgya nag gi ral gri byung nas/ bod mi de gnyis 'thabs kyang*/ rgya gar rgya nag gnyis la 'khon mi 'ong ba bzhin no/ / nyi ma dbyings su shar ba'i 'od phyogs thams cad du khyab pa ltar/ ye shes lha'i rig sngags sems can gyi don la kun tu khyab pa na/
