de'i cha shas phra mo tsam re/ sngags mkhan gnyis kyis blangs te 'thabs pa la/ ye shes dbyings kyi lha la skul skyod ga la yod/ 'di yang nan tan du go ba gal che ste/ 'di ma go bas rnam rtog ma langs dgu langs shing*/ 'chal gtam gyis rgyal khams gangs 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ rje btsun rwa lo chen po de nyid kyi thugs sras lo tsā ba chos rab ni rong gi ne'u me tog ldan du sku 'khrungs/ yab chos thams cad bum pa gcig nas gcig tu byo ba bzhin du thugs su chud/ rwa lo chen po nyid las lo tsā yang shin tu mkhas par bod yul nyid du sbyangs/ bla ma chen po'i sku ldad grub nas bal bor byon/ paṇḍi ta sa manta shrī la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo gsan/ lo phyed dang lnga tsam na sems 'grel skor gsum cha lag dang bcas pa la ches mkhas par gyur cing*/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel 'gyur dpe snga ma la ma gzigs par rtsa 'gyur mdzad pas shin tu legs par byung*/ skabs der bod du phebs/ 'gro don cung zad mdzad nas/ paṇḍi ta sa manta shrī bod du spyan drangs/ dbu gtsang kun tu phebs/ phar log phebs dus gser srang sum brgya dus gcig tu phul/ skyid grong gi bar du skyel mar phebs/ bla ma'ang dgyes te/ bla ma nyid kyis dam tshig rdor dril dus 'khor lugs dang*/ bstan skyong 'bum phrag gsum pa'i prog zhu/ brgyad stong pa'i po ti dang bcas pa gnang*/ yang phyis rgya gar du phebs nas/ paṇḍi ta wā gī shwa ra gu pta la yang thugaphag mo so bdun ma la sogs pa'i chos skor rnams bsgyur/ nag po chen po'i rgyud mngon byung yang bsgyur zhing dbang dang man ngag blangs/ de skabs he ru ka mngon byung*/ phag mo mngon byung*/ mgon po mngon byung ste/ mngon byung skor gsum gyi tha snyad kyang byung*/ gsang sngags kyi lo tswa ba cig la bla ma 'di rang mkhas par grags/ de la sras gnyis mnga' ba las/ gcen po ni rwa ye shes seng ge ste/

de yang rwa lo chos rab kyi sku'i yon tan thams cad par btab pa bzhin mnga' ba yin/ rong khu lung gi se khyim zhes pa'i mkhar cig tu bzhugs/ rwa nub pa bar grags/ de'i sras ni rwa 'bum seng yin te/ de yang bla ma gong ma rnams la mnga' ba'i chos thams cad thugs su chud pa cig byung*/ ye shes seng ge dang*/ 'bum seng gis kyang rgya bal du khor tsam re gshegs shing*/ sgrub thabs thor bu ba sogs chos sna cung zad re 'gyur mdzad/ rwa lo ye shes seng ge dang*/ rwa lo 'bum seng du yang grags so/ / de las brgyud pa'i rigs kyi dbon sras brgyud pa'ang ci rigs phyis byung bar du yod par snang yang slob brgyud bzang*/ rigs brgyud grags chung ngo*/ / rwa lo chos rab kyi sras chung ba ni/ rwa dharma seng ge yin te/ des ne'u me tog ldan du bzhugs/ de'i sras dkon mchog seng ge de'i sras shes rab rgyal mtshan yin te/ de rnams kyang nus mthu dang ldan zhing*/ nag po skor gsum la mkhas pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa/ dus 'khor/ phag mo'i chos skor sogs kyang ci rigs pa mnga' ba byung de dag rnams la rwa shar bar grags/ rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan pa'i rjes su/ rwa lcags mkhar ba sogs brgyud pa mang du gyes/ slob brgyud la ru mtshams kyi rgya dbang phyug grags pa/ de'i sras rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ de khams su byon/ rgyal thang me long steng du bzhugs/ mi nyag dang*/ dmar khams kyi yul du'ang lan mang du phebs/ mthu stobs shin tu che'o/ / de la khams su slob ma mang*/ khams pa yon tan 'bum bya bas dbus gtsang du'ang khong gi lugs dar bar byas/ mchod rten dkar po ba sangs rgyas skyabs sogs slob ma mang du byung*/ des lha btsun bsam yas pa sogs la bshad nas da lta'i bar du dar/ rje btsun 'bum seng la zur du byon pa'i sras blo gros seng ge nas brgyud/ gdung rabs 'ga' re byon 'dug 'gro don che ba rang ma byung ba 'dra/

slob brgyud bu chen bza' la mang ba byung*/ thugs sras kyi gtso bo rong ba rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje yin/ mdo sngags thams cad dang*/ khyad par dus 'khor la mkhas shing grub pa thob/ de'i sras rje shes rab seng ge dang*/ bla ma a ka ra gnyis kyang dus 'khor dang gshin rje gshed pa la mkhas shing*/ 'jigs mdzad la brten nas nus pa'ang thob bo/ / rje sher seng nas brgyud pa la/ mang mkhar lo tsā ba dang*/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ yang rje sher seng dang*/ bla ma a ka ra gnyis ka la/ skyid ston grags rgyal gyis zhus/ de la sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo kun mkhyen chen pos gsan/ seng rgyan pa dang*/ kun mkhyen chen po la zhang ston rgya bor grags pa/ mkhas pa bsod nams grags kyis gsan/ 'dis 'jigs mdzad kyi chos rgya cher spel/ 'bri khung dpal 'dzin du grags pa'ang 'di'i slob ma'o/ / yang rje sher seng la khor rang gi dbon po rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de la dbon po bsod nams lhun grub kyis zhus/ de la'ang 'bri khung dpal 'dzin gyis zhus so/ / yang rwa 'bum seng gi slob ma klog skya dbang phyug grags pa de gshin rje gshed dang dus 'khor la mkhas pa cig byung*/ de la ldongs ston shes rab dpal gyis gsher skor rnams zhus/ ldongs ston des mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen mang po mkhyen/ brgyud pa tha dad sna tshogs kyi chos sna bzhugs rgya che zhing thams cad la mkhas pa cig yin yang*/ nyams len rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kho na gtso bor gton pas/ nus mthu yang chen po mnga'/ sku bsod che bas bla chen 'phags pa dang*/ rgyal po go pe la'i bla mar song*/ gshin rje'i 'khor lo'i skabs sogs 'ga' zhig tu/ snga ma rnams dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos cung zad yod/ khong rang gi sgos kyi brgyud 'dzin rnams la ldongs lugs pa zer ba byung*/ bla chen 'phags pas kyang rwa lugs rtsal 'don mdzad de spel bas/

sngar dkar po rnam gsum gyi dus su mdzad pa'i mal lugs de ni bag la zha ba ltar gyur to/ / bar skabs su rwa lugs 'di bo dong 'jam ral du grags pa nam mkha' smon lam/ 'bri khung lo tsā ba ma ṇ-i ka skyi rong lo tsā ba ngag dbang*/ gzungs kyi dpal ba/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ bla ma chos dpal bzang po/ sngags 'chang kun dga' zla ba/ slob dpon dge ba rgyal mtshan la sogs pas dar rgyas su byas/ da lta'i bar du'ang dar ro/ kha cig 'di la sa lugs kyi ming 'dogs pa ni 'phags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nyid dang 'gal nyen gda'o/ / 'dir byung tshul spyi khog tsam bshad pa yin gyi/ brgyud rim so so ba rnams ni brgyud yig las shes par bya'o/ / rwa lugs 'di la dgra gdong gnyis dkyil 'khor re dang*/ 'jigs mdzad la bcu gsum ma dang*/ ro langs brgyad bskor te dkyil 'khor bzhi'i dbang rgyun da lta'i bar du yod do/ / / / skyo lugs kyi brgyud pa'i dbang du byas na/ la li ta badzra dang*/ gsang ldan mdzad mkhan gyi sgeg pa'i rdo rje gcig pa ltar gyi bshad pa byed de/ de ni ma yin mod/ 'on kyang slob dpon des nyan 'don byed sar byon nas 'khor ba nas 'khor bar bton pas ci phan gsungs/ nya rnams zhal du gsol nas 'jam dpal gyi zhing du spur nas btang zer/ slob dpon la li ta de la 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis thugade yang grub pa thob par nye nas spyod pa la byon/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po cig glang po che la zhon nas 'ongs pa dang*/ zam pa cig tu mjal nas/ lam bzung res ma byung bas slob dpon gyis sdigs 'dzub bstan pas/ rgyal po dang*/ glang po che gnyis ka phyed mar gas te/ zam pa'i g.yas g.yon du lhungs/ de nas 'khor rnams kyis bzod par gsol zhing gsol ba btab pas/ slar gsos te nang pa'i bstan pa la bkod/ 'jig rten lha la phyag mi 'tshal/ / glang po byung yang lam mi bzur/ kha nas gsang sngags rgyal po bzlos/

/ rkang pa brag ri thogs med 'gro/ / zhes pa khong la tshang ngo*/ / de'i slob ma ni a mo gha badzra chen po yin/ de ni bum pa nam mkha' la 'jogasprul pa'i sku zhal gzigs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub brnyes skad do/ /de la slob ma bzhi ste/ de ba ā ka ra tsand+ra dang*/ nag po ba dang*/ birya tsand+ra dang*/ a mo gha badzra chung ba'o/ / dang po ni/ zhang lo tsā ba shes rab bla ma'i rtsa ba'i bla ma de yin/ mgos khug pa'i bla ma btsun mo can dang gcig pa 'dra'o/ / 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brnyes nas dpal gyi ri la bzhugs zer/ gnyis pa ni/ kā ma ru'i yul du mchog sbyin byed mkhan gyi mu stegs rnams la sdigs 'dzub byas pas/ dran med du brgyal/ rgyal pos zhus nas slar gsos/ rgyal po zhabs la gtugs/ dmar mchod rnams phal cher bkag / lam la stag brdzus mdzad kyin gnyal du byon/ bod du byon dus lo tsā ba med pas chos ni ma bsgyur/ dbang dang man ngag than thun gsungs/ a tsa ra zhabs dkar po can du grags so/ / gsum pa ni/ jo bo rje'i gcung po yin/ gshin rje gshed kyi nus pa grub pa/ bod yul phal cher du byon/ yar klungs kyi klu dgon par yun ring bzhugs/ slar rgya gar la thegs pa de ka yin nam sems/ skyo ba rnams 'dis 'ja' lus brnyes/ dpal gyi ri la bzhud zer/ bzhi pa ni/ slob dpon a tu la dā sa'i sras yin par yang 'chad/ gang ltar yang zhang shes rab bla ma rgya gar du bzhugs pa'i dus/ slob gnyer gyi 'phros skyong ba'i gzhon nu gcig yod zer/ phyis nus pa dang ldan pa'i paṇa chen du gyur/ bod du phebs dus zhang lo shin tu bgres por gyur kyang chos gsan/ spyir bod yul du 'gro don che/ ba ri ba'i bla ma sku drin che shos gcig yin/ dus mnyam gyi lo tsā ba phal cher kyis gtugs/ phar phyin dang mdo sde rgyan sogs mdo chos kyang mang du gsungs/ sngags chos gsang 'dus/ dgyes rdor sogs dang*/

sgrub thabs phra mo'i rigs mang du gsungs shing*/ phyag rgya bzhi la brten pa'i rdzogs rim kyang mang du gsungs 'dugabod pa'i dge bshes dang sngags pa mang pos zhabs 'bring byas/ stod lung gi phu'i la zhig la bzhud pa'i tshe/ jag pa mang po byung ba la bod pa rnams ri la brdzes 'thab chas byed pa la/ paṇḍi tas sdig 'dzub mdzad pas jag par rnams rengs/ 'thab ma dgos par la thon/ de nas bod kyi dzo gi rnams la nus pa mi 'dug pa gsung*/ 'gro don cher mdzad nas rgya gar du bzhud/ sku tshe'ang ring du bzhugs/ ras chung bas kyang bla ma 'di la chos mang du zhus gda' ste/ ras chung ba'i rnam thar na 'bri dgos nges shes pa 'di tsho ma bris par 'dugade lta bu'i bla ma a mo gha badzra la bla ma skyos gsan pa yin te/ khong gi yul/ pa snam gyi nya tshan phug yin/ dang po mngon pa dang*/ tshad ma dam dum mkhyen/ rnying ma sgyu 'phrul sogs legs po shes pa'i ban gzhon nor che ba cig yod/ ming dngos cha mi 'tshal/

bla dwags la skyo nag 'brom ston zer/ kho nangs par sman 'dra nyo ba dang*/ gzhan don spyod cig kyang yod/ grabs rnams grub ste nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ lung ba'i mda' chen mo ma gi nas yar/ shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i lus can/ mdog nag pa/ mgo dang rkang lag mang po yod pa/ me dang dud pa'i dkyil na gzugs shin tu che ba cigayar yong gin 'duga'adir ma byung na rung ste bsam tsa na/ khong rang gi rtsar tshang gis byung*/ skrag rang grags te gang grag ci grag la gnyid sad pas/ gos thams cad rngul nag gis bangs 'dug der bsams pa/ da de ring gi don de rang mi 'grub pa yin/ de bas god gzhan ci yong yang mi shes te/ dus brtsams zin pas/ ma phyin na mi rung bsams/ nam langs ma thog phyin/ gra ma smu gu zer ba'i chu 'gram de'i thad na/ paṇḍi ta dpon g.yog 'ga' zhig 'dugade mthong ba tsam gyis yid la dga' bde khyad par can yang skyes/ zil che ba zhig kyang 'dugade la mos nas nga da lta 'khor nas yong bas 'dir bzhugs zhigabadag gi khyim du spyan 'dren pa lags byas/ de nas tshong 'dus 'gur mor phyin pas sman mang po'ang rnyed/ don spyod de yang legs pa rang zhig byung*/ de la brten pa'i chang 'dren pa mang ste/ nyi ma zer ba tsam thub yongs/ de nas sngar log yong ngo byas pa dran te/ 'phro bzhag nas 'ongs pas mun tshab tshub la/ paṇḍi ta dpon slob rnams sngar kyi sa de na ka bzhugs 'dug sar sleb/ nub mo de ka yar byon te khyim du spyan drangs/ zhabs tog sna len bzang po byas/ paṇḍi ta dbus du phebs pa'i cha rkyen thams cad kyang der bsags/ sngar lo tsā rab rib zhig mkhyen pa la slar rgya skad la sbyangs pa cher mdzad/ paṇḍi ta dbus su phebs pa'i phyag g.yog gi rkang len mdzad/ zhor chos kyang mang du thob/ yar phebs nas bla ma rang gi thugs dam gyi mthil gang yin pa de nga la zhu byas/ snyigs ma'i dus na 'di kho na byin rlabs che/

nga'i yi dam gyi snying po'ang 'di yin gsungs nas/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i thang sku bstan/ sngar rang gi rmi lam du byung ba der 'dug nas/ dga' grags nas te te brdungs/ dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi dkyil nas 'od dkar po'i gong bu snyim pa tsam cig byung*/ khyim thams cad 'od kyis gang nas/ skyo ston gyi dbu la thim/ bla mas ming 'od kyi 'byung gnas su btags/ der zla ba bzhi tsam bzhugs nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor dpy-is phyin pa zab rgyas su gnang*/ skyid grong tshun chad skyel mar phebs/ der rta bzang po cig phul nas smon lam btab ste/ phyir log yong khar/ dbu zhwa dang phyag 'khar gnang nas/ da sgrub pa gyis shig legs pa 'ong zhes lung bstan mdzad/ de nas chos rgyud gcig par dgongs te/ 'bri 'tshams kyi nang gi dge 'dun bzang po'i drung du byon/ sngar gyi rgyab rten du dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi chos skor rdzogs par zhus so/ / de nas nya tshan du sgrub pa byed kyin yod tsam na/ rmi lam du bla ma phebs yod phyir shog zer ba cig byung*/ phyir phyin tsa na zhing kha cig na bla ma a mo gha zhugs 'dugaphyag phul tsa na/ spa mkhar gyis sa la ri mo mdzad kyin/ 'dir khang pa gyis gsung 'od dkar po cig tu gyur nas yal song*/ de nas mi ring pa cig na/ pha spun cig yod pa des zhing de nyo'i zer byung ba la/ lung bstan dran nas zhing nyos dgon pa byas/ pa tshab nyi ma sde zer ba de yin/ lan cig der sgrub pa byas tsa na/ lha'i bu gnyis kyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas khrus byas/ lag tu rdo rje gtad de/ ri ni ma he'i gzugs 'dra ba/ / de yi rtsa ru skyes pa ni/ / shākya'i sras po zhes bya ba/ / 'od 'byung zhes ni grags pa yin/ / de la bka' gnang byin rlabs kyis/ / 'jam dpal gyi ni dngos grub thob/ / lha yi dbang pos btang ba yin/ / bsam pa'i don las ma 'gyur cig/

zer sman chu lung du yang dben mdzad nas/ bsnyen sgrub lo bdun byas pas/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po zhal gzigs te/ ma he'i zhal bzhad cing rtsa sngags gsung ba dang*/ 'khor las kyi gshin rje bzlas pa byed pa gzigs/ bar chad bzlogasku tshe ring*/ lung bstan dang mthun pa'i byin rlabs 'byung*/ mthu stobs shin tu che/ skyo rog phung ba dang*/ pa tshab bdos phung bar grags/ mthu rtags kyi lo rgyus mang po yod 'dug na'ang bris pa mi 'dugalar gyi thugs ngang rgyud 'jam zhing bzang ba zhig yin par 'dug pas brag las la brtson par ma mdzad kyang*/ sdig gsog pa rnams la rang shugs kyis rtags 'byung ba yin par 'dug go / de la sras 'jam dpal dang padma gnyis byung*/ yab kyi rjes zin/ bu chen lnga/ rtsangs yang dag 'bar/ sgang ri bo che ba/ ma snar khro me ba/ bsags gzhon nu/ glan gnya' nam pa ste/ de thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi chos la mkhas pa'o/ / glan ni 'o yug tu rnying ma ba cig la chos nyan kyin yod tsa na/ nub cig rmi lam btags pas/ rmi lam du skoms nas chu btsal bas/ bye ma'i chu rnyog ma can 'ba' zhig 'dugade nas la cig brgal bas phu shar bstan cig na/ chu zhim po cig 'dug pa 'thungs pas tshim pa cig rmi/ sang slob dpon la bshad pas/ slob dpon na re/ khyod la nga'i chos kyis phan mi thogs par 'dugabla ma skyo 'di grub thob cig yod par 'dug pas/ khong can du song gsungs/ der byon nas dbang gdams ngag zhus bsgoms pas/ nyams rtogs bzang zhing nus mthu che ba cig byung bar gda'/ skyo 'jam dpal gyi sras ni jo sras khams pa yin/ des yab dang*/ khu bo dang*/ glan gnya' nam pa gsum car la gtugs/ mes po'i rjes zin par byung*/ de yan chad bka' rgyas bsdams pas/ mes dbon de dag la rgyud shes shing nus pa thob pa'i slob ma mang po byung yang*/ de dag gis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor gzhan la bshad pa mang po med/

de nas dbus skyi smad gsang mda'i gnyan rin chen bstan pa zhes bya ba/ rten dkar po mtshan nyid kyang shes/ yo ga dang gsang 'dus sogs sngags chos mang po rang shes pa zhig skyo khams pa'i lo rgyus thos pas/ dad pa skyes nas dang por mjal du phyin/ gshed skor gyi chos kyi snyan 'bul byas pas/ nga lo steng gi skeg che da res mi 'ong*/ sang phod tsam bya gsungs/ de res logaphyi lo de phyin pas lo mtshams byas yod gsung ma mjal te/ snod brtags pa'ang yin par 'dugade na lo gnyis lon nas phyin pas mjal/ za 'og yug bzang po cig phyag rten du phul/ khyod sngar thag rings nas 'ongs/ da yang thag ring du 'gro bas bshad kyis gsung*/ sman chu lung du gtor ma cig mdzad/ gtor ltas shin tu bzang ste/ sman chu lung du bshad na bar chad cig yong bar 'dugakun ra gnas su 'gro gsung*/ der phebs nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang man ngag rnams rdzogs par gnang*/ rtog bdun gyi zhib bshad tshar gnyis mdzad/ cha lag kun kyang rdzogs par gnang*/ de nas pa tshab nyi ma lder phebs nas rgyab rten zhe dgu ma dang*/ dgra nag gdong drug sogs kyang gnang*/ lar lo gnyis bzhugs/ yo byad thams cad kyang sprugs te phul/ bshad pa gdams ngag thams cad kyang rdzogs par shes pa byung bla ma'i gsung nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'di mi spags khud kyi gser phye yin/ chos 'di bsgrubs na/ btsal na nor rnyed/ btul na dgra thul/ sdig pa mi 'jigs/ sangs rgyas myur du thob/ pha'i chos btub nas bu dang tsha bo yang tsha sogs mtha' med pa'i bar du chos kyi grul thub pa zhig yin/ chos yin zer ba la la/ pha'i ring la dar dar nas/ bu'i ring la shog rjes kyang med par 'gro/ / 'di de dang mi 'dra'o/ / byi khung du mdung las snyung bu gzo bya ba yin/ khyod kyis kyang chos chen po mang po shes par 'dug ste/ nga'i chos 'di kho nas phan thogs par 'ong*/ mi gsum las mang ba la dus gcig tu ma shod cigaces bka' rgya bkrol te gnang*/

bla ma 'dis kyang yi dam 'grub ste mthu stobs thogs pa med pa mnga'/ dgung lo brgya dang bcu gnyis bzhugs/ brgya brgyad kyi steng du/ 7 bla chen chos rgyal 'phags pas kyang zhabs la btud/ de'i sras po gnyan 'od srungs/ de la'ang bla chen gyis chos gsan/ de'i sras po gnyan chos rgyal yin/ de la bu chen 'dzims pa rin she sogs bu chen brgyud pa dang*/ rigs brgyud kyang gnyan ston rdo rje grags kyi bar du mi rabs bzhi lnga tsam chos brgyud zin pa rang byung 'dug go / da ltar yang chos bka' ma num tsam yod cing*/ kho bos kyang 'khums so/ /brgyud yig logs su gsal/ rwa lugs kyi 'og nas lugs srol 'di yang gdams ngag rgyas la bzang pa byin rlabs che ba zhig go / lugs 'di la skyo nyid kyis rang lugs khro mo brgyad bskor gyi dkyil 'khor kho na yin/ dgra gdong 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma gsum zhang lugs la bskrun ma'o/ / / / gshin rje gshed nag po skor gsum gnyos lugs ni/ rgya gar gyi brgyud pa phal cher gnyos lugs rang gi gsang 'dus dang 'dra ste/ gnyos kyis ba ling ā tsarya la gsan pa yin/ rtsa ba la li ta la thug dgos pa gzhir bcas kyang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis man ngag kho na la brten pa'i phyir/ dngos su brgyud pa'i 'go yang de nas 'dren/ gnyos lo yon tan grags/ de'i sras rdo rje bla ma/ de'i sras dpal le/ de'i sras grags pa dpal rnams kyi bar du mthu stobs shin tu che/ de'i sras rgyal ba lha nang pa 'phrin las phyogs kun tu khyab/ de'i dbon rigs sogs la'ang dar te/ gnyos lugs rang du grags shing rgyal ba lha nang pa la mched grogs 'gar dam pa chos sdings pas zhus/ khong gi 'bri khung gi spyi rim pa yun ring po mdzad/ sku tshe'i smad la/ spo bor lha dgon btab nas gdul bya bskyangs pas/ bar skabs cig tu 'jigs mdzad 'gar lugs su grags shing*/ mdo khams lho stod du dar rgyas che ba byung zer/

rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi srol 'dzin bar skabs su byung ba la/ 'gar ljongs rgya gsum grags che ste/ 'gar lugs gnyos lugs kyi nang tshan yin/ ljongs dang rgya lugs rwa lugs gyi nang tshan no/ / phyis kyi bshad pa rdo rje myu gu zer ba 'di na 'gar ni lho pa 'gar rdo rje snying po zer ba dang zhang lugs brgyud 'dzin la zhang ston rgya bo zhes sogs zer ba ni/ chos rgyus phyogs tsam yang med pa'i bab col lo/ / ba ri ba'i rjes 'brang rnams ni/ la li ta la 'jam dpal grags pas zhus/ de yang rdo rje ma mkha' 'gro mas dbang bskur zhing mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa yin/ de la 'jam dpal grags pa chung bas zhus/ de yang yon tan snga ma dang 'dra/ de la 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis zhus/ de la a mo gha che bas zhus/ de la a mo gha chung bas zhus/ de la bla ma ba ri lo tsā bas zhus/ des g.yor dar grags la gnang*/ de nas kyang brgyud pa gsum bzhi'i bar du byung bar 'dug ste/ yun ring du ni ma dar ro/ / lugs 'di la'ang dgra gdon gnyis la re re dang*/ 'jigs mdzad bcu gsum ma dang*/ gti mug rdo rje la sogs pa'i mtshan rnam snang la sogs par bsgyur ba'i lha dgu ma dang*/ yab yum kha sbyor gyi sku can gyi ro langs brgyad bskor te dkyil 'khor lnga yod do/ / / /mal lugs su grags pa ni/ nag po skor gsum gyi nā ro pa'i man ngag rnams phaṃ thing ba chen po la bzhugs/ de la klog skyas zhus/ de la mal los zhus pa dang*/ yang slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyi man ngagabal po ye rang gi paṇti ta ha du dkar po zhes bya ba/ ba ra ind+ra ru rtse'i drung du mal los zhus nges su 'dugaphaṃ thing pa phyi ma la yang zhus ni zer/ gang ltar yang mal los 'jigs mdzad chen po dang*/ las mkhan smyon pa 'jigs byed la nus pa cung zad thon/ de la bla ma sa skya ba chen por zhus/ 'jigs byed sa lugs bya ba 'di la zer ba yin/ paṇḍi ta'i ngag sgros kho na las bsre bslad ni chung*/

nag 'jigs gnyis ka la dbang bka' bshad bka' yod/ bshad rlabs chung zhing man ngag kyang mdor bsdus pa'o/ / drag po'i 'khrul 'khor la sgyogs kyis btsal ba dang*/ 'khrul 'khor a ka ru nag po'i chu la 'dren pa sogs yod de/ rgya bal paṇa chung 'dra'i ngag sgros dang lag len yin srid kyang*/ dgos nus gang yang med do/ / lugs 'di'i lung bka' ci rigs dang*/ dbang mchog gzhan la brten pa'i dbang bka' ma nub tsam yod pa yang bdag gis 'khums/ 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang chog7 bla chen sa skya ba kun snying gis mdzes pa ste/ bar skabs su sa skya ba'i pho rus che bar bsgom pa sa tshig rdo tshig la song ba tsho sus kyang ma rnyed pa dpe rnying rang zhig khog bo'i lag tu 'byor bas ngo mtshar skyes so/ / lugs 'di la dgra nag gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'jigs mdzad ro langs brgyad bskor kho na te/ gnyis po dbang rgyun nges can yin la/ gdong drug ni de gnyis kyi 'dabs thebs pa tsam mo/ / gsum pa ni/ bla med kyi lugs dmar nag 'jigs gsum dang 'brel ba'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ji tsam bod du 'gyur snyam na/ nag po'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa lhan cig skyes pa'i snang ba/ dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dka' 'grel rin chen 'phreng ba gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa/ dpyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur te/ rgya 'grel rnam dag gnyis yod/ 'grel pa rin chen sgron ma zer ba/ slob dpon shān ti pa la kha 'phangs pa 'di dang*/ sgrub thabs ku mud ta kha phye ba zhes pa/ dgra nag bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs shān ti pa la kha 'phangs pa 'di dang*/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo'i don rgyas par bshad pa/ slob dpon mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad zer ba ste/ nag po'i skor la gsum po 'di/ ma nang lo tsā ba go rub chos shes brtsams pa yin gyi/ rgya gar gyi gzhung 'grel ma yin la/ ku mud kha phye ba ni/

rgyud dang mi mthun pas legs po yang ma yin zhing*/ gzhan gnyis tshig dang don legs par yod do/ / rgyud kyi 'grel pa mthong ba lam sgron nag po pas mdzad zer ba 'di ni/ skor ni ru bas bod skad du brtsams pa'am/ khong gi slob ma zhig gi zin bris yin gyi/ rgya dpe las bsgyur bar mi 'dugadon gyi cha ni/ dpal 'dzin gyi 'grel pa'i rjes su phal cher 'brang pa bshad pa bzang po yod/ tshig kyang rgyas par yang snang ngo*/ / dgra nag lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa 'di/ 'gyur gyi rtsa ba nag tsho'i 'gyur yin/ gnyos lo dang*/ zangs kar dang*/ klog skya dang*/ rwa lo rnams kyis kyang 'gyur bcos re mdzad 'duganag tsho 'gyur dpal 'dzin gyi 'grel pa dang gzhung 'di dag la/ la lar paṇḍi ta kriṣṇa pa yin zer ba dang*/ dā na kirti yin zer ba sogs paṇḍi ta'i ming mi 'dra ba 'ga' re 'dug cing*/

'gyur byang gcig pa la tshig rigs mi 'dra ba yang dum re snang ngo*/ / yang lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil chog dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga rnams gzhung gcig la tshang ba'i gshin rje gshed 'byung ba zhes bya ba la li ta chung ba'am/ la li ta badzra gyis mdzad pa paṇḍi ta a mo gha dang*/ zhang lo shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur yod/ gzhung de rgyud kyi don 'grel du brtsams pa yin zhing*/ shin tu bzang ba zhig kyang snang ngo*/ / slob dpon ka ma la rakṣi tas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa jo bo rje dang*/ nag tshos bsgyur/ spyir dgra nag bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs 'gyur tshad/ slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi rjes 'brang yin yang*/ sgos su ka ma la rakṣi ta'i sgrub thabs 'di zhabs lugs zangs ma rang yin no/ / slob dpon nyin byed grags pas mdzad pa'i bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs mgos 'gyur cig kyang yod/ bzhi po de nges can yin la/ paṇḍi ta rdo rje blo yis byas zer ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ paṇḍi ta kun tu bzang pos byas zer ba'i sgrub thabs te/ de gnyis yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs yin/ yang dpal 'dzin gzhung la mdzad byang mi gcig pa re byas lhad cung zad re bcuga'agyur mi gcig pa'am/ 'dod tshul tha dad byas pa tsam du zad do/ / de ltar na/ dpal 'dzin/ padma srung ba/ la li ta chung ba/ nyin byed grags pa ste dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs rkang thub bzhi yod/ dpal 'dzin dang la li ta badzra chung bas mdzad pa ste/ dkyil chog gnyis yod par don la 'gro yang*/ la li ta'i sgrub dkyil bstan bcos gcig gi nang nas phye ba yin pas/ gzhung so sor bgrod du ma btub bo/ / gzhung phra mo'i skor la/ lha bcu gsum po re re'i sgrub thabs bcu gsum dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa dang*/ dgra nag lha lnga'i mngon rtogs shrī paṇḍi tas mdzad zer ba cig yod/ mdzad byang la yig nor cig byung ba 'dra/

dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i dpa' gcig sgrub thabs yang dpa' gcig sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa 'jam dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ yang ka ma la rakṣi tas mdzad pa'i gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs dang*/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga ste gnyis/ gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs nag po pas mdzad pa/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga mdzad byang med pa gcig chos sku'i snang ba'i cho ga zer ba'i mchod rten gyi cho ga gcig dang*/ tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga ka ma la ma has mdzad zer ba gcig zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mdzad byang med pa gcigade rnams pradzñā shrī dzñā na'i 'gyur yin/ pradzñā shrī dzñā na ni rgya gar zangs gling par grags pa skor ni ru pa'i mtshan yin no/ / gzhan yang mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga li la badzra gyis mdzad pa/ bsrung 'khor gyi sgrub thabs mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs gho ṣa badzra kyis mdzad pa/ gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs mdzad byang med pa gcigardzogs rim gyi 'o ma sgrub pa zhes bya ba las rgya'i man ngag slob dpon dzi mu tas mdzad pa/ gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa paṇḍi ta klu byang gis mdzad pa rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi pa de bā ka ra tsand+ras mdzad pa khyad 'phags gcig yod kyang bstan 'gyur du sngar ma chug 'duganag po'i mchod chog gcig la dpe kha cig la/ dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad/ kha cig la kriṣṇa paṇḍi tas mdzad ces/ mdzad byang mi 'dra ba 'byung ba gciga'adi'i nang nas yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa tshig don legs po cig 'byung*/ mkhas mchog bus gshed dmar la yang sbyor bar mdzad do/ / ro sreg dang tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa/ tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga snga ma dang 'di gnyis 'gyur khyad ka yin/ ngo bo gcig par mngon no/ / 'khor lo 'bri ba'i cho ga mdzad byang med ba cig dgra nag gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs la li ta chung bas mdzad pa dang*/ sbyin sreg kyang des mdzad pa cig rnams byung*/

bstod pa ā tsarya kirtis mdzad zer ba cig rnams 'gyur ro/ / de dag las gzhan gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa jo bo rje dang lo chen gyis bsgyur ba 'di bstan 'gyur na skabs 'dir yod kyang*/ 'di dgra nag gi chos skor ma yin/ nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sgrub thabs kha 'thor ba'i sdebs yin/ bskyed chog sogs dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dang mthun shas che/ yang gshin rje gshed zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs phyogs gcig pa zhes pa/ jo bo rje dang nag tshos bsgyur ba 'di yang*/ dgra nag gi skor ma yin kha 'thor ba yin/ bstod pa'i rgyud las phyung ba yin zer ba'i bstod pa 'di yang de dang mthun pa'i bstod pa yin gyi dgra nag gi ma yin no/ / sdom gsum pa gdong drug gi rgyud dang 'brel ba la ni/ klu'i byang chub kyi mtshan can paṇḍi ta cig gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ de bā ka ra tsan dra'i sgrub thabs yod/ de gnyis kar nas las tshogs kyi rnam gzhag mun ne ba re ston/ gdong drug la 'di gnyis ma gtogs dgongs 'grel gyi rgya gzhung yongs su grags pa med do/ / gshin rje gshed dmar po'i phyogs la/ rgyud kyi 'grel pa 'gyur ba ni med/ thor bu'i skor la lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs/ lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs/ gtor chog chung ba/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gzhung che chung gnyis/ 'od gsal 'char ba'i dbang chogardzogs rim shin tu spros med de/ brgyad po de la bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad zer/ glo bo lo tsā ba la bshad bka' stabs gcig tu byung*/ der ma 'dus pa'i birwa'i gtor chog che ba cig kyang dpyal lugs dang dā na shī la'i lugs la 'dugasgrub thabs che chung dang*/ 'khrul 'khor che chung 'di rnams la dpyal chag dā na shrī la gsum ga'i 'gyur yod/ lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rang byin rlabs zhes pa slob dpon blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa/

chag lo chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ sgrub thabs 'di rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa'i man ngag tu 'dus pas rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi phyogs su gtogs kyang*/ gzhung 'di la gra sdebs gzhan med cing*/ lha sngags cho ga rnams gshin rje gshed dmar nag spyi dang mthun pas/ sdebs gcig la bzhag pa gda'/ gzhung ni khyad 'phags zhig yod do/ / dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i chos skor la/ dmar po lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbang chog rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi rim/ maṇḍal gyi cho gamachod chogagator chogating nge 'dzin gyi cho ga phyir bzlog man ngag drug gi gzhung*/ lha mo 'od 'chang ma'i sgrub thabs/ tsar tsi kā sogs yum bzhi'i sgrub thabs re re ste/ gzhung bcu gsum bshad bka' stabs gcig tu byung*/ sbyin sreg gcig 'dug pa ni/ dkyil chog gi nang nas bton par snang la/ lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs sogs gzhung thor bu pa gzhan yang snang ngo*/ / 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga gnas brtan byang chub snying pos mdzad pa dang*/ mdzad byang med pa ste gnyis yod/ 'di gnyis ka dus 'khor lugs yin zhing*/ dpyal chag gnyis ka'i 'gyur snang la/ dā na shī la'i 'gyur yang yod par snang ngo*/ / lhan skyes gyi sgrub thabs rnam snang srung bas mdzad pa dang*/ blo bzang snying pos mdzad pa dang*/ lha lnga rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa dang*/ 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid ces pa darpan a tsaryas mdzad pa rnams yod/ gshin rje gshed kyi lag mchod dā na shī las mdzad pa dang*/ thar los bsgyur ba'i gzhung phran gzhan yang snang ngo*/ / gshin rje gshed dmar po'i las kyi 'phreng ba'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ slob dpon shes rab skyong gis mdzad pa/ dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur 'di la/ klu dang gnod sbyin mo dang 'byung po dang sha za'i sgrub thabs sna tshogs 'dus pa/ da lta sum cu so lnga yod/

so bdun yod par bshad pas gnyis 'thor ba'o/ / 'di rgyud sna tshogs las bsdus pa'i man ngag yin pas/ gshed dmar kho na'i chos skor yin rgyu tsam med do/ / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i chos skor la/ gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ni/ bshad pa shin tu cha chung ba mna' sel lta bur snang*/ rdo rje grub pas mdzad pa dang*/ so na shrīs mdzad ces pa gnyis ni 'gyur khyad tsam ma gtogs ngo bo gcig yin zhing*/ rol pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba cig gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa'ang yod/ slob dpon mi bskyod pas mdzad zer ba'i 'grel pa 'di ni/ lo tsā ba go ru ba chos shes byas pa yin/ 'grel pa phyi ma de rnams gzhon nu zla ba las ni cung zad rgyas kyang*/ rgyud don gsal bar rtogs nus pa'i bshad pa mi snang ngo*/ /gzhung phran gyi skor la/ a mo gha badzra gyis mdzad pa'i bum dbang gi dkyil chog yod/ zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs la li ta chung bas mdzad pa/ zhi ba ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum kar ston pa'i sgrub thabs/ sems dpa' bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa 'di la bod mang dag don yod rdo rjes mdzad zer kyang ma yin no/ / sgron ma drug pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs shrī bha dras mdzad pa dang*/ dzñā na ka ra bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs khro bcu'i srung 'khor sngon du 'gro ba'i sgrub thabs/ li la badzra gyis mdzad par yang 'dod pa ste/ gsum po 'di phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor du grags pa de'i rigs kyi sgrub thabs yin/ phyi ma 'di la bod rnams ro langs brgyad skor yin zer ro/ / dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ a mo gha chung bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'di gnyis dang*/ gong du smos pa'i sgron ma drug pa de gsum po gzhal yas khang med pa'i lugs yin/ sgrub thabs padma rgyas pa ka ma la rakṣi tas mdzad pa dang*/

rdo rje 'od zer bai ro tsa na rakṣi tas mdzad pa ste de gnyis bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs yin zhing*/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yin yang rtog bdun gyi rtog pa dang po'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ dgra nag gi rim pa bkral ba yin no/ / de bzhin du phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ bsdus pa rnam gsum gyi sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ gtor chog bsdus pa la li tas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga a mo ghas mdzad pa/ tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga shān ti pas mdzad pa/ drag po las bdun dang*/ zhi ba las bdun gyi cho ga ste gnyis po de a mo gha badzra gyis mdzad pa yin/ 'di'i 'phrul 'khor rnams rtog gsum gyi lugs kho na rang min yang*/ rtog gsum dang mthun shas che/ a mo gha chung ba bod la byon pa de yin/ zhes bod rnams zer yang*/ gong du smos pa'i dpa' rkyang gi sgrub thabs mdzad pa po de dang mi gcig par mngon no/ / phyag mtshan gyi rnam dag ta thā ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa mal 'gyur gcigagazhan yang bstod pa'i rnam grangs 'ga' zung dang bcas pa 'gyur ro/ / rgyud 'di'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung yin zer ba/ phyis byung ba gcig gnyis tsam gda' ste/ bod du phyis brtsams pa kho nar zad do/ / de ltar na dmar nag 'jigs gsum la/ gzhung rnam dag bod du 'gyur ba da dung gzhan yang yod srid mod kyang*/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal du chug pa dang*/ ma chug kyang yongs su grags pa ni de tsam mo/ / gzhan yang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang na'ang yod pa sogs/ gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs kha 'thor ba/ gzhung rnam dag kyang mang dag yod cing*/ gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud la 'grel pa gnyis yod pa rgya 'grel yin tshul du byas 'dug kyang*/ snga dar ram/ phyi dar snga dus kyi zin bris zhig yin par mngon/ dkyil chog gsar ma zhig yod/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung bzang po 'ga' re snang ste/

bstan 'gyur du ni ma chug go de ltar na gshin rje gshed skor rgya gar nas bsgyur nges pa'i gzhung ni de tsam yin yang*/ de dag la brten pa'i bshad pa dang*/ man ngag zab mo ni mtha' yas pa yod do/ / / / da ni 'di cung zad dpyad par bya ste/ gshin rje gshed rwa lugs kyi chos skor la/ phyis bod yul 'di na rwa bod ces grags che bar snang ngo*/ / re zhig 'di'i dkar chag tshigs bcad ma ni 'di yin te/ le'u bco brgyad kun gyi gzhi/ / rgyud kyi rgyal po ston pas gsungs/ / de yi grogs su rtog pa gsum/ / sngags pa'i mtshon char gsungs pa yin/ / sgrub thabs dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyis/ / mdzad pa 'di la gtso bor bzung*/ / 'phrul 'khor gsal byed buddha shrī/ / lus dang snying 'dra'i man ngag yod/ / ces nag po'i rgya gzhung dang*/ rgyud kyi spyi chings khog don yin/ / yig sna lus kyi rnam bshad yin/ / bla ma'i gsung bsdur phran tshegs rnams/ /ma go gegs sel gdams ngag yin/ / dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad gdams ngag la/ / gsal byed tsam gyi yi ge byas/ / bha ro'i phyag len dpal 'dzin gsung*/ / de brten dbang bskur gong ma la/ / yig sna bdud rtsi'i bum pa brtsams/ / chos bzhi 'chi med bdud rtsi dang*/ / mig sman sgrub pa'i gtam rgyud dang*/ / srung 'khor kha sbyor dbye ba dang*/ / las sgrub 'khor lo phyi ma dang*/ / rgyas gdab bla ma'i bzhed pa dang*/ / bla ma'i zhal bsdur gtor ma dang*/ / sa 'og dgug pa'i gtam rgyud dang*/ / bla ma rnams kyi zhal bsdur dang*/ / he ru ka yi rnam bshad dang*/ / bar do byang chub sems bshad dang*/ / glu yi rnam par bshad rnams dang*/ / bla ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin du/ / zin bris byas nas bla ma la/ / gzigs par phul nas dag par gtugs/ / mnyes nas de tsug yin zhes gsung*/ / char 'bebs lha dbang klu nad gtong*/ / sbrul bzung gso dang mgo nad zhi/ / chu 'gag 'khyams dang ro langs bsgrub/ / 'phags ma dzi gu li sgrub thabs/

/ yum bzhi la sogs bsgrub pa dang*/ / mig sman ril bu rkang mgyogs dang*/ / mkha' spyod thos pa bsgrub pa dang*/ / sa 'og mkha' spyod mi snang dang*/ / ral gcig pukka sī bsgrub dang*/ / lha dang klu yi bu mo dgug/ man ngag gser zhun 'di dag rnams/ / rgyud kyi snying 'dra bla ma'i gsung*/ / bod kyi bandhes yi ger bkod/ / bla ma nyid la gzigs pa phul/ / nor 'khrul byung na dngos grub med/ / lhag chad e 'dug lan gsum zhus/ / rkang thag spangs nas lan gsum zhus/ / bla ma'i zhal nas legs zhes 'bod/ / nor 'khrul mi 'dug lan gsum gsung*/ / zhes nag po'i skor gyi bod yig rnams dang*/ bshad rgyud sdom gsum ldan pa yod/ / dka' ba'i gnas bkrol yig sna byas/ / don bsdus gsal ba'i sgron me byas/ / dbang chog bdud rtsi'i bum chung byas/ / zhes gdong drug gi bod yig dang*/ snying po rgyud mchog rtog bdun yod/ / las mkhan te'u lo'i rtog pa yod/ /

shrī bha dra yis mdzad pa'i/ / sgrub thabs lo tsā bsgyur ba yod/ / don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa yi/ / sgrub thabs dkyil chog sbyin sreg yod/ / dī paṃ ka ras sbyin sreg yod/ / ratna a kar shān ti yis/ / mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo yod/ / bha ro'i sgrub thabs rnam gsum yod/ kha cig gsar 'gyur kha cig bcos/ / zhes rdo rje 'jigs byed skor gyi rgya gzhung dang*/ rgyud gyi rgyal po rtog bdun la/ / nag 'grel mun pa'i mda' 'phen brtsams/ / rkang 'grel phyogs mthong 'ben la btang*/ / bcud kyi thigs pas phog par bsnun/ / gsod pa'i mtshon de snying la gnas/ kha rgyun yi ger ma bkod do/ / bsnyen sgrub dgra srog dbang sdud yod/ / mngon rtogs rim pa lnga yang yod/ / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg cho ga yod/ / dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa yod/ / smin byed dkyil mchog yig sna yod/ / ces 'jigs mdzad skor gyi bod yid rnams so/ / dpe 'ga' zhig tu/ bsnyen sgrub las gshin sbrags ma yod/ / ces 'byung*/ tshig lhug par yang de bzhin 'byung ngo*/ / 'jug tu/ 'di dag rnams ni mi legs na'ang*/ / ban chung rwa yi lugs su snang*/ / 'di ru ma 'dus ye ge'i tshogs/ / legs na'ang gzhan gyis sbyar ba yin/ / zhes sogs yod cing*/ nag po'i sgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ rgyud kyi dka' 'grel dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rnams la/ rwa lo chen pos bsdus don re yod pa/ dkar chag tshigs bcad mar ma chug pa ni/ sku 'da' khar mdzad pas yin/ chos rab kyis yi ge ma mdzad/ ye shes seng ges dgra nag la mngon rtogs dang*/ dharma seng ges bum dbang gi cho ga'i yi ge byas/ zhes pa dang*/ paṇḍi ta zla ba phyed pa'i lugs yod kyang rtsis su mi mdzad ces pa dkar chag tshigs bcad ma'i 'grel pa/ ga gong dpal gyi dgon par/ rwa sher rgyal gyis bris gsung ba na yod do/ / 'on kyang rwa chos rab kyi nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yig sna dang*/

ye shes seng ge dang*/ 'bum seng gis kyang de las cung zad spros pa'i yi ge snang bas/ chos rab kyi yig sna gsar pa ma mdzad pa'ang min la/ gong du 'khod pa'i yi ge de rnams dkar chag der/ rwa lo chen po'i gsung yin tshul brjod mkhas par byung 'dug pas/ bar skabs kyi mkhas pa rnams dang*/ phyis kyi sa dge bo gsum sogs rdo rje 'jigs byed pa kun gyis/ rwa lo'i gsung yin nges su bzung nas/ 'ga' zhig yig cha de dag la dgag pa gtong zhing*/ rwa lo 'gog thub par mngon pa'i nga rgyal byed/ kha cig dad pa tsam gyis rjes su 'brang mod kyi/ bstan bcos de dag gi nang na/ rje btsun rdo rje grags pa'i gsungs rtsom yang ci rig pa yod par snang zhing*/ phal cher gsung la slob ma rnams kyis zin bris su byas pa yin pas/ gsung rgyun yin pa'i phyir gsung zhes byas pa yin/ dmigs su dod pa la/ bsnyen sgrub las gshin sbrags ma zhes pa tshigs bcad ma de yin na/ tshig sbyor ches mi mdzes pa yod pas lo tsā ba'i gsungs rtsom ga la yin/ yang bsnyen sgrub dgra srog dbang sdud bya ba lag len khrigs bkod la zer na/ de ni rwa lo chen po'i gsung la/ zhang tshe spong bas zin bris sbyar ba yin par grags pas mtshon/ bcud thig che ba yang rwa dharma seng ges mdzad pa dang*/ yang dgra nag gi yi ge cig na/ paṇḍi ta sa man ta shrī'i bzhed pa bkod pas kyang gsal/ 'on kyang de dag na bla ma'i gsung bgros 'chugs pa yang cher med la/ gsung rab spyi dgos dang 'gal ba'i nor ba yang cher med pas/ dgag pa byed pa rnams ni mkhas 'dod kha thal ba tsam ma gtogs/ don thog tu song ba cang mi snang ngo*/ / mngon rtogs rim pa lnga dang bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog ni/ rwa lo yab sras kyi gsung dngos reg zig cig yod pa dpe ha cang bka' dam pas ma 'phel ba dang*/ phyi mo gcig po de yang bla ma dkon mchog seng ge pa'i dus su mes tshig nas/

de'i dod du khong nyid kyis brtsams pa'am/ bla ma sher rgyal bas mdzad pa yin/ gser pod dod du gser 'dra brtsams/ / zhes pa'i kha skad yod ces/ rwa ba'i bla ma rnams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rnam rgyal gyi gsung las thos so/ / de bzhin du dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa yang*/ dbang sdud dang*/ dug srung bsdus pa de 'dir bgrong pa yin gyi/ dug srung rgyas pa 'di ni stod lung bai ror grags pa/ rgya gar gyi grub thob bai ro tsa na badzra zhes pa la/ rwa dharma seng ges gsan pa yin/ 'di'i lha sku mdog sngon po yin pas/ dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i tha snyad kyang mi thob bo/ / 'jigs mdzad bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog chen mo 'di/ rwa lo chen po'i rtsom pa dngos yin na/ 'bum seng gi dkyil chog logs pa 'di mdzad mi dgos pa las/ de'i phyir yang de 'drar rig par bya'o/ dkar chag tshigs bcad ma de'i don gzhan rnams go sla/ de'i grogs su rtog pa gsum/ zhes pa da lta'i rtog gsum gyi gzhung rang yin/ dkar chag mdzad pa po rgyud du bzhed pa yang des gsal/ des na ngor pa rnams rwa pod rwa lo'i gsung rtsom du 'dod bzhin du/ rwa ba rnams rtog gsum khas mi len zer pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi yig skor de kho na ma gtogs/ rwa pod rdzogs par lan gcig tsam yang ma bklags shing*/ dkar chag tshang ba yang ma bltas pa'i skyon no/ / gal te mthong na ni/ 'di'i 'grel pa tshig lhug pa na yang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi rtog pa/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi bza' ba'i rtog pa/ las dang rgyud kyi grogs shes rtog pa gsum po dngos su bgrangs 'dug kyang*/ rtog gsum yin pa ma shes pa 'di ni/ ma jos 'dod yon lnga bgrong ma shes pa'i dpe'am lag tu sgron me thogs nas me slong du 'gro ba dang 'dra'o/ / lus dang snying 'dra'i man ngag yod/ / ces pa ni/ buddha shrīs mdzad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi gzhung dngos lus dang 'dra/

de'i gsal byed kyi gzhung chung snying dang 'dra zhes pa'i don yin/ yig sna lus kyi rnam bshad ces pa rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa'i ṭī ka yin/ gzhan rgyud sde'i rnam bshad nas klu'i bshad pa yan chad/ yig chung bcu drug yod pa ba rnams la zin bris chen mor ming 'dogs/ ṭī kar ma 'dus pa'i bshad pa'i dogs gcod yin/ char 'bebs nas klu mo dgug pa'i bar la yig chung nyi shu rtsa lnga yod de/ las 'phros zab mo zhes mi 'dogs/ ṭī ka'i dkyus la 'brir ma lang pa'i sgrub thabs kyi man ngag rnams yin/ dpal gyi la sogs pa rnams rwa pa'i las 'phreng chen mo zhes pa yig sna nyi shu rtsa gnyis tsam yod pa yo bsdoms pas dgra nag gi 'grel pa gcig tu 'gro ba yod zer ba ni/ yi ge dngos su ma mthong bar ma zad/ rna thos kyang ma dag pa/ 'on pas phag nyan byas par lta bu'o/ / gsod pa'i mtshon ni snying la gnas/ / zhes pa ni ha la nag po'i shog gril gsum ste/ las sbyor dngos dang*/ spogs chog dang*/ shin tu spogs chog go kha rgyun yi ger ma bkod ces pas/ da dung zhal shes yod pa'i don yin no/ / mngon rtogs rim pa lnga ni/ dpal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal phyag rgyas pa gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs/ bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rnams la zer ba yin/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ni/ drag po la dgra bgegs kun 'dul zer ba'i yi ge che ba cig yod/ zhi ba la tho yig 'bring ba cig yod/ dbang drag la tho yig bsdus pa'o/ / de dag las rkang 'grel dang*/ bcud thig dang*/ ha la'i shog gril dang*/ bsnyen sgrub las gshin sbrags ma dang*/ lag len khrigs bkod rnams ni nang sel na thun mong ma yin pa'i brjod bya gcig tu ma bshad pa cig shos su bshad pa mang po yod pas/ de dag nges par rtogs na yi ge spyi khog na zlos pa'i tshul du yod pa rnam mgo mi rmongs par 'gyur ro/

/de ltar rwa pod du grags pa 'di/ rwa shar pa'i lugs la dkar chag dang bcas pa yod pa yin/ nub pa rnams la dkar chag 'dis bsdus pa'i po ti khrigs chags mi mdzad kyang*/ yig sna phal cher mthun cing*/ khyad bcos lhag po yang mang po yod do/ / uṣṇi ṣa'i man ngag gi skor rnams kyang*/ bzlas sngags sogs kyi sgo nas/ gsang 'dus la brten pa'ang yin mod de/ nag po'i rgyud ni gsang 'dus kyi rjes su 'brang*/ de dang cha mthun gdong drug yin/ 'jigs byed kyang phyogs 'dra zhing 'brel can yin pa'i phyir/ gsang 'dus dang 'brel ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ gshed skor ma yin zer ba gad mo'i gnas yin no/ / 'on kyang lha rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis par byed pas/ gsang 'dus kho na'i yang ma yin no/ / 'di nyid kyi yig skor las kyang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la sogs pa/ mkhas grub mang po'i dgongs 'dus yin par bshad/ des na rgyud sde gang la sbyar yang rung mod kyi/ gtso bor gshin rje gshed nag po skor gsum dang 'brel che bar mngon te/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi las sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i ched dang mngon spyod kyi las rnams rang nyid kyis sgrub pa la/ pha rol po'i lha'i gnod pa dang*/ bzlog pa sogs kyi las kyis rang gi las sbyor gnad du mi 'gro ba'i bar chad mang du 'byung ba la srung bzlog 'di nges pa gal che zhing pha rol po'i gsang sde 'joms pa dang*/ byas pa gzhig pa dang*/ rang gi las gzhan gyis mnan pa 'don pa dang*/ yang bzlog la sogs pa'i ched du 'di dgos pa yin pas/ gshin rje gshed kyi las tshogs rnams sgrub pa'i rgyab skyor la gal che zhing*/ snyigs ma'i dus su sngags pa nang rgyas kho na 'byung ba'i phyir/ srung bzlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag 'di rnams kyang legs par rtogs par bya'o/ / 'di la rwa shar nub kyi man ngag dpe bum so so ba gnyis yod do/ / gzhan yang sgrub thabs thor bu ba 'ga' re yod/

mgon nag la mchog sred kyi gzhung la mchan bu dang*/ man ngag gi yi ge gcig yod/ dpal lha mo la srog gi gzer bu'i gzhung mchan bu dang bcas pa dang*/ man ngag gi yi ge gcig go / lha mgon gyi skor la/ tshu tshun dha ra'i cho ga sngar song*/ de'i mchan bu dang*/ las mkhan te lo'i rtog pa dang*/ de'i man ngag yig chung dang*/ lha mgon gyi sgrub thabs kā la ka las mdzad pa/ sgrub khog gi yig chung rnams yod/ las gshin la chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa dang*/ de'i gsal byed kyi yi ge dang*/ man ngag gces pa brgyad dang*/ dmar po'i man ngag spu gri reg gcod che ba dang*/ rgya ston phyogs la dmar po rigs gnyis kyi sgrub thabs las sbyor dang bcas pa re re dang*/ spru gri reg gcod chung ba dang*/ gzhan yang phyag mtshan gyi las tshogs dang*/ 'khor lo rnam gsum ma dang*/ yang bzlog gi man ngag gsum sogs man ngag thor bu mang po zhig yod de/ de dag ni rwa lugs kyi skor ro/ / skyo lugs la ni/ brten so rgyud bzhi la brten/ bstan bcos la sgron ma drug gcig tu bsdoms pa'i rgya gzhung bcu tsam rgyab brten du byed/ rtog bdun la skyo chen po nyid kyi ṭī ka dang*/ rtog gsum la ngag sgros kyi ṭī ka dang*/ sgrub dkyil/ sbyin sregarab gnas sogs 'phral gyi cho ga rnams dang*/ man ngag la chog sgrigs nyams kyi zhal gdams zhes pa gcig gis sna drangs pa'i/ yig sna phra mo lnga bcu lhag tsam yod do/ / de dag gi tho gzhan du bris zin to/ / zhang lugs la ni/ rtog bdun la mchan bu thar thor ma gtogs yig sna ma mthong mod/ yod par ni snang*/ sgrub thabs la zhe dgu ma dang*/ phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis ka snang*/ dkyil mchog dgra nag gi de ka sbyor/ nag po'i skor la rgyud la mchan bu mi 'dra ba gnyis dang bsdus don sogs mthong*/ yig sna yang mi 'dra ba gsum yod par ni grags/ gshin rje gshed 'byung ba la gcung rdo rje rtse mos ṭī ka mdzad/

des 'khor lo'i man ngag sogs yig sna thor bu ba yang mang du mdzad/ gtsang thang 'od pos kyang bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag khyad par can mdzad/ phyis zhang rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis/ zhing khams snang ba zhes bya ba'i spyi don yang mdzad/ gzhan gang zag so sos brtsams pa'i sgrub dkyil sbyin sreg sogs mang du yod/ khyad par du yang de ba ā ka ra tsand+ras mdzad pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung la/ mchan bu yig sna sa bcad gsum yod de ngo mtshar che ba yin no/ / lo tsā ba ba ri'i lugs la rtog bdun la mchan bu thor tsam dang*/ nag po'i lo rgyus dang*/ bsdus don sogs phra mo tsam mthong ngo*/ / nag tsho lugs la/ rgyud dang dpal 'dzin gyi 'grel pa gnyis ka la mchan bu dang*/ rgyud 'grel gyi bsdus don yang yod/ 'grel par mi gsal ba'i kha skong*/ rgyud kyi yig sna rgyas rab dang bcas pa mthong ngo*/ / 'di'i lugs kyi brgyud yig na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ tha ga ba dga' pa'i rdo rje/ nag po spyod pa/ lwa ba pa/ rgyal po harṣa de ba/ gaṃ bi ra badzra/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin/ dharma shrī/ rin chen 'byung gnas/ shānti bha dra rnams nas brgyud zer ba 'dug go / mal lugs su grags pa la ni/ nag po'i rgyud la ni/ gung thang la tse'i gnas su/ bla ma lo tsā ba dang dpal 'dzin gyi dgongs pa dri gtugs dang bcas pa mchan du btab pa'o/ / zhes yod pa cig dang*/ bla ma lo tsā ba la dpa' phaṃ things pa'i dgongs pa slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dri gtugs dang bcas mtshan du btab bo zer ba yod pa'i yig chung mi 'dra ba gnyis yod cing*/ sa ma ṭī ka lta bu'i yig sna bsdus pa rang cig dang*/ bsdus don dang*/ rje btsun chen po'i sgrub thabs rnams yod/ rtog bdun la/ bla chen sa skya ba'i bka' 'grel dang*/ de la gsal byed kyi mchan bu rtse mos mdzad par grags pa zhig yod/ gnyis ka la thun mong du bla chen gyis dbang chog zhig mdzad do/

/ 'di pa'i lugs la slob dpon dza mā ri pas rgyud 'di spyan drangs gsung ngo*/ / de dag gi so so'i yig cha rtsa ba rnams ji tsam rnyed pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ snga phyir lugs so so la yig sna dpag tu med pa yod mod kyi/ thams cad brir ga la lang ste bzhag go / 'di ltar dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// srid pa gsum gyi rgyal thabs bla na med/ khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po'i rgyud sde la/ / 'jug par 'dod rnams de ltar shes par gyis/ / zhes par gshin rje gshed kyi chos khungs gtan la phab pa/ yid ches ngo mtshar can zhes pa 'di yang*/ tā ra nā thas skyes bdag gi lo la smras pa'o// //zhus dag /maṅga laṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ rgyud rgyal gshin rje gshed skor gyi chos 'byung rgyas pa yid ches ngo mtshar bzhugs/ -PAGE 138--PAGE 137--PAGE 1-
